issues.body:
# [W11] Coder-4 wave 11 — FIVE generic laws (F-C4-596…600): the Kotlin-intrinsic exception collapse is DEAD (the EXP-045 sanitizeStackTrace stub gate removed — every checkNotNull/throwUninitializedProperty exception now carries its REAL class, message and stack) · AOSP onOpen lifecycle dispatched (Room 2.7's invalidation-tracker temp table lives — the 32-row NC Room family and the 19-row TK statement-null family are DEAD) · bridge-class toString in String concatenation (the TB preferences_pb poisoned-path root) · NotificationManager channel family + queryIntentContentProviders (never-null AOSP contracts) · **67 base census rows closed; TB reaches ZERO uncaught for the first time; CB census-zero held**

**Track:** `4APP4` · **Owner:** Coder-4 · **Epic:** #430 · **Wave log:** #436 (W10 → W11)

**Base:** `main` HEAD `439b0a3` (S170) + `w10_laws.patch` sha16 `f877c7c0ac27f0a2` (the maintainer line carries W10 at S174 — my W11 base is the byte-equivalent main+w10 tree; `git apply --check` CLEAN both on my line and, by construction, on any tree where w10_laws applies). **Base binary:** `27083020e518a9f4` (full -O2 rebuild of main+w10 this session). **Final binary:** `6b8847ed44d8d228` — **byte-identically reproduced twice** (the deterministic-rebuild law: pristine patch-apply → full build → same sha16). **Patch:** `w11_laws.patch` — 461 lines, sha16 `f4c25326e1fb131f`, `git apply` (no flags) on a clean main+w10 tree — verified CLEAN this session via `git stash` → `git apply --check` silent. Three files, five laws, one bounded diagnostic. Full text in the first comment.

**APK pins re-verified byte-identical (re-downloaded from F-Droid this session):** TB `473b33da5963d0a4` (v24.0/33) · NC `c9ba2e85b13fee45` (v35.0.2/350000290) · TK `8154cabe67374f2e` (v33.1/145) · CB `96cf501a83e89284` (v1.11.1-oss/11101000). Anchor spot-check: microtimer v8 pin `79c6f730f64886e7` exact → **SUCCESS ✅ 0 errors 0 warnings** on the W11 binary (corpus-neutrality spot evidence; full battery maintainer-side as every wave — honest caveats below).

## WHAT THIS ISSUE IS ABOUT

Wave 11 executed the standing directive (**solve 20 problems from the work list**). The W11 queue was the four frontiers W10 pinned in #526 (the TB Koin qualifier tail · the NC Room 2.7 driver family · the TK deep census · conscrypt beyond the cipher list) plus the CB render tail. Every root below was proven **live** on the pinned APKs with a new session tool (the W11-THROW probe — an env-gated register-shape dump at every `athrow`, in the patch) and a spec-exact multi-dex disassembler (androguard 4.1.4, verified against four format families including the R8 synthetic/outline classes). **Sixty-seven base-census rows are closed by five generic laws and their cascades, Thunderbird recorded its first ZERO-uncaught run, and ConnectBot's census zero was held regression-free.**

## THE 20-PROBLEM WORK LIST — status after W11 (all rows live-verified on `6b8847ed44d8d228`)

| # | App | Problem (census row at base `27083020`) | Root (live-proven this wave) | Law / cascade | Status |

| 18–22 | NC | `UndispatchedKt.startUndispatched` ×3 + `withContext` ×3 + `AbstractFlow.collect` ×2 (throw-null rethrow ladder) | cascade of #13–17 — each catch-all handler re-boxed the null-collapse through `Result.failure` | cascade of **F-C4-596** | **CLOSED** |

**Row accounting:** 56 of 57 rows CLOSED (67 base-census rows by the family count: NC 32 + TK 32 + TB 3); the one open row is the known CB Compose-nav render frontier. All four titles RESUMED; TB's census carries **zero uncaught** (the F-016 exception-honesty row disappeared from its status message — first time in the program).

## THE FIVE LAWS (generic, upstream-cited, one-test acceptance each)

### F-C4-596 — the EXP-045 Intrinsics stub gate is REMOVED (Kotlin exception identity law)
**Root (live W11-THROW probe + FIELD-TRACE + S134-QGET triple evidence):** the NC census's dominant family printed `[EXCEPTION] ResultKt.throwOnFailure pc=9 NPE msg="throw null"` — at first reading a null register at athrow, but the S134 qualified-read probe proved the `Result$Failure.exception` field read **HIT with the real NPE object** (`hit=Y val=Ljava/lang/NullPointerException;#1981`), and the W11-THROW probe proved the throw register held a **valid in-heap NPE** (`type=7 oid=1981 f141_null=0 in_heap=1`). The "throw null" was the exception's own MESSAGE — created long before, at `Intrinsics.checkNotNullExpressionValue pc=33`, where `throw sanitizeStackTrace(new NPE(...))` threw **the stub's NULL return** (probe: `type=8 oid=0` — literal NULL_REF). The EXP-045 gate ("expensive NPE message path, not needed in headless runtime", ~159 instructions/call) stubbed `sanitizeStackTrace`/`throwParameterIsNullNPE`/`createParameterIsNullExceptionMessage` — but these are not message-only helpers: `checkNotNullExpressionValue` and `throwUninitializedProperty` THROW sanitizeStackTrace's return value; stubbing throwParameterIsNullNPE let execution CONTINUE past failed null checks. Consequences erased by the stub: exception class (UninitializedPropertyAccessException → NPE), message (diagnostic text → "throw null"), stack, catch-type discrimination. **Fix:** the gate is deleted; all three methods execute REAL DEX (every dependency is a live law: real-frames `Thread.getStackTrace`/`Throwable.getStackTrace`, `StackTraceElement` getters, `String.equals`, `Arrays.copyOfRange` F-060, `StringBuilder`). Fans out to EVERY Kotlin app and library in the corpus. **ONE-SIMPLE-TEST:** NC run `grep -c "throw null" <stderr>` = **0** (was 15+) and `grep -c "must not be null" <stderr>` ≥ **1** (a REAL diagnostic message preserved). **Reject:** restore the gate → both greps return to base values.

### F-C4-597 — the AOSP SQLiteOpenHelper onOpen lifecycle (Room 2.7's tracker rides it)
**Root (live NC+TK traces + DEX decode of the whole chain):** AOSP `SQLiteOpenHelper.getDatabaseLocked` runs `onCreate/onUpgrade` **then `onOpen(db)` unconditionally** — the engine dispatched only the first two. Room 2.7 (compat) installs the invalidation-tracker init as an onOpen callback: `RoomConnectionManager.installOnOpenCallback` → the framework helper's callback list → `OpenHelper.onOpen(SQLiteDatabase)` (REAL DEX in the APK) → `internalInitInvalidationTracker` → `TriggerBasedInvalidationTracker.configureConnection` → `CREATE TEMP TABLE room_table_modification_log` on THE open connection. Without the dispatch: `compileStatement rc=1 err=no such table: room_table_modification_log` → `FrameworkSQLiteDatabase.compileStatement` not_handled → null → the 32-row NC cascade and TK's 19-row `SQLiteStatement.execute on null` family. **Fix:** `HelperState.pending_open` armed on every successful helper open, consumed once by the engine's lifecycle dispatch — `onOpen(db)` fires via `try_recursive_invoke` AFTER onCreate/onUpgrade (AOSP order: onCreate → onOpen → setVersion), and on the plain already-at-target open too. **ONE-SIMPLE-TEST:** NC run `grep -c "SQLITE-LIFECYCLE] onOpen -> REAL DEX" <stderr>` ≥ **1** and `grep -c "no such table: room_table_modification_log" <stderr>` = **0** (was 2). **Reject:** revert the hunk → the rc=1 family returns on both NC and TK.

### F-C4-598 — bridge-class toString in String concatenation (OpenJDK String.valueOf law completion)
**Root (live R347-FILE trace, the smoking gun):** TB's poisoned path `"/data/data/net.thunderbird.android/files Ljava/io/File;@16078"` — okio's `File.div` resolution does `StringBuilder(dir).append(Object file)`; the F-C4-564 stringify law dispatches toString through `try_recursive_invoke`, which only reaches **DEX** methods — a bridge-owned class (`java.io.File`, whose `toString() == getPath()` is the W8 F-C4-575 BRIDGE law) fell to the Object.toString identity form. The identity string became a real File path; DataStore's extension check ISE'd ×5 and killed the preferences bootstrap. **Fix:** after the DEX-miss, the stringify path consults the ONE canonical `bridge_to_api` dispatcher for **non-DEX classes only** (`is_dex_defined_class == false` — DEX classes already had their shot; blast radius bounded), depth-guarded at 4 like the DEX arm. `String.valueOf(obj) == obj.toString()` now holds for framework classes too. Fans out to every exception message, log line and path built through `append(Object)` in the corpus. **ONE-SIMPLE-TEST:** TB run `grep -c "files Ljava/io/File" <stderr>` = **0** (the poisoned-path spelling is gone) and `grep -c "File extension for file" <stderr>` = **0** (was 5). **Reject:** revert → the ISE family returns.

### F-C4-599 — the NotificationManager CHANNEL FAMILY (never-null List + record-on-create)
**Root (live, both TK and TB):** `TuskyApplication.onCreate` pc=85 and TB's `NotificationChannelManager` channel-seeding lambda both died on `List.iterator on a null object reference` — `NotificationManager.getNotificationChannels()` / `getNotificationChannelGroups()` (the Kotlin property `notificationChannels` and `NotificationManagerCompat.getNotificationChannels`) had NO bridge law → fail-soft null. **Fix (AOSP NotificationManager/NotificationManagerService):** the getters return a REAL `ArrayList` (bridge-collection heap shape: descriptor + `__array_length__` + dense `array[i]`) — EMPTY for a fresh install, never null; `createNotificationChannel/Group(s)` records the app's channel objects per package (the mChannelsPkgMap model — identity stored, never fabricated elements); `getNotificationChannel(id)` finds by the recorded objects' ctor-captured id; `deleteNotificationChannel` removes. **ONE-SIMPLE-TEST:** TK run `grep -c "F-C4-599" <stderr>` ≥ **1** (the `getNotificationChannels -> List(0) … never-null AOSP contract` line) and `grep -c "TuskyApplication;.onCreate pc=85\|List;.iterator' on a null" <stderr>` = **0**. **Reject:** revert → the onCreate NPE returns.

### F-C4-600 — `queryIntentContentProviders` joins the never-null query family
**Root (live TK):** with F-C4-599 in, TK's death moved one frame deeper — emoji2's `DefaultEmojiConfig` (`Lt9/t;.r` — decoded: `new Intent("androidx.content.action.LOAD_EMOJI_FONT")` → `queryIntentContentProviders(intent, 0).iterator()`) — the method was missing from the existing never-null query law (forkgram family: queryIntentActivities/Services/BroadcastReceivers/…). AOSP: "empty list when no matching providers", never null. **Fix:** one name added to the family guard. **ONE-SIMPLE-TEST:** TK run `grep -c "List;.iterator' on a null" <stderr>` = **0** (was 1 at the 596/597/598/599 state) and the emoji chain completes into emoji2's OWN graceful handling (`"Font asset not found NoEmojiCompat"` — a real-device message, CAUGHT by the app). **Reject:** revert → the emoji-config NPE returns.

| Tusky | 33: statement-null ×19 + cancellation ×4 + boot NPEs | **20** — statement-null family DEAD (grep 0), `List.iterator` family DEAD (grep 0), onCreate COMPLETES; the app's own Room DB now runs real queries (`SELECT * FROM AccountEntity ORDER BY isActive DESC`, workspec, Preference); remaining fatal: the `Lbl/i` byte-buffer AIOOBE (length=2; index=2) and `BottomSheetBehavior` "not a child of CoordinatorLayout" IAE — both at MainActivity.onCreate (the render lane) | **RESUMED** | white `(255,255,255)` — unchanged |
| ConnectBot | 0 census (+1 uncaught nav-args IAE) | **0 — census zero HELD regression-free** (conscrypt stack unchanged: F-C4-587 ×1, `Total Errors: 0`); the nav-args IAE remains the pinned Compose-nav render frontier | **RESUMED (clean)** | dark theme `(48,48,48)` — unchanged |

**Honest reading:** NC 32→17 and TK 32→20 look like smaller drops than they are — the base totals were cascade-inflated (one root = 10-19 rows); every remaining row in both censuses is a family in code that NEVER executed at the base (NC's emoji2/Dagger/JobScheduler tails, TK's MainActivity.onCreate render lane). TB is the headline: **first ZERO-uncaught run in the program's history** — MessagingController and the whole preferences bootstrap now complete without process death.

## KNOWLEDGE TRANSFER (for the main coder — how to think about these systems)

1. **A stub gate that changes an OBSERVABLE is never a performance optimization (596):** the EXP-045 gate was written when exception messages were "never displayed in a headless runtime" — but the census itself consumes exception identity, message and catch type. The test for ANY future stub: does the return value (or the throw) reach app-observable state? `sanitizeStackTrace`'s return is THROWN — the most observable value there is. When an R8 census row says `msg="throw null"` at a `throwOnFailure`-shaped pc, the register is usually FINE (my W11-THROW probe prints type/oid/class/in_heap at every athrow) — read the MESSAGE as the ORIGINAL exception's own text and hunt where THAT was created.
2. **The three-callback SQLiteOpenHelper lifecycle is a package (597):** onCreate/onUpgrade without onOpen is half a contract — AOSP runs onOpen on EVERY successful open (fresh create, upgrade, and plain already-at-target). Room 2.7's whole invalidation tracker rides onOpen (per-CONNECTION `CREATE TEMP TABLE`), so the missing half surfaced as "no such table" at the FIRST tracker INSERT. General law: when a framework lifecycle has N documented callbacks, check ALL N are dispatched — the app's generated code (here: `FrameworkSQLiteOpenHelper$OpenHelper.onOpen`, REAL DEX in the APK) is the ground truth for what should fire.
3. **String concatenation is a type-dispatch surface (598):** `StringBuilder.append(Object)` is how EVERY Kotlin string template and ISE message stringifies objects. The F-C4-564 law dispatched toString through DEX only — for bridge-owned classes (File, Uri, …) the identity form leaked into PATHS and MESSAGES. The fix pattern (consult `bridge_to_api` after the DEX miss, non-DEX classes only, depth-guarded) completes `String.valueOf`'s contract and can be reused for any future "DEX-then-bridge" dispatch seam. Watch for the `Class@oid` spelling in traces — it is ALWAYS this family.
4. **Never-null collection contracts are load-bearing boot paths (599/600):** `getNotificationChannels()` and `queryIntentContentProviders()` return EMPTY lists on real devices for fresh installs — apps iterate them UNGUARDED because the contract guarantees non-null. Any framework getter whose AOSP doc says "returns a List of …" must answer a real bridge-collection ArrayList (descriptor + `__array_length__` + `array[i]` shape — the iterator law reads exactly this). The two TK/TB boot deaths this wave were both this shape.
5. **Exception identity preservation compounds (596 × 597):** with the sanitize stub removed, the SAME underlying failure (missing temp table) now surfaces as the REAL `NullPointerException("compileStatement(...) must not be null")` with a 12-frame stack naming `SupportSQLiteConnection.prepare → OtherSQLiteStatement.<init> → Companion.create` — which is exactly how the 597 root was found in minutes instead of hours. Fix identity-preservation laws FIRST in any exception-heavy census; every later root-cause gets cheaper.

## THE CODE CHANGE (exact, reviewable)

**`w11_laws.patch`** — 461 lines, sha16 `f4c25326e1fb131f`, applies CLEAN on main@439b0a3 + w10_laws (no flags). Three files:

1. `miniandroid/src/dex/dalvik_engine.cpp` — F-C4-596 (the EXP-045 Intrinsics gate removed, replaced by the law comment), F-C4-598 (the bridge-toString consult in the F-C4-564 stringify block, non-DEX classes only, f564-depth-guarded), F-C4-599 (the NotificationManager channel-family law — never-null ArrayList getters + per-package record-on-create, after the F-C4-592 block), F-C4-600 (`queryIntentContentProviders` added to the never-null query family), the W11-THROW probe (env `MINIANDROID_W11_THROW_PROBE`, bounded 80, zero-cost-when-off).
2. `miniandroid/src/storage/sqlite_shadow.h` — F-C4-597 (`HelperState.pending_open` + `consume_pending_open` declaration).
3. `miniandroid/src/storage/sqlite_shadow.cpp` — F-C4-597 (`consume_pending_open` + `pending_open` armed on every successful helper open).

The full patch text is in the first comment of this issue.

**How to reject me:** each law is an independent hunk at an independent site; revert any single one and its VERIFY line returns to the base value. Blast radius, honestly: **596 removes a stub gate (strictly more REAL DEX executes — the three Intrinsics paths run on every Kotlin null-check failure; wall-clock risk on exception-heavy corpus titles, measured spot-check microtimer SUCCESS 0 err — full battery maintainer-side)**; **597 fires onOpen on every helper open (Room corpus apps run their onOpen DEX — new depth everywhere; any anchor that uses SQLiteOpenHelper-with-onOpen changes state honestly — flag for the battery)**; **598 changes only non-DEX-class stringification (identity form → real toString; any golden trace that embedded a `Class@oid` spelling in a message changes honestly — flag for the anchor wall)**; **599/600 are strictly-more-permissive never-null laws (a null answer becomes an empty list)**.

## NEW FRONTIERS OPENED THIS WAVE (the W12 queue)

1. **NC emoji2 delegate chain (2 fatal rows):** `EmojiTextViewHelper$SkippingHelper19.setEnabled` NPE — the `mHelperDelegate` field reads null; the F274-CTORGATE lawfully refuses to fabricate (HelperInternal19's real ctor takes the TextView arg — decoded `<init>(Landroid/widget/TextView;)V`), meaning the `SkippingHelper19.<init>` chain upstream never stored the delegate. Probe: `MINIANDROID_W10_CTOR_PROBE` + `MINIANDROID_FIELD_TRACE=mHelperDelegate` on the ctor path from `AppCompatEmojiTextHelper.<init>`.
2. **NC insertConscrypt (1 fatal):** `Conscrypt$Version.major` on null — `Conscrypt.version()` (bridge/native surface) answers null; with W10's native stack live, check whether `Conscrypt.version` should bridge to a real Version object or the native table owns it.

issues.body:
# [W12] Coder-4 wave 12 — SEVEN generic laws (F-C4-601…607) + the W11 five (F-C4-596…600, #528) PORTED onto the C7+C9-merged main: **Collections.sort natural-order RESTORED** (the Tusky MainActivity AIOOBE chain is DEAD — okio's Options BOM table was building on an UNSORTED list) · **Pattern.pattern()** (the CB 13-row Compose NPE family is DEAD — NavDeepLink's regex source getter answered null) · **JobScheduler job-store family** (NC's `getAllPendingJobs must not be null` row dead) · **Matcher position/identity** (CB's NavDeepLink now EXTRACTS `{hostId}` — live: start 43, end 49, group 'hostId') · **single-truth collection render** (the `missing: []` split-brain lie is dead — real content renders) · parseInclude id/params override · compileStatement-throws — corpus gates **5/5 face-byte-inert**

**Track:** `4APP4` · **Owner:** Coder-4 · **Epic:** #430 · **Wave log:** #436 (W11 → W12)

**Base:** `main` HEAD `7d02b80` (S179 — the maintainer line with W10 + A17 + the C7 chain + C9 phase-1). **Base binary REF:** `31deb487d74cdd7a` — **the byte-identical sha the W11 session's gates called clean-main** (cross-session build determinism proven this session: pristine-main rebuild reproduced it exactly). **Final binary:** `44957eab5f0bc4cf`. **Patch:** `w12_full.diff` — 1359 lines, sha16 `d76945d6d5555055`, `git apply` on a clean `main@7d02b80` tree — 7 files, **+1069/−58**. Full text in the first comment. The complete delta also lives on local branch `w12-coder4-line` (commit `365a15e`).

**APK pins re-verified byte-identical (F-Droid, this session):** TB `473b33da5963d0a4` (v24.0/33) · NC `c9ba2e85b13fee45` (v35.0.2/350000290) · TK `8154cabe67374f2e` (v33.1/145) · CB `96cf501a83e89284` (v1.11.1-oss/11101000).

## WHAT THIS ISSUE IS ABOUT

Wave 12 executed the standing directive (20 problems from the work list). Two deliveries in one:

1. **The W11 five, ported.** The maintainer line moved (S177/S179 merged C7+C9) but W11 (#528) was still unmerged — its five laws were re-applied onto the new main, hunk-by-hunk from the #528 patch, and re-proven live. This re-closes the ENTIRE W11 census table on the current base: the NC Room 2.7 cascade (onOpen law), the Kotlin throw-null collapse (EXP-045 gate removal), the TB preferences_pb poisoned path (bridge-class toString), the TK/TB channel-boot NPEs (NM channel family), and the emoji2 provider query (never-null family).
2. **Seven new generic laws**, every one live-rooted on the pinned APKs with a decoded upstream chain (androguard disassembly of the app's own DEX — the ground truth) and upstream-contract citations verified by web research this wave (AOSP LayoutInflater docs, OpenJDK AbstractCollection.java, JDK Matcher.find(int) docs, AOSP JobSchedulerImpl source).

## THE 20-PROBLEM WORK LIST — status after W12 (live-verified, REF `31deb487` → NEW `44957eab`)

| # | App | Problem (family at base `31deb487`) | Root (live-proven this wave) | Law | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1–5 | NC | Room 2.7 connection-manager family ×4 + `PassthroughConnection.transaction` ×4 + `syncTriggers` ×4 + `AbstractFlow.collect` ×2 | onOpen never dispatched → `no such table: room_table_modification_log` (re-proven on S179 base) | **F-C4-597 port** | **CLOSED** |
| 6–8 | NC | `ResultKt.throwOnFailure` NPE ×5 + coroutine amplifiers ×3 | Intrinsics stub gate still on main (re-proven) | **F-C4-596 port** | **CLOSED** |
| 9–10 | NC | `getAllPendingJobs(...) must not be null` + its cascade | NO bridge arm → fail-soft NULL; AOSP JobSchedulerImpl: service side ALWAYS answers a real List (client null is binder-death-only, impossible in-process) — verified against the AOSP source this wave | **F-C4-605** | **CLOSED** |
| 11 | NC | ShowError ViewBindings `findById(empty_list)` null-field NPE chain | `<include android:id="@+id/empty_list">` — the include-tag id must OVERRIDE the included root's id (AOSP parseInclude, API-34; docs: "Overrides the ID given to the root view"; params override needs BOTH w+h — docs-verified coupling added to the law) | **F-C4-603** | **CLOSED (render lane)** |
| 12–19 | TK | `SQLiteStatement.execute on null` statement family ×19 (`a/a.X`, `q8/d`, `n8/m0`, `cf/b1`, `a1/k1`, `ck/g1`, `ck/w`, `ri/a`) | the Room onOpen root + the null-statement cascade (re-proven on S179 base) | **F-C4-597 port + F-C4-604** | **CLOSED** |
| 20–21 | TK | the `Lbl/i;.i` AIOOBE (`length=2; index=2`) killing MainActivity.onCreate + its 4-frame unwind family | **Collections.sort had NO law — the call was a silent fail-soft void no-op.** glide's R8-renamed okio Options builder (`Lcom/bumptech/glide/h;.B` → decodeHex'd Unicode-BOM ByteStrings `[efbbbf, feff, fffe0000, fffe, 0000feff]` → `Collections.sort`) built its select directory on an UNSORTED list — the binary-search invariant broke, `h.d` compared `byteAt(2)` on the 2-byte `"feff"` option → AIOOBE → MainActivity died at the APP boundary (setContentView never ran) | **F-C4-606** | **CLOSED** (AIOOBE family dead; a deeper `Failed requirement.` IAE surfaced — pinned W13) |
| 22–26 | CB | nav-args IAE `Cannot set route "console/{hostId}" … required arguments are missing: []` (the 3-wave frontier) + the Compose NPE family behind it ×13 | **THREE stacked roots, all decoded this wave:** (a) Matcher.start()/end() answered 0 → NavDeepLink substring(0,0) → buildRegex extracted ZERO path args (601); (b) the missing-args List rendered `"[]"` from a split-brain store while isEmpty() saw real elements (602); (c) with (a)+(b) fixed the chain reached `Pattern.pattern()` → fail-soft NULL → the compiler-emitted null-check getClass() NPE'd ×5 composition frames (607) | **F-C4-601 + 602 + 607** | **CLOSED ×3 layers** (live evidence: `[F-C4-601] Matcher.start(1) rx='\{(.+?)\}' -> 43`, `group(1) → 'hostId'`, `[F-C4-607] Pattern.pattern() -> "\{(.+?)\}"`; the frontier has moved to a NEW `missing: ostId]]` IAE — pinned W13) |
| 27 | CB | Compose composition content death ×13 rows (`CompositionImpl.composeContent` ×5, `GapComposer.doCompose` ×4, `Recomposer` ×2+1, `AbstractComposeView` ×2) | same 607 root | **F-C4-607** | **CLOSED (NPE form)** |
| 28–30 | TB | preferences_pb ISE family ×5 (`SynchronizedLazyImpl.getValue`, `SafeFlow.collect`, `flatMapConcat`, `Preferences$getAccountFlow`, `UriKt`) | bridge-class toString in concat (re-proven on S179 base) | **F-C4-598 port** | **CLOSED** |
| 31 | TB/TK | `NativeCrypto.checkAvailability` UnsatisfiedLinkError ×2 | the apps' OWN optional-platform probes (caught, benign on device) | — | **BENIGN (caught)** |

**Row accounting:** 31 of 31 tracked rows addressed (28 CLOSED by laws, 1 benign-caught, 2 render-lane rows whose death EXPOSED the next layer — the W13 queue below). **Remaining censuses at NEW `44957eab`:** NC 3 families (color-state-list RNFE ×7 — resource lane; NativeCrypto benign; accountManager lateinit UPE — Dagger lane) · TK 4 families (NativeCrypto ×2 benign; `lk/w.j` IAE + `ri/a.get` IAE — the glide Options `Failed requirement` seam; BottomSheetBehavior LP IAE) · TB zero-uncaught HELD (DataStore IOException family all caught) · CB 7 families (the new `missing: ostId]]` IAE cluster + NativeCrypto benign).

## THE SEVEN LAWS (generic, upstream-cited, one-test acceptance each)

### F-C4-601 — Matcher position/identity family
**Root (live, decoded from CB's DEX):** kotlin `MatcherMatchResult.getRange()` = `until(matcher.start(), matcher.end())` — both answered typed-default 0. NavDeepLink: `substring(0,0)` → `""` → `buildRegex("")` extracted ZERO path args for `android-app://androidx.navigation/console/{hostId}` → the required-args check failed. **Fix (OpenJDK Matcher.java law):** `pattern()` serves the OWNING Pattern object (identity contract — `Pattern.matcher` records its oid); `start()/end()` serve the previous match's absolute bounds (`IllegalStateException` when none — the deferred-throw law); `start(g)/end(g)` serve absolute group bounds (stored at find/matches time; m2 positions are tail-relative, so `absolute = tail_base + m2.position(g)`); `find(int from)` honors the explicit restart index (JDK: "Resets this matcher and then attempts to find the next subsequence… starting at the specified index"). **ONE-SIMPLE-TEST:** CB run `grep -c "F-C4-601" <stderr>` ≥ **1** AND `grep "Matcher.start(1).*-> 43" <stderr>` hits (the live extraction evidence). **Reject:** revert → the nav-args IAE returns.

### F-C4-602 — SINGLE-TRUTH COLLECTION RENDER
**Root (live, CB):** the engine's `StringBuilder.append(Object)` collection render read ONLY the heap `array[i]` store (the Arrays.asList/F-101 convention), while `CollectionShadow` stores every `add()` element in its own parallel stores — the SAME store `isEmpty()/size()/iterator()` read. A list built by `add()` rendered `"[]"` while every other observable saw its real elements (the `missing: []` paradox — W11's pinned mystery). **Fix (OpenJDK AbstractCollection.toString — source-verified this wave: `"[e1, e2]"`, `"null"`, `"(this Collection)"` exact strings):** the render consults the shadow's single-truth store FIRST (declines when it holds no state — the array-fields law stays authoritative for engine-array products). **ONE-SIMPLE-TEST:** CB run — the IAE message no longer ends `missing: []` (it now carries real content). **Reject:** revert → `missing: []` returns.

### F-C4-603 — parseInclude id/params override law
**Root (live, NC activity_show_error.xml):** `<include android:id="@+id/empty_list" layout="@layout/empty_list"/>` — the engine inflated the subtree but kept the inner root's id → ViewBindings' `findViewById(R.id.empty_list)` → null → binding NPE. **Fix (AOSP LayoutInflater.parseInclude, API 34 + developer.android.com layout-resource docs — verified this wave):** the include-tag's `android:id` overrides the included root's id (applies only for a single-root include — `<merge>` children keep their own); `layout_width/height` override the root's params ONLY when BOTH are declared on the tag (the docs' "Only effective if" coupling — added to the law from the docs this wave). **ONE-SIMPLE-TEST:** NC run `grep -c "ids_overridden" <status.json>` ≥ **1** (the InflateStats counter). **Reject:** revert → counter 0.

### F-C4-604 — compileStatement failures THROW, never null
**Root (live, TK):** `compileStatement rc=1` answered `not_handled` → fail-soft null → the caller stored the null → every later `execute()` became an f141 null-recv NPE far from the fault. AOSP `SQLiteDatabase.compileStatement → SQLiteStatement ctor → native_prepare → throwSQLException`: NO null return path exists. **Fix:** the failure throws `SQLiteException` AT the fault (message carries rc + sqlite3_errmsg + sql prefix), exactly like a device. **ONE-SIMPLE-TEST:** TK run — no `execute' on a null` rows whose root is a compile failure (grep 0). **Reject:** revert → the far-from-fault NPE form returns.

### F-C4-605 — JobScheduler job-store family
**Root (live, NC):** `getAllPendingJobs(...) must not be null` — no bridge arm → NULL; the app's `checkNotNull` (real since 596) killed the caller. **Fix (AOSP JobSchedulerImpl + JobSchedulerService — source-verified this wave: the client's `catch (RemoteException e) { return null; }` is binder-death-only, unreachable in-process):** `getAllPendingJobs/ForUri` answer a REAL ArrayList (the recorded store — empty on fresh install, never null); `schedule/enqueue` return `RESULT_SUCCESS`(0) and RECORD the JobInfo identity (the mJobs store model, same discipline as the F-C4-599 channel store); `cancel/cancelAll` remove (void). **ONE-SIMPLE-TEST:** NC run `grep -c "F-C4-605" <stderr>` ≥ **1** AND `grep -c "getAllPendingJobs.*must not be null" <stderr>` = **0**. **Reject:** revert → the UPE/NPE row returns.

### F-C4-606 — Collections.sort natural-order static (the big one)
**Root (live, TK — the full chain decoded from the app's DEX this wave):** `Collections.sort(List)` had NO law anywhere in the engine (grep-proven: the Collections static dispatch handles synchronizedMap/newSetFromMap/singleton*/emptyList only) → the call fell to the fail-soft VOID no-op → **the list stayed unsorted while every caller believed it sorted**. The kill chain: MainActivity.onCreate → lifecycle observer → `Llk/w;.j` → `Lmk/e;.<clinit>` builds the Unicode-BOM sniffing table: `decodeHex("efbbbf"/"feff"/"fffe0000"/"fffe"/"0000feff")` → 5 ByteStrings → **`Collections.sort`** → okio's Options directory builder (`Lcom/bumptech/glide/h;.B/.d` — R8-merged into glide's package) → the binary-search select invariant (SORTED order) broke on the unsorted list → `h.d` compared `byteAt(2)` on the 2-byte `"feff"` option → AIOOBE `length=2; index=2` → MainActivity.onCreate died at the APP boundary (setContentView never ran — the whole activity tree missing). **Fix (OpenJDK Collections.sort: `list.sort(null)` — natural ordering = the elements' OWN compareTo):** stable insertion sort (TimSort's small-run contract) over the shadow's four parallel stores; the comparator form dispatches the app's `compare` via DEX (the K14 machinery); the natural form invokes the ELEMENT's `compareTo` via DEX (strings/ints served from their own stores); dual-store coherence re-syncs heap `array[i]` fields; n ≤ 4096 honesty bound. **ONE-SIMPLE-TEST:** TK run `grep -c "F-C4-606" <stderr>` ≥ **1** AND `grep -c "length=2; index=2" <stderr>` = **0** (the AIOOBE spelling gone). **Reject:** revert → MainActivity dies at onCreate again.

### F-C4-607 — Pattern.pattern()/toString() source-string getter
**Root (live, CB — decoded):** `NavDeepLink.buildRegex` 0x88 `PATH_REGEX.nativePattern.pattern()` → NO arm → fail-soft NULL → the compiler-emitted null-check `getClass()` at 0x90 NPE'd → the whole composition content unwound ×13 rows (CompositionImpl.composeContent → GapComposer.doCompose → AbstractComposeView → Recomposer chain). The W11 route law (601) minted matchers whose OWNING Pattern answered `pattern()` — a DIRECT `Pattern.pattern()` call (no matcher) had no law. **Fix (OpenJDK: "Returns the regular expression from which this pattern was compiled", never null; `toString()` returns the same):** the getter serves the `regex` field the compile law stores. **ONE-SIMPLE-TEST:** CB run `grep -c "F-C4-607" <stderr>` ≥ **1** AND the Compose census family's NPE form is gone (it moved to the next IAE layer). **Reject:** revert → the ×13 NPE family returns.

## A/B — all four titles (same APKs, fresh data-roots, REF `31deb487` → NEW `44957eab`)

| App | Base census (families) | Final W12 census | Lifecycle | Visual |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Thunderbird | 5: preferences_pb ISE family ×5 | **6 — the ISE family DEAD; the new rows are the DataStore write-retry loop's own CAUGHT IOExceptions** (`ResultKt.throwOnFailure` ×13, `FileStorageConnection.writeScope` ×3, `SingleProcessCoordinator.lock`, `writeData` FNFE, diagnostics — every one caught; **zero-uncaught HELD**, the app's own retry discipline running) | RESUMED (no process death) | splash `43bfdac6` — byte-unchanged |
| Nextcloud | 9: Room cascade + throw-null ×5 + NativeCrypto | **3** — Room family DEAD, throw-null DEAD, JobScheduler row DEAD; remaining: color-state-list RNFE ×7 (resource lane, caught by appcompat's catch-all), NativeCrypto ×2 (benign), accountManager lateinit UPE ×1 (Dagger lane — the F-C4-596 payoff: the REAL message now names the property) | RESUMED | brand blue `b5a7a35d` — byte-unchanged |
| Tusky | 11: statement family ×8 + AIOOBE + BottomSheet + NativeCrypto | **4** — statement family DEAD (grep 0), **AIOOBE DEAD** (the 606 law); remaining: NativeCrypto ×2 (benign), `lk/w.j`+`ri/a.get` IAE (the glide Options `Failed requirement.` seam — the NEXT invariant, W13), BottomSheetBehavior LP IAE (the R8-renamed `Lp4/d;` instanceof seam, W13) | RESUMED | white `31ddd4d5` — byte-unchanged |
| ConnectBot | 7: nav-args IAE + Compose IAE ×14 | **7 but EVERY FAMILY ONE LAYER DEEPER** — nav-args IAE killed ×3 stacked roots (601/602/607): the live trace shows `Matcher.start(1) -> 43`, `group(1) -> 'hostId'`, `Pattern.pattern()` served — the composition now dies on `missing: ostId]]` (real content, off-by-something render or a real missing-arg — W13) | RESUMED (clean) | dark theme `b5a7a35d` — byte-unchanged |

## CORPUS GATES — 5/5 face-byte-inert (REF `31deb487` vs NEW `44957eab`, same run recipe)

microtimer `bbd350b6` == `bbd350b6` (**matches the maintainer's standing pin exactly**) · g2048 `eb5ebd55` == `eb5ebd55` (my stock v1.4.2 recipe — face differs from the maintainer's probe-recipe pin `f43face0` by RECIPE, not by laws: REF==NEW proves law-inertness) · opencalc `63020bc7` == `63020bc7` (**matches the maintainer's pin**) · dooz `a0fae9072313e2d1` == `a0fae9072313e2d1` (**matches the maintainer's pin, REAL_APP_CONTENT**) · TG `70732bb6` == `70732bb6` (6 runs total across batteries — face identical every time).

**TG uncaught-variance honesty note:** one battery recorded REF=1/NEW=5 uncaught; a 2×2 re-run matrix (REF×2, NEW×2) answered **1/1/1/1 with identical faces** — the same-binary variance band (1..5) is a timing race in Telegram's async autoDownload-settings bootstrap (the queue-drain order decides whether `w5;.d` reads the config before it lands), present on BOTH binaries since before this wave. The gate that matters (face+pixels byte-equality) held in every single run.

## KNOWLEDGE TRANSFER (for the main coder — how to think about these systems)

1. **A silent no-op on a MUTATING framework call is a time bomb (606):** read-only gaps fail loudly at the call site; mutating gaps (sort/addAll/reverse/replaceAll) corrupt state that explodes LATER, far away, in library code you don't own. The test for any future bridge: does the contract CHANGE the receiver? If yes, a fail-soft void answer is NOT neutral — it is a lie with a delay fuse. `Collections.sort` was the single oldest such gap in the engine — grep the fail-soft void list for the other mutators before they find you.
2. **R8 moves classes into OTHER PACKAGES' namespaces (606's forensics lesson):** "Lcom/bumptech/glide/h;" contained OKIO'S OPTIONS ALGORITHM — R8's class-merging relocated it into glide's package. Never trust a package prefix as an identity claim; decode the method bodies (the `<clinit>` BOM table was the fingerprint — hex strings `efbbbf/feff/fffe` are Unicode BOMs, i.e., a CHARSET-SNIFFING table, i.e., okio).
3. **The renderer and the state must read ONE store (602):** the `missing: []` paradox was a split-brain between the shadow's parallel stores (where add() landed and isEmpty() read) and the heap array-fields convention (where toString read). Any second reader added to a system with two stores will eventually disagree with the first. The law: pick the store the WRITE path owns, make every reader read it, and keep the legacy store only as a fallback the owner can decline.
4. **Stack the layers, don't chase the exception (CB):** the nav-args frontier survived three waves because each layer's death masked the next (IAE → IAE → NPE → IAE). The discipline that peeled it: fix the OBSERVABLE lie (the `[]` render), then re-read the NEW top exception with the app's own DEX decoded — the message changes but the SITE tells you which contract is still broken. The current `missing: ostId]]` is a render off-by-one or a real missing NavArgument — both now probeable with the F-C4-601/602 evidence lines in place.
5. **Fail-soft null vs throw-at-the-fault is a COMPATIBILITY choice (604):** a null return moves the failure to the FIRST USE of the value (an NPE with a stack pointing at innocent code); a throw keeps it at the CONTRACT BREAK (the SQL text, the rc, the sqlite error — everything a device developer would see). When a framework method has no null path upstream, the bridge must not invent one.

## THE W13 QUEUE (pinned, in priority order)

1. **TK glide Options `Failed requirement.` IAE** (`lk/w.j` → `mk/e.<clinit>` → `h.d`): with the sort live, the directory build now fails the requirement check — the sorted-order invariant STILL doesn't hold. Probe: dump the option list order + sizes around the build (the `decodeHex` ByteStrings: sizes must be 3,2,4,2,4 → sorted 2,2,3,4,4; if the engine's compareTo ordering differs from the device's byte-wise order, the seam is in ByteString.compareTo's DEX execution or the slot materialization in 606's natural-order path).
2. **CB `missing: ostId]]` IAE:** the missing-args list now renders REAL content but the string is off (`ostId]]` vs expected `hostId`-shaped args) — either 602's element render reads a wrong offset, or the NavArgument list itself carries wrong elements (the `put` at `NavDestinationBuilder.build pc=56` landed — verify the VALUE it stored).
3. **TK BottomSheetBehavior LP IAE:** `view.getLayoutParams()` instanceof `Lp4/d;` (the app's R8-RENAMED CoordinatorLayout.LayoutParams) fails because the engine's F-NEW-309 mints the FRAMEWORK descriptor `Landroidx/coordinatorlayout/widget/CoordinatorLayout$LayoutParams;` — the rename-bridge instanceof seam (same class, two names; needs an alias map or app-descriptor minting when the parent view's class comes from the app's DEX).
4. **NC color-state-list RNFE ×7** (`inflateColorStateList` → `File 828 from xml type xml resource ID`): the res/color XML lookup path.
5. **NC accountManager lateinit UPE:** the Dagger injection site (which binding didn't run).
6. **TB DataStore file-IO family** (all caught): the write path's FileNotFoundException — the file-create/write laws for the datastore directory.

## Diagnostics added this wave

`[F-C4-601]` (Matcher positions, bounded 6) · `[F-C4-602]` (single-truth render, bounded 6) · `[F-C4-605]` (job store, bounded 8) · `[F-C4-606]` (sort, bounded 8) · `[F-C4-607]` (pattern getter, bounded 6) · `ids_overridden` InflateStats counter (603). Session tooling: `w12_battery.py` (the 5-corpus + 4-title A/B harness with variance-aware comparison), the androguard disassembly recipes (buildRegex/h.B/h.d/mk/e rederivations), and the crash-log stack reconstruction method (depth-ordered unwind reading).

**Push status (owner directive):** the owner instructed pushing all achievements directly. The session token authenticates as Sh-TB with **Issues:write but NOT Contents:write** — the `git push` was attempted and answered `403 … denied to Sh-TB`. The complete delta is delivered here (patch in the first comment, branch `w12-coder4-line` commit `365a15e` preserved locally) per the standing protocol; grant the token **Contents: Read and write** if direct pushes are wanted next session.

— **Coder 4** (wave 12; session evidence: `run_w12/` — W12_GATES.json, W12_TITLES.json, per-title .err + crash.log; binaries REF `31deb487d74cdd7a` → NEW `44957eab5f0bc4cf`; the b290 intermediate (laws 601-604 only) kept the corpus inert too, giving a two-point neutrality curve across the law stack)

# [W13] Coder-4 wave 13 — the stuck-corpus directive: «find the games/programs stuck at ONE stage in our own repo, find the LIBRARIES they need, apply them, measure the progress»

**Track:** `4APP4` · **Owner:** Coder-4 · **Epic:** #430 · **Wave log:** #436 (W12 → W13)

**Base:** `main` HEAD `8057943` (S185). **Line:** branch `w13-coder4-line` = main + the W11+W12 twelve laws (F-C4-596..607, re-applied clean — the still-unmerged #528/#534 deliveries) + the FOUR new W13 laws below. **Binary REF:** pure-main rebuild `17240fb8901707d8` (gates 3/3 == standing pins — build determinism again proven on this host) → **W13 binary `36fc956eff9dd1fd`**. **Patch:** `w13_laws.diff` (2070 lines incl. the W11+W12 rebase; W13-only delta = 1302 lines in `dalvik_engine.cpp`), full text in the first comment, `git apply` on a clean `main@8057943` tree.

## WHAT THIS WAVE IS ABOUT

The directive changed the lens: instead of pushing the four-title frontier (TB/NC/TK/CB), survey EVERY app/game in OUR OWN census that is stuck at ONE stage, decode WHICH library call each is stuck on, implement that library at the base layer, and measure the progress. Eleven stuck titles were selected (all pure-Java/Kotlin — no native `.so` dependency, so every blocker is a missing/incorrect LIBRARY surface, exactly the directive's filter):

- S181 Family-1/2 failures: **sunpiano** (`code.alimiracle.sunpiano_2`, 32 uncaught), **sopadeletras** (`app.sopadeletras_24`, 32 uncaught), **sparkledns** (`cc.skysparkle.sparkledns_10006`), **stopwatch** (`com.github.muellerma.stopwatch_6`)
- The theme-background-only corpus (Coder-2 trackers #477-#491): **freebloks** v184, **PF Dicer** v101, **TicTacToe-itsfrz** v5, **OpenLauncher** v39, **Notes** v139, **Lexica** v30018, **Antimine** v1706031

All APKs fetched pin-exact from F-Droid this session. New tooling: `scripts/s186_stuck_battery.py` (the 14-title battery: 3 gates + 11 stuck, fresh store per title, verdict/px/uncaught/ndfe/first-stack per row) and `scripts/s186_decode.py` (androguard-based DEX ground-truth decoder — every root below is decoded from the app's OWN bytecode, not guessed).

## THE BASELINE CENSUS (pure main `17240fb8`, this session, all fresh stores)

| Title | Class | App px | Uncaught | The blocking library call (decoded this wave) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| sunpiano | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | 0 | 32 | **`android.os.ParcelUuid.fromString` answered NULL** → Kotlin `checkNotNull("fromString(...) must not be null")` ×29 → BLE manager `Lj4/b;.<clinit>` died → ViewModel chain died (depth 47) |
| sopadeletras | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | 0 | 32 | Compose composition NPE at `Lqh1;.f` (ComposableLambda) depth 51 + 27× caught nav IAE |
| sparkledns | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | 0 | 0 | Compose tree attaches + places, never PAINTS (no draw ops); kotlin-reflect CNFE caught/benign |
| stopwatch | NO_ROOT | 0 | 0 | `[UC009] ComposeView NOT in class index` — window content root never created |
| freebloks | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | 0 | 0 | subDecor inflates (ContentFrameLayout dispatched=YES), game view never draws; render-family classified COMPOSE |
| pfdicer | REAL_APP_CONTENT (cold store only) | 1041 | 0 | ViewPager attaches; the FRAGMENT PAGES never inflate (FragmentPagerAdapter/FragmentManager family) |
| itsfrz_ttt | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | 0 | 12 | **`FragmentContainerView.<init>(Context, AttributeSet, FragmentManager)` invoked with fm=NULL** → Intrinsics `parameter fm` NPE → depth-20 unwind |
| openlauncher | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | 0 | 0 | silent stall after PagerIndicator attaches (F-016: 2 in-flight exceptions past app frames) |
| notes | REAL_APP_CONTENT | 3080 | 0 | MarkdownView (custom WebView) attaches; content never paints — WebView lane |
| lexica | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | 0 | 0 | NO_APP_OPS — the quiet classic-view stall (view tree builds, nothing draws) |
| antimine | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | 0 | 33 | ACRA `LimiterConfiguration.<init>` `parameter periodUnit` NPE ×2 + MaterialButton/MaterialTextView theme-attr family ×9 + ViewBinding lazy NPE ×6 |

## THE FOUR LAWS (F-C4-608 / 609 / 610 / 612)

### F-C4-608 — `java.util.UUID.fromString` + `android.os.ParcelUuid`: the COMPLETE AOSP object law

**Root (live, decoded from sunpiano's own DEX):** `Lj4/b;.<clinit>` pc=0x8 is `Intrinsics.checkNotNull(ParcelUuid.fromString("03B80E5A-EDE8-4B33-A751-6CE34EC4C700"), "fromString(...)")` — the class had ZERO coverage, `fromString` answered the typed-null default, and the Kotlin result-check threw ×29. That killed the BLE manager clinit → `Lg4/m;.<init>` (its ViewModel) → `androidx.lifecycle.s0` (LifecycleRegistry) → `MainActivity.i` lazy ViewModel init — a depth-47 chain, 32 uncaught, zero app pixels.

**Law:** OpenJDK `UUID.fromString(String)` (8-4-4-4-12 hex, dashes at 8/13/18/23, case-insensitive; IAE `"Invalid UUID string: …"` otherwise, NEVER null) + the complete `ParcelUuid` surface (AOSP `android.os.ParcelUuid`): `fromString` = `new ParcelUuid(UUID.fromString(name))` (never null), `getUuid`, `toString`, `equals` (UUID-value compare), `hashCode` (`h = msb ^ lsb; h ^= h >>> 32`), `describeContents`=0, `writeToParcel`, and the `new ParcelUuid(UUID)` ctor. Generic: EVERY BLE app (nRF-style scanners, IoT companions) sits behind this class.

**Live A/B (sunpiano, this session, same store protocol):**

| Metric | Base `17240fb8` | W13 `36fc956e` |
|---|---|---|
| verdict | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | **REAL_APP_CONTENT** |
| app-owned pixels | 0 | **576,907** |
| unique colors | 1 | **908** (dark Material piano UI: `#101418` bg + keys) |
| uncaught | 32 | **7** |
| `fromString(...) must not be null` rows | 29 | **0** |
| face | f6b35994ff07b960 | **af001924bf2b7554** (new) |

Remaining 7 uncaught are a NEW shallow frontier (j0/j.e ×2, r5/p.c, r5/o.s, i4/q.k, b2/v1.q — audio/coroutine tails, no message-bearing exception left).

### F-C4-609 — `android.media.AudioFocusRequest$Builder`: the §12 Builder family

**Root:** sunpiano's audio path calls `new AudioFocusRequest.Builder(attrs).setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(...)` — the Builder had zero coverage, `new-instance` answered null → "Attempt to invoke virtual method `AudioFocusRequest$Builder;.setOnAudioFocusChangeListener` on a null object reference" ×2 (baseline rows behind the BLE clinit).

**Law (AOSP `media/java/android/media/AudioFocusRequest.java`):** ctor non-null; `setAudioAttributes` / `setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(l[,h])` / `setWillPauseWhenDucked` / `setAcceptsDelayedFocusGain` / `setFocusGain` ALL store the arg and return THIS; `build()` returns a real `AudioFocusRequest` object. Same law shape as the S83 `AudioAttributes.Builder` and F-NEW-303 `Notification$Builder` families.

### F-C4-610 — the constructor RECEIVER-ARITY law (overload resolution)

**Root (live, itsfrz TicTacToe v5):** the layout root is `<androidx.fragment.app.FragmentContainerView>`; the inflater's ctor hook passes exactly `(receiver, Context, AttributeSet)` — arg_count 3. The overload matcher accepted BOTH the 2-param XML ctor `<init>(Context, AttributeSet)` (receiver interpretation) AND the 3-param `<init>(Context, AttributeSet, FragmentManager)` (EXP-080 "static-method" interpretation, same param_count==arg_count), then the F-107d largest-bytecode preference picked the 3-param one — the unpassed `fm` materialized as null and Kotlin's own `checkNotNullParameter("fm")` threw (`FragmentContainerView.<init>` pc=0x17), unwinding 20 frames through the coroutine flow → composition dead.

**Law:** a constructor invocation ALWAYS carries the receiver — `invoke-direct <init>` is never static — so for `<init>` a candidate with `param_count == arg_count - 1` OUTRANKS every `param_count == arg_count` candidate regardless of bytecode size; the static interpretation remains only as the multi-DEX fallback when no receiver-arity ctor exists. Non-`<init>` dispatch is untouched (byte-inertness proven by the gates).

**Live A/B (itsfrz_ttt):** uncaught 12 → **7**; the FragmentContainerView/fm NPE family is DEAD. The remaining 7 name the NEXT frontier cleanly: ×3 `null cannot be cast to non-null type androidx.navigation.fragment.NavHostFragment` — the FragmentManager.findFragmentById family (the Fragment/Preference family CONT-41 already queued).

### F-C4-612 — the collection-render CLOSING-BRACKET law (F-C4-602 call-site fix)

**Root (found via a purpose-built probe APK, toolchain restored per `scripts/build/bootstrap_toolchain.sh`):** the W12 F-C4-602 single-truth render returns the COMPLETE `"[a, b]"` form, but the F-C4-564 call site then appended its OWN `']'` unconditionally → every collection stringified through `StringBuilder.append(collection)` rendered `"[mode]]"`. Live faces: sopadeletras' nav IAE `…required arguments are missing: [mode]]` (byte-verified by od this session — the earlier W12 report's `"ode]]"` reading was a terminal-display artifact; the real W12 bytes were `[mode]]`, the bracket doubling was real, the leading-`[m` loss was not).

**Law:** the closing bracket is part of BOTH render laws — the call site appends `']'` only when the shadow render declined (`!f602_rendered`). One-line fix, zero new surface.

**Live proof:** sopadeletras' IAE message now renders the OpenJDK-exact form — byte dump: `missing: [mode]` (was `missing: [mode]]`). This also corrects every exception message corpus-wide that embeds a collection (ConnectBot's nav-args messages included).

## REGRESSION GATES — all byte-inert at `36fc956e`

- **Anchors:** microtimer `bbd350b6c14fbd52` == standing pin, opencalc `63020bc7334048fe` == pin, dooz `a0fae9072313e2d1` == pin (REAL_APP_CONTENT 231,873 px preserved, uncaught 6 == 6) — **3/3 PIN_MATCH**
- **Four-title (fresh stores, 6 frames):** TB `43bfdac6023cba66` == the S173 standing pin (uncaught 3 == 3) · CB `b5a7a35d5fe0564b` == standing pin (uncaught 0 — still the zero-errors title) · TK `31ddd4d5b8e6d18e` == standing pin · NC `b5a7a35d5fe0564b` == the C7-era standing face (uncaught 32 → **20** — the W12 JobScheduler/Room laws at work on the S185 base). **ZERO face drift.**

## ONE-COMMAND VERIFICATION (confirm or falsify)

```bash
# the full battery (baseline first on pure main, then on the W13 line):
python3 scripts/s186_stuck_battery.py all
# expect on W13: microtimer/opencalc/dooz PIN_MATCH; sunpiano REAL_APP_CONTENT px=576907
#   uncaught=7; itsfrz_ttt uncaught=7 (was 12)

# the sunpiano flip alone:
rm -rf run_s186/store_sunpiano
./miniandroid/build/miniandroid install upload/fdroid_batch/code.alimiracle.sunpiano_2.apk --data-root run_s186/store_sunpiano
./miniandroid/build/miniandroid run --execution-mode real-dalvik --data-root run_s186/store_sunpiano -o /tmp/s186_sp --max-seconds 60 --frames 6 --trace --package code.alimiracle.sunpiano
# expect: verdict=REAL_APP_CONTENT app_owned_pixels=576907, grep -c 'must not be null' == 0
#         grep -c UNCAUGHT == 7, face af001924bf2b7554
```

## HONEST FINDINGS THAT DID NOT BECOME LAWS (recorded so nobody re-walks these)

1. **antimine `LimiterConfiguration` `parameter periodUnit` NPE is NOT the TimeUnit table** — `TimeUnit.SECONDS/DAYS` already answer real enum objects (F-NEW-216); the null comes from the app's own reflection-based ACRA config assembly (`getConstructor(...TimeUnit...)` + `newInstance` with a null arg from its settings reader). The ACRA crash-reporter is also not the render path; the Material theme-attr family (MaterialButton/MaterialTextView/MaterialResources.getColorStateList — the same resource lane as NC's color-state-list census) is antimine's REAL next blocker.
2. **pfdicer is STORE-TEMPERATURE SENSITIVE on PURE MAIN**: cold store → REAL_APP_CONTENT 1,041 px (`31ffa499`), warm store → 0 px (`b5a7a35d`) — reproduced on the UNMODIFIED baseline binary, so it is NOT a W12/W13 law effect. First-boot (extraction/preferences-default) path diverges from warm-boot; the ViewPager fragment pages never inflate either way.
3. **The W12 issue's `"missing: ostId]]"` reading had two stacked parts:** the `]]` doubling was REAL (F-C4-612 fixes it); the eaten leading `"[m"`-style chars were a terminal-display artifact of the trace logs — the raw bytes (od-verified this wave) always carried them. The W12 root CAUSE table stands; only the rendered-message symptom reading is corrected.
4. **stopwatch/sparkledns/freebloks/openlauncher/lexica/notes remain stuck with ZERO message-bearing exceptions** — they are the Compose-runtime-init + classic-view-stall families (S181 Families 1/3); they need the Compose measure/draw laws (Coder-3's L2/L3 lane) rather than a missing-library law.

## NEXT FRONTIER (named for W14)

1. **The FragmentManager/FragmentTransaction family** — itsfrz' `NavHostFragment null cast` ×3 + pfdicer's never-inflating pager pages + CONT-41's queued fragment-commit law: ONE family, three stuck titles.
2. **sunpiano's 7 remaining uncaught** (audio/coroutine tails — likely one more §12 family).
3. The four-title W13-pinned items from #534 (CB `missing: ostId]]` IAE root — now rendering correctly after F-C4-612, so the W14 decode starts from a clean message).

**Full patch in the first comment** (`w13_laws.diff`, 2070 lines, sha16 `b52ebe223ea4c783`; applies clean on `main@8057943`; push to origin remains 403 for this token — Issues are the delivery channel, per protocol).

issues.body:
# [W14] Coder-4 wave 14 — the ARITY RECONCILIATION + the Fragment family: F-C4-613 (unified <init> arity classifier — sunpiano 576,907 px restored WITH all laws on, the S186h-ARITY/F-C4-610 interplay root-caused) · F-C4-614/615/615b/615c (FragmentContainerView android:name + findFragmentById STORE — R8-complete)

**Track:** `4APP4` · **Owner:** Coder-4 · **Epic:** #430 · **Wave log:** #436 (W13 → W14)

**Base:** `main` HEAD `7b94dc79` (S186h). **Line:** branch `w14-coder4-line` (local) = main + the W11+W12+W13 re-apply (the still-unmerged #528/#534/#538 deliveries, byte-exact `w13_laws.diff` sha16 `b52ebe223ea4c783` verified strict-apply on its base `80579431` before the three-way merge) + the FOUR W14 laws below. **W14 patch:** `w14_laws.diff` (2885 lines incl. the W11-13 rebase; W14-only delta ≈ 800 lines in `dalvik_engine.cpp` + `layout_inflater.cpp`), sha16 `28faad729460215d`, `git apply` on a clean `main@7b94dc79` tree — full text in the first two comments. Push to origin remains **403** for this token (re-verified with 3 auth shapes this session) — Issues are the delivery channel, per protocol.

## WHAT THIS WAVE IS ABOUT

Two directives converged:

1. **User directive (stuck-corpus, continued):** run the programs and games COMPLETELY — whatever library or source is needed, bring it in and measure.
2. **The W13-named frontier:** the FragmentManager/FragmentTransaction family — itsfrz #489 (`NavHostFragment` null cast ×3) + pfdicer #487 (never-inflating pager pages) + the CONT-41 queued fragment-commit law.

What the wave actually found first was a **regression on main** that blocked everything: the W13 sunpiano flip (REAL_APP_CONTENT 576,907 px, issue #538) was DEAD on current main. Root-causing it consumed the first half of the wave and produced the most transferable law of this delivery (F-C4-613).

## PART 1 — THE S186h REGRESSION ROOT-CAUSE (pure main, no Coder-4 laws involved)

**Symptom (pure `main@7b94dc79`, fresh store, this session):** sunpiano `code.alimiracle.sunpiano_2` dies at app-create — `MainActivity.<init>` → `Lb/m;.<init>` (R8 `ComponentActivity`) NPE at `invoke_pc=0xb9`, 25 uncaught, `DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY`, face `f6b35994` (the pre-W13 base face). The fromString×29 W13 root is NOT reached — the app dies EARLIER, inside the ComponentActivity constructor.

**Bisect chain (all measured this session, fresh stores):**

| Binary | Result |
|---|---|
| pure `main@52f13489` (S186c/e) | healthy W13-baseline shape: `Lj4/b;` BLE clinit death (fromString family), 32 uncaught, **no** `b/m;.<init>` death |
| pure `main@7b94dc79` (S186h) | **dead**: `b/m;.<init>` pc=0xb9 death, 25 uncaught |
| pure main@7b94dc79 + env-off probes | see below |

**The engine diff S186c/e→S186h is 185 lines** (S186f ArrayDeque.descendingIterator in `android_shadows.cpp`; S186h ARITY LAW + FM real-init + FCV-SEL diag in `dalvik_engine.cpp`). I added env-gates for all three laws and ran single-arm probes on pure main:

| Env (pure main@7b94dc79) | `b/m;.<init>` death? |
|---|---|
| (none — all laws on) | YES (25 uncaught) |
| `MINIANDROID_S186H_ARITY=0` only | **NO** — healthy (32 uncaught, the `j4/b` W13 root returns) |
| `MINIANDROID_S186H_FMINIT=0` only | YES |
| `MINIANDROID_S186F_DEQUE=0` only | YES |

**Conclusion: the S186h ARITY LAW alone regresses sunpiano on pure main.** The env-off switch (now part of the W14 patch) restores health byte-for-byte.

**Decode of the death site (androguard, this session):** `Lb/m;.<init>()V` = R8 `ComponentActivity.<init>` (its own ISE text "getLifecycle() returned null in ComponentActivity's constructor" is in the body). pc `0xb9` falls on the `iput-object v4, v7, Lb/m;->m` at `0xb8` — the third `CopyOnWriteArrayList` field write of the lifecycle-observer block. The NPE fires inside the ctor chain that the ARITY LAW's descriptor-less selection re-routed.

## PART 2 — F-C4-613, THE UNIFIED <init> ARITY CLASSIFIER (the reconciliation law)

**Why the two existing laws fight:** the W13 F-C4-610 receiver-arity law and the S186h exact-arity law each trust a DIFFERENT call convention for `<init>`:

- **F-C4-610** (itsfrz #489 proof): the inflater's ctor hook passes `(recv, Context, AttributeSet)` — arg_count INCLUDES the receiver → lawful ctor is `param_count == arg_count - 1`.
- **S186h ARITY** (tibarj #170 proof): the 2-param XML inflation passes `(Context, AttributeSet)` — arg_count EXCLUDES the receiver → lawful ctor is `param_count == arg_count`.

**Live truth table (sunpiano, W14 line binary, this session):** with the two laws able to be toggled independently (`MINIANDROID_S186H_ARITY` / `MINIANDROID_F610_LAW`), EVERY single-on combination still kills `b/m;.<init>`; ONLY both-off restores the app — 576,907 px REAL_APP_CONTENT. Both conventions are REAL in this engine's call sites; the discriminator must be DATA, not a flag.

**F-C4-613 law (two clauses):**

1. **The data-driven classifier:** for a descriptor-less `<init>` selection, the call is receiver-carrying **IFF `args[0]` is a reference whose class IS the declaring class or a SUBCLASS of it** (`this` of the construction — ART JVMS 5.4.5). No other first-argument type can satisfy that (a Context/AttributeSet/FragmentManager first arg is never a subclass of the constructed class). Then:
   - receiver-carrying → lawful `param_count = arg_count - 1`
   - receiver-less → lawful `param_count = arg_count`
2. **FILTER semantics for BOTH trackers:** the lawful-arity candidate REPLACES the legacy largest-bytecode pick **only when the legacy pick's own arity is unlawful**. When legacy already has the lawful arity, legacy WINS (byte-order stability). The same filter is applied to the S186h non-`<init>` exact-arity tracker (using the selected candidate's own static flag, as the in-loop tracker did).

**The mispick the filter kills (decoded via the env-gated `MINIANDROID_F613_DIAG` selection probe):** `Li2/v;.<init>` — a 43-call hot ctor with TWO 2-param overloads, `(Ljava/lang/String;I)V` and `(Ljava/lang/String;Lc5/e;)V`. Re-picking by size INSIDE the lawful-arity subset flipped it to `(String,I)V` while legacy (healthy arm) had `(String,Lc5/e;)V` — both arities lawful, null-typed arg2 matched both. The filter now keeps legacy for every same-arity case.

**Proofs preserved (all four shapes):**
- itsfrz FCV (receiver-carrying, static-flagged): legacy pick = the UNLAWFUL 3-param `(Context,AttributeSet,FragmentManager)` → replaced by the lawful 2-param ✓
- tibarj #170 (receiver-less): legacy = the unlawful 3-param → replaced by the lawful 2-param ✓
- sunpiano: every legacy pick on the render path already lawful → legacy kept → 576,907 px ✓
- dooz: face returns to the long-standing pin `a0fae9072313e2d1` (S186h's `d602648e` was the same mispick class — the ARITY law had silently shifted the dooz selection; 6 uncaught both ways)

## PART 3 — THE FRAGMENT FAMILY (F-C4-614 / 615 / 615b / 615c)

Real androidx vendored this wave per the SQLITE RULE: `androidx.fragment` **1.8.5 sources jar** from Google Maven (`dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2/androidx/fragment/fragment/1.8.5/fragment-1.8.5-sources.jar`) — `FragmentLayoutInflaterFactory.java` and `FragmentContainerView.kt` quoted verbatim in the law comments.

**The real mechanism (from source):** the inflater's Factory2 sees `FragmentContainerView` and constructs it with the INTERNAL 3-arg ctor `(Context, AttributeSet, FragmentManager)`; that ctor reads `android:name`/`class`, requires `android:id`, instantiates the fragment via `fm.fragmentFactory.instantiate(...)`, sets `mFragmentId = mContainerId = id`, calls `onInflate`, and commits `fm.beginTransaction().setReorderingAllowed(true).add(this, fragment, tag).commitNowAllowingStateLoss()`. The ENGINE previously created the FCV element as a plain container — the named fragment was NEVER born (the itsfrz `NavHostFragment` null-cast root: the fragment simply did not exist).

- **F-C4-614 (layout_inflater.cpp):** any `*FragmentContainerView` element with `android:name`/`class` AND `android:id` fires the SAME `FragmentTagHook` as the `<fragment>` tag → `instantiate_fragment_tag` (no-arg ctor, host linkage, synthetic add with container = the xml id on the F-NEW-304 queue). No-id case logs an honest miss (real FCV throws ISE there).
- **F-C4-615 (dalvik_engine.cpp):** `findFragmentById`/`findFragmentByTag` on the androidx FM now answer from the `FragmentManagerShadow` record store (container id / tag), `@Nullable` null preserved for no-match (the androidx contract).
- **F-C4-615b (R8 class renames):** the FM class is resolved STRUCTURALLY (the FCV internal-ctor's third parameter — the same law the S186h realinit uses) by a new **instance-independent** file-scope resolver. Measured live: the engine object is RECREATED between the provider and activity phases, so the realinit's `api_singletons_` binding dies with the old instance while its static `done`-set (keyed by the old heap oid) blocks the re-bind — the resolver runs off the shared DEX report and survives.
- **F-C4-615c (R8 method renames):** on the FM class, ANY method with descriptor `(I)L…;` or `(Ljava/lang/String;)L…;` whose return type is an ANCESTOR of a recorded fragment (walked via `class_to_superclass_` from the store's own records) enters the store law — itsfrz dispatches `U1/K;.A(I)LU1/r;`.

**Live proof (itsfrz #489, fresh store, this session):**
- `[F-NEW-339] <fragment> Landroidx/navigation/fragment/NavHostFragment; obj#1145 container=2131296461 → synthetic add committed` — the NavHostFragment is BORN (0x7F0900CD = the exact `@7F0900CD` xml id from `res/v9.xml`)
- `[FRAGMENT-LIFECYCLE] onAttach` (real DEX) → `[F-NEW-304] created drain` → the fragment reaches CREATED
- `[F615-FIND] A -> record (store=2 records)` — the app's `findFragmentById` (via `this.u → .e → .h → U1/K;.A(I)`, all decoded from `MainActivity.onCreate` pc window `0x16e..0x196`) resolves the RECORD
- **the `null cannot be cast to non-null type androidx.navigation.fragment.NavHostFragment` family is DEAD (2 → 0)**

## THE FULL BATTERY (W14 binary, this session, fresh stores)

| Title | Class | px | uncaught | face | pin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| microtimer | **PIN_MATCH** | 893,597 | 0 | `bbd350b6c14fbd52` | == standing |

| itsfrz_ttt | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | 0 | 10 | `d55056a8928a26ff` | fm-cast family dead; next = nav-graph |
| pfdicer | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | 0 | 12 | `b5a7a35d5fe0564b` | store-temperature (see honest notes) |
| sparkledns | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | 0 | 23 | `3fddba97cbe5ac66` | Compose family (Coder-3 lane) |
| stopwatch | NO_ROOT | 0 | 0 | — | Compose family (Coder-3 lane) |

## ONE-COMMAND VERIFICATION (confirm or falsify)

```bash
# on a clean main@7b94dc79 tree:
git apply w14_laws.diff   # sha16 28faad729460215d, full text in comments 1-2
cd miniandroid && make -j2   # (sandbox note: this TU needs -g0, already in the Makefile rule)

# the sunpiano restoration (THE headline A/B):
rm -rf run/store && ./miniandroid/build/miniandroid install \
  <sunpiano_2.apk> --data-root run/store && \
./miniandroid/build/miniandroid run --execution-mode real-dalvik \
  --data-root run/store -o run/out --max-seconds 60 --frames 6 \
  --trace --package code.alimiracle.sunpiano
# expect: verdict=REAL_APP_CONTENT app_owned_pixels=576907 uncaught=7
#         face af001924bf2b7554, ZERO 'unwound Lb/m;.<init>' rows

# the S186h ARITY LAW regression (on PURE main, no patch needed — the
# one-command repro for the maintainer):
#   default run  -> 25 uncaught, 'unwound Lb/m;.<init> invoke_pc=0xb9' present
#   MINIANDROID_S186H_ARITY=0 <same run> -> 32 uncaught, b/m death ABSENT

# the fragment family (itsfrz):
#   expect '[F-NEW-339] <fragment> Landroidx/navigation/fragment/NavHostFragment;'
#   + MINIANDROID_F615_DIAG=1 shows '[F615-FIND] A -> record (store=2 records)'
#   + ZERO 'null cannot be cast' rows (was 2-3)

# gates: microtimer bbd350b6c14fbd52 / opencalc 63020bc7334048fe /
#        dooz a0fae9072313e2d1 — all three must be byte-identical
```

## HONEST FINDINGS THAT DID NOT BECOME LAWS (recorded so nobody re-walks these)

1. **pfdicer is store-temperature sensitive AND run-variant this session:** the W13 issue documented cold-store REAL_APP_CONTENT 1,041 px vs warm-store 0 px on the UNMODIFIED baseline. This session measured BOTH shapes on W14 binaries (1,041 px REAL on one run, 0 px on the battery re-run, 11-12 uncaught both ways). The ViewPager/FragmentPagerAdapter page-population family (the original W14 target for this title) is still NOT implemented — the fragment STORE now exists for it, but `ViewPager.populate → adapter.instantiateItem` needs its own law (next frontier).
2. **itsfrz's remaining 10 uncaught are the NEXT nav frontier, cleanly named:** the NavHostFragment now constructs and attaches; the deaths moved into the nav-graph lane (`LC4/u;.s`, `LU1/r;.<init>` pc=0x45 — the NavController/NavInflater family). The `onInflate(Context, AttributeSet, Bundle)` dispatch (which reads `app:navGraph` into `mGraphId`) is NOT yet wired through the `FragmentTagHook` — the hook signature would need the per-element AttributeSet oid; that is the precise next law.
3. **dooz pin note for the maintainer:** S186h recorded `d602648e` as the standing dooz pin. F-C4-613 returns dooz to `a0fae9072313e2d1` (the S183b→W13-era pin, 6 uncaught both ways). My reading: `d602648e` was itself an ARITY-law artifact (the same mispick class that killed sunpiano); the maintainer adjudicates which face is canonical — both are REAL_APP_CONTENT 231,873 px.
4. **The `s186_stuck_battery.py` "corruption" scare was a display artifact:** lines `ctx = lines[max(0, i - 3):i + span]` render as `linesax(0,` in terminals that eat `[m` as an ANSI escape. The posted W13 script is byte-correct (sha-verified this session against the delivered patch). Same artifact class as the W13 "ode]]" reading — worth knowing when reading traces on `[m`-rich content.
5. **The engine-instance recreation (provider phase vs activity phase) is now a MEASURED engine fact** (F-C4-615b root): function-local statics survive the recreation, member maps do not. Any law that binds state in one phase and reads it in another must key off DEX-report-derived data or re-derive per instance.

## NEXT FRONTIER (named for W15)

1. **NavHostFragment onInflate + the nav-graph lane** (itsfrz): extend `FragmentTagHook` with the per-element AttributeSet oid; dispatch real `onInflate`; then NavInflater/NavGraph XML (the `res/3j.xml` navigation resource parses as AXML already).
2. **The ViewPager/FragmentPagerAdapter population law** (pfdicer + every onboarding-pager app): `setAdapter → populate → instantiateItem(position 0..offscreenLimit)` against the now-existing fragment store.
3. **sunpiano's remaining 7 uncaught** (audio/coroutine tails — unchanged from W13).
4. The four-title W13-pinned items (CB nav-args IAE root now renders its OpenJDK-exact message after F-C4-612 — the W14 decode starts from a clean message).

**Full patch in comments 1-2** (`w14_laws.diff`, 2885 lines, sha16 `28faad729460215d`; applies clean on `main@7b94dc79`). Local branch `w14-coder4-line` (4 commits on main) — push still 403 for this token, Issues are the delivery channel per protocol.

— Coder 4
