issues.body:
# PHASE E — RECOVER THE ACTUAL VIEW AND DRAW PIPELINE

Start with gmdice and unote. Do not assume identical routes.

## gmdice (Adapter/View route)

Chain: `Activity → ListActivity → ListView → Adapter → getView → row inflation → addView → measure → layout → draw`.

Investigate: setListAdapter · adapter identity · getCount/getItem/getItemId · getView · row resource · LayoutInflater · convertView · child ownership · child attachment · notifyDataSetChanged · LayoutParams · actual drawing · scroll behavior.

**Known defect:** adapter data can grow (0→1→2) while actual visible rows remain zero. Fix the lowest shared root. The real Adapter must produce real Views. **Do not manufacture rows.**

## unote (Toolbar route)

Toolbar construction → children → custom child insertion → LayoutParams → child ownership → drawing traversal → Canvas propagation → render-task creation → framebuffer delivery. The existence of a Toolbar child is NOT evidence it was rendered. **Trace the exact point the child disappears from the rendering path.**

## Shared View system (generic, AOSP contracts)

View construction · ViewGroup child management · LayoutParams · MeasureSpec · onMeasure · requestLayout · onLayout · dispatchDraw · invalidation · backgrounds · Drawable bounds · padding/margins · visibility · text rendering · image rendering · clipping · transforms · scrolling · z-order. No screenshot-specific isolated fixes.

Owner: Coder 2 + Coder 3, integration by Main Coder. Status: OPEN.

issues.title: CODER 8 — Base Concurrency & Scheduling Runtime Engineering Worklog
issues.body:
>

# CODER 8 — Base Concurrency & Scheduling Runtime Engineering Worklog

> **Standing rule (user directive 2026-11-06): GitHub content is ENGLISH-ONLY.** This Issue is CODER 8's single reference and worklog. Mission: repair the runtime's generic concurrency & scheduling base so **thousands of apps boot** — not one-by-one micro-fixes. The 140-row semantic coverage matrix (real code + corpus evidence) is published here, each row with its measured impact on APP LOADING and a status label. No commit/push is made; only this Issue is updated.
> **Method law (per S185/#536 — THE SQLITE RULE):** VEND, DON'T REWRITE · LOAD-FIRST (full load before any size work) · TRACER-THEN-PRUNE · NOTHING BULKY IN GIT. Every claim carries evidence; no "loaded" claim without zero uncaught exceptions.

## 0. Identity, mission, method

- **Coder:** CODER 8. **Repo:** `Sh-TB/MiniAndroid-Compatibility-Runtime` (public, `main` @ clone of 2026-11-06).
- **Mission (per briefing):** improve the **generic concurrency & scheduling base** (Thread runtime / Looper+MessageQueue / Handler+callbacks / clocks+timers / monitors+synchronization / Executors+Futures / async-integration contracts) so it honors real Java/Android semantics — fixes must serve **many independent apps**, never one app.
- **Batch model:** rolling batches of 20+ laws. **This entry = Batch 1: the 40 structural root fixes** that unblock app loading (57 register rows now IMPLEMENTED because many root fixes close several law rows at once).
- **Engineering red lines honored:** no fake callbacks; no "enqueued = executed" confusion; no swallowed exceptions (every law violation now raises or logs LOUD); no arbitrary delays masking races; no single-thread shortcut beyond the documented deterministic-serialization model; no app-specific branches.
- **Security:** no token, credential, or host path appears anywhere in this Issue or its evidence. The token lives only in the CI-side environment, never in code, logs, or patches.

## 1. Impact legend — what a law row does to APP LOADING

| Level | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **L0** | App **fails to load/boot** (crash in `<clinit>`/`onCreate`, or the UI thread silently starves) for the whole app class that touches the law |
| **L1** | Major framework (Room/WorkManager/AsyncTask/coroutines/RxJava/Volley/Glide) fails at load or its core feature is dead after load — affects >50% of modern apps in the class |
| **L2** | Feature-level wrong behavior after successful load — 10–50% of apps |
| **L3** | Edge-case / observability / hostile-input only — <10% |

## 2. Batch 1 result (this entry)

**57 of the 140 audited laws are now IMPLEMENTED + TESTED** (including **all 14 L0 boot-blockers** — T-05, H-02, H-03, H-04, H-06, H-07, H-21, M-01, M-03, M-04, M-16, E-02, E-03, E-04). 29 rows were verified already-correct (pre-existing laws with evidence), 2 PARTIAL (documented deterministic subsets), 44 PENDING for the next batches, 8 BLOCKED (near-zero corpus demand).

### 2.1 The ten structural root fixes (each closes multiple rows)

| Root fix | Rows closed | Was | Now |
|---|---|---|---|
| **R1 Monitors are real** — MONITOR_ENTER/EXIT execute an owner/depth registry keyed by the monitor object; non-owner/unowned exit raises `IllegalMonitorStateException` (AOSP ObjectMonitor) | M-01, M-02 | hard no-op in the interpreter | `dalvik_engine.cpp` `fetch_decode_execute` |
| **R2 Object.wait/notify/notifyAll protocol** — ownership check (IMSE), full monitor release, park on `monitor:<oid>`, FIFO wake 1/all, timeout wake, interrupt-before/during-wait → `InterruptedException` | M-03..M-07 | ZERO handling anywhere (generic stub → crash) | `bridge_to_api` law |
| **R3 Thread state machine** — per-thread life phase (NEW/ALIVE/TERMINATED), interrupt flag with wake-on-interrupt of parked bodies, consume-on-read static `interrupted()`, per-thread name/tid/equals/toString | T-02..T-09, T-12, T-29 | no-op / always-false / always-true ("main", tid 1) | `ThreadShadow` (`android_shadows.cpp/h`) |
| **R4 Thread.join drains to termination** — while the target is parked, the one virtual clock advances to its wake and the body re-drains to completion; join returns only at TERMINATED | T-10 | no-op → stale-state handoffs | `bridge_to_api` join law |
| **R5 Real Futures** — `submit(Runnable/Callable)` mints a FutureTask, enqueues the REAL task on the pool's worker identity; the shared queued-entry dispatcher completes the future (`__ft_done__/__ft_result__`), wakes `get()` parkers; `get()` blocks/parks/throws CancellationException/TimeoutException; `cancel` purges the queued task | E-02..E-06, E-16, E-22 | loud stub, no Future at all | `executor_shadow` + `invoke_queued_entry` |
| **R6 Executor contract honesty** — `execute(null)` NPE, `newFixedThreadPool(0)` IAE, `shutdownNow()` purge+interrupt, `isTerminated()` = shutdown ∧ all futures done, `awaitTermination` virtual-time | E-07..E-12 | log-only fakes / stubs | `executor_shadow.cpp` |
| **R7 Message protocol end-to-end** — `obtainMessage*` returns a REAL Message (what/arg1/arg2/obj/target/when fields); `sendEmptyMessage/sendMessage*/sendMessageAtTime` enqueue; the drain dispatches the **target handler's real DEX `handleMessage(Message)`**; `removeMessages/hasMessages` what/obj laws; `sendToTarget/getTarget/setTarget` | H-02..H-09, H-21 | returned `true` and did nothing; `obtainMessage` answered a boolean | `HandlerShadow` + `LooperShadow` Message block + drain dispatch |
| **R8 Looper per-thread law** — `prepare()` allocates a background Looper+Queue for the current thread (duplicate → AOSP RTE), `myLooper()` answers the CALLING thread (null unprepared, main singleton on main), `getQueue` per-thread, `getThread()` reverse registry, `quit` never on main (loud) | L-01..L-04, L-06, L-07, L-17 | myLooper always answered MAIN | `LooperShadow` registry |
| **R9 HandlerThread class** — init(name)/start/getLooper (prepares ITS OWN looper, identity-stable)/quit/isAlive | H-17 | class absent entirely (getLooper → null → boot NPE) | `ThreadShadow` HandlerThread block |
| **R10 Locks + Conditions** — ReentrantLock owner tracking (contended `tryLock` → **false**), non-owner unlock → real IMSE, `newCondition` → real object (was **null** → NPE), `Condition.await` = ownership check + lock release + park on `cond:<oid>`, `signal/signalAll` FIFO wake with ownership check | M-13..M-17 | tryLock always true; newCondition null; await/signal absent | `locks_shadow` + engine await law |

Plus: **CountDownLatch** (entire class — `await` parks, `countDown` wakes all at zero, `getCount`), **SystemClock epoch separation** (`currentTimeMillis` = fixed deterministic RTC base + virtual ms; uptime/elapsed unchanged — one clock authority), **Handler looper binding law** (a Handler delivers on the looper it was constructed with).

### 2.2 Executable evidence (no documentation-only claims)

| Harness | Scope | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/coder8_concurrency_test.cpp` (NEW, `make coder8`) | 67 checks across the 12 mandated families: H1 thread identity, H2 cross-thread delivery identity, H3 callback order, H4 delayed dispatch, H5 dispatch-time cancel, H6 join registry, H7 interrupt, H8 wait/notify FIFO, H9 executor laws, H10 future cancel, H11 exception channel, H12 termination + Message/Looper/HandlerThread/Condition/Clock groups | **67/67 PASS**; **3 consecutive runs byte-identical**; exit 0 |
| `tests/exp088_phasef_handler_queue_semantics.cpp` (pre-existing) | Handler queue laws (post/drain/remove/front) | **26/26 PASS** (no regression) |
| Full runtime build | `make build/miniandroid` (all 76k-line engine + shadows) | **BUILD OK, zero errors** |
| Pre-existing `tests/s130_laws_test.cpp` | gesture/model laws | **pre-existing compile break vs. current `GdModel::Cb` signature (unrelated to concurrency; untouched files) — registered as OBSERVED, fix is out of CODER 8 scope** |

Determinism law: the 3-run byte-identical requirement holds on the new harness (stdout fingerprint identical across runs).

### 2.3 Regression risk assessment (mandatory for shared-engine changes)

- `MONITOR_EXIT` IMSE: javac/D8 emit balanced enter/exit pairs; only hostile/hand-crafted DEX can hit the throw. Risk **LOW**.
- `isAlive` now truthful: apps whose load path loops on `while(!t.isAlive())` were livelocking to the visit cap before (false failures) — the truthful law can only reduce false failures. Risk **LOW**.
- `execute(null)`/`newFixedThreadPool(0)` now throw: AOSP parity; the old behavior was a documented-law violation logged loudly. Risk **LOW**.
- `currentTimeMillis` now epoch-domain: apps comparing it to `uptimeMillis` previously saw equality (a lie); the new base is fixed-deterministic so byte-identical replay holds. Risk **LOW**.
- Handler message family now actually enqueues: previously-silent apps may now reach `handleMessage` bodies that were dead code — that is the FIX, not a regression; the corpus battery (f124 anchors) is the arbiter for the next run.

## 3. The 140-law semantic coverage matrix

Columns: ID · Subsystem · API/law · State **before** this batch · Defect · App-loading impact · Status.

| ID | Sub | API/law | Before | Defect | Loading impact | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T-01 | Thread | start()/run() inline drain (F-THREAD-TICK) | OK | pending-start drain runs REAL DEX run() — no fake callback | boot: N/A (was working) | OK |
| T-02 | Thread | Thread.interrupt() | WRONG | was a no-op in the setDaemon/setName no-op family — interrupt-driven workers never fired; parked bodies slept forever | L1 >50% (OkHttp/RxJava/coroutine cancel paths, media players) | IMPLEMENTED |
| T-03 | Thread | Thread.isInterrupted() | WRONG | always returned false — cancel loops never observed the flag | L1 >50% | IMPLEMENTED |
| T-04 | Thread | static Thread.interrupted() | MISSING | consume-on-read law absent (fell through to generic stub) | L2 10-50% | IMPLEMENTED |
| T-05 | Thread | Thread.isAlive() | WRONG | always true — while(t.isAlive()) loops livelocked to the 50001-visit cap and the run ended as a false failure | L0 100% of apps with isAlive guards | IMPLEMENTED |
| T-06 | Thread | Thread.setName/getName | WRONG | getName returned constant "main" for every thread; setName discarded | L2 (thread-name guards, logging, ANR trace matching) | IMPLEMENTED |
| T-07 | Thread | Thread.getId() | WRONG | constant 1 for all threads — identity collisions in thread-keyed maps | L2 | IMPLEMENTED |
| T-08 | Thread | Thread.equals/hashCode/toString | WRONG | equals compared against the main singleton — worker-vs-worker equals always false | L2 | IMPLEMENTED |
| T-09 | Thread | Thread.sleep interrupt law | WRONG | sleep on an interrupted thread silently slept instead of throwing InterruptedException | L1 (interrupt-cancellable waits) | IMPLEMENTED |
| T-10 | Thread | Thread.join() | WRONG | no-op — callers proceeded before the worker finished: every join-handoff read stale state | L1 >50% (worker-then-read patterns) | IMPLEMENTED |
| T-11 | Thread | Thread.join(millis) timeout overload | PENDING | deterministic full-drain subset today; bounded virtual-time wait planned batch 2 | L3 | PENDING |
| T-12 | Thread | Thread life phase (NEW/ALIVE/TERMINATED) | MISSING | no life state existed; run_thread_start_body never marked termination | L1 | IMPLEMENTED |
| T-13 | Thread | Thread.getState() | MISSING | enum state surface absent | L3 | PENDING |
| T-14 | Thread | setDaemon/getDaemon | PARTIAL | setDaemon accepted+ignored (documented); getDaemon unhandled (falls to stub) | L3 | PENDING |
| T-15 | Thread | setPriority/getPriority | STUB | no scheduler model; getPriority unhandled | L3 | PENDING |
| T-16 | Thread | ThreadGroup | MISSING | no group object model; enumerate/stop/uncaught hooks absent | L3 | BLOCKED |
| T-17 | Thread | holdsLock(Object) | WRONG | returned void (no-op family) — must answer bool from the C8 monitor registry | L2 | PENDING |
| T-18 | Thread | getContextClassLoader/setContextClassLoader | PARTIAL | void no-ops; getters must return a ClassLoader object | L2 (reflection-heavy apps) | PENDING |
| T-19 | Thread | UncaughtExceptionHandler (F-NEW-272) | OK | engine law: default = KillApplicationHandler, never null; set/get reach the engine | load: N/A | OK |
| T-20 | Thread | uncaught exception propagation in drained bodies | PARTIAL | bodies that throw mid-run terminate without the handler chain on the drain path | L1 (background crashes kill silently) | PENDING |
| T-21 | Thread | ThreadLocal | OK | 26 engine sites; get/set/remove implemented | load: N/A | OK |

| T-29 | Thread | interrupt of a SLEEPING body | WRONG | no wake existed — the body slept the full sleep() even after interrupt | L1 | IMPLEMENTED |
| T-30 | Thread | thread-default uncaught handler used by executor workers | PARTIAL | drained executor tasks lack the per-thread handler chain | L2 | PENDING |
| L-01 | Looper | Looper.prepare() per-thread | WRONG | no-op — no per-thread looper existed; the worker-Looper pattern silently bound main | L1 >50% (HandlerThread/Volley/Glide patterns) | IMPLEMENTED |

| H-02 | Handler | Handler.obtainMessage(...) | WRONG | returned a BOOLEAN (true) — no Message object was ever minted; msg.what readers hit garbage | L0 100% of handleMessage-style apps at first use | IMPLEMENTED |

### 4. Generic root causes (3, all system-level — this is why it is a BASE law, not an app patch)
- **RC-1**: no loader-visible resolution surface at process start — glibc caches `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` at exec; `setenv()` after start can never fix DT_NEEDED.
- **RC-2**: bionic version surface (`DT_VERNEED`/versym "LIBC") refused by glibc.
- **RC-3** *(new measurement — the real S183 "init-constructor frontier")*: `libgdx.so .init_array[0]` is **NULL with no relocation filling it**; glibc **calls** NULL entries, bionic **skips** them → the "segfault inside init constructors" was glibc jumping to address 0. Not an app bug, not a shim gap: a loader-contract divergence.

### 5. Implementation (4 sub-laws, in-runtime, fresh-container-proof; no app-specific branches)
- **B1-SPAWN** (`main.cpp`): stage `<bin_dir>/native_shims` and put it on `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` **before any runtime work**; one self re-exec (`MINIANDROID_B1_SPAWNED` guard) so the loader caches it from process start.

`ShapeDrawable` owns ONE mShape (RectShape/OvalShape/RoundRectShape/ArcShape) and ONE mPaint created lazily by getPaint (identity-stable — mutations through it persist); `AbsListView.setDivider/setDividerHeight` parks mDivider/mDividerHeight and the list draw paints the divider between consecutive visible children (no rows → no dividers); `AdaptiveIconDrawable` layers resolve through Resources (the decoder needs a resource resolver); `Paint()` defaults to BLACK — a never-colored ShapeDrawable still FILLS black.

### 3. Source citations

### 4. Generic root causes (3 — base laws, no app branches)
- **RC-A**: programmatic ShapeDrawable state existed NOWHERE (no capture, no paint identity) → every programmatic shape drawable (dividers, custom backgrounds) was invisible. Base law: any app drawing shapes in code.
- **RC-B**: ListView divider contract absent → list UIs lose their separators corpus-wide.
- **RC-C**: the A7b icon decode passed NO resource resolver → every adaptive-icon app (API 26+ default) hit the honest-refusal "no resolver was provided".

### 5. Implementation (4 sub-laws, in-runtime, registry-pattern reuse; no app-specific branches)

Do not add every famous library. Inspect the failing application route first:

1. Existing implementation present and correct → **reuse it**.

Skia (2D raster) · Mesa/llvmpipe (software GL) · GL4ES (legacy OpenGL translation) · SDL2/SDL3 (SDL routes) · FFmpeg (real media consumers) · libyuv (pixel-format conversion) · libzip/minizip-ng (ZIP/asset access) · libcurl (HTTP) · OpenAL Soft (native spatial audio) · AndroidX source (missing framework/component behavior).

- Verify license.
- Build reproducibly.
- Keep bulky source and binaries outside Git.
- Record build provenance.
- Prove runtime loading.
- **Prove real APK consumption.**

- A resource implementation must be accessible to ImageView.
- An Executor implementation must be accessible to libGDX.
- A native-library implementation must be accessible to the real APK loader.
- An AndroidX lifecycle fix must be usable by every applicable application.

labels.name: common-runtime
labels.description: Failure owned by common runtime code

issues.body:
# PHASE B — BUILD ONE SHARED EXECUTION GRAPH (FDT)

Extend the existing FDT system (`tools/fdt/`). **Do not build a second competing tracer.**

## One graph per APK execution, containing

APK identity + SHA256 · runtime commit · runtime binary SHA256 · run ID · route ID · active execution paths · observed capabilities · causal relationships · first divergence per path · final graphical result · input result · regression result.

## Node types

APK, CLASS_LOAD, METHOD_CALL, API_DISPATCH, OBJECT_STATE, RESOURCE, ASSET, VIEW, ADAPTER, LAYOUT, DRAW, NATIVE_LOAD, JNI, EGL, GLES, AUDIO, INPUT, STATE_MUTATION, FRAMEBUFFER, SCREENSHOT.

## Edge types

CALL, DATA_FLOW, DEPENDS_ON, ATTACHES, CREATES, CONSUMES, RENDERS_TO, CAUSES, REPLACES, SCHEDULES.

## Provenance requirements

Resource nodes record byte origin · Bitmap nodes identify decoder + consumer · View nodes identify parent + lifecycle · Draw nodes identify renderer + destination · GLES nodes identify context, surface, framebuffer.

## Contract-aware first divergence

Distinguish: valid null / invalid null / unimplemented API / wrong overload / incorrect return / missing side effect / incorrect dispatch / wrong object identity / incorrect state propagation / missing consumer / rendering failure / capture failure. Every divergence records: exact method, caller, callee, args, receiver identity, expected contract, actual result, source location, downstream effect, confidence, owner. **An early missing API returning null beats a later NPE as the root cause.**

## Hard rules

- `UNOBSERVED` is never `PASS`.
- Multiple independent divergences per APK supported; View-route and Native-route diagnostics never overwrite each other.
- FDT OFF has no measurable overhead beyond baseline variability.
- First implementation must run on **real executions** of gmdice, TicTacToe, Mindustry. No documentation-only wave.

Owner: Main Coder + Coder 3. Status: OPEN.

The app now gets deep into libGDX internals (render loop live, `AndroidGraphics.onDrawFrame` running, FreeType param objects built), so the wall moved INTO the asset pipeline. Chain, each leg proven from the APK's own dex (`s139_dex_dis`):

1. `AssetManager.load(String, Class, params)` pc=35→37 queue-dup check `desc.fileName.equals` → NPE 'String.equals on null' → `AndroidLauncher.onCreate` unwind. **Why:** `AssetDescriptor.<init>` sets `fileName = fileName.replaceAll("\\", "/")` (dex pc=276–278) — `replaceAll` had NO law → bridge tail answered the reference-type default (NULL).
2. After fixing (1): `finishLoading` returned with **zero** assets loaded; `updateTask` never traced. **Why:** `AssetManager.tasks` is a `java.util.Stack` — `push` had NO law (Stack extends Vector; the F-NEW-246 law is Vector-keyed) → every push silently no-op'd → the tasks Stack stayed empty → `update()` answered true.
3. After fixing (2): `Future.isDone` NPE inside `AssetLoadingTask.update` → `taskFailed` → `GdxRuntimeException`. **Why:** libGDX `AsyncExecutor.submit(AsyncTask)` → `ExecutorService.submit(Callable)` — submit had NO law and was also listed in `ExecutorShadow::stubbed_methods` — the return was NULL → `AsyncResult.future` null → `isDone` NPE.

## B) Root cause (one family, three instances)

The **silent-null bridge tail**: every unimplemented reference-returning method answers NULL (or typed-zero) instead of a loud miss — the exact family the S100 block fixed for trim/indexOf (browser onClick). Three more instances: `String.replaceAll`, `java.util.Stack`, `ExecutorService.submit`. All three are libcore/java.util.concurrent semantics — zero app-specific branches.

## C) Implementation (dalvik_engine.cpp, +470/−2, one file)

- **F-NEW-576** — `String.replaceAll` / `replaceFirst` (std::regex ECMAScript + hand-expanded Java replacement template: `$n`/`${n}` groups, `$0`=whole match, backslash escapes; bounded `[F-NEW-576-RE]` degradation to literal replace on regex_error) + `replace(CharSequence, CharSequence)` / `replace(char, char)` literal (OpenJDK empty-target law) + the replace family joins the null-receiver NPE arm.
- **F-NEW-577** — `java.util.Stack` law on the F-NEW-246 Vector store: `push` (returns the item), `peek`, `pop` (removes top; `EmptyStackException` when empty), `empty`, `search` (1-based from top). Stack joins the same class gate as Vector — every Vector method is now a Stack method.
- **F-NEW-578** — `ExecutorService.submit` on the executor family: task `call()`/`run()` executes to completion INLINE (real DEX, the M3 §4 deterministic serialization — enqueue would deadlock `finishLoading`'s blocking loop) and returns a REAL Future (done=true, value = task result / the explicit result arg). **F-NEW-578b** — `Future.isDone/get/cancel/isCancelled` on the minted futures. `ExecutorShadow` keeps enqueue-shaped `execute()`; submit is completion-shaped.
- **`MINIANDROID_INVOKE_TRACE=<class-substring>`** — generic dex-frame tracer in `execute_method_internal` (per-(class,method) bounded 40, one thread_local gate). This is what made the whole chain visible; available to every coder/title (no per-app law).

## D) Verification (all runs this session, fresh binary, base 52f13489)

| check | result |
|---|---|
| tictactoe: `AssetManager.load` NPE | GONE — `[F-NEW-576] replaceAll(rx="\") len 14->14` ×5 (real calls) |
| tictactoe: task queue | `updateTask` now EXECUTES (trace + the failure moved past queue-fill) |
| tictactoe: submit | `[EXECUTOR] submit(AsyncExecutor$2) oid=505 → ran=1 Future obj#552` |
| bouncy 30f ×2 (canonical taps, s182 gate) | **BYTE-EXACT `8a6c24ac8a7d718e`** == S183b/S186b pin, rc=0, 0 uncaught ×2 |
| stack.tower3d 30f | rc=1 (pre-existing partial), **0 uncaught**, no drift signal |
| recipes | `./build/miniandroid run --execution-mode real-dalvik --frames 30 --frame-delay 200 --width 1080 --height 1920 [-taps] -o <dir> <apk>` |

## E) Named frontier (honest residual, evidence kept)

The I18NBundle locale ladder now runs end-to-end (`createBundle → loadBundleChain ×3 → toFileHandle ×3 → checkFileExistence ×3`, all REAL dex) but every candidate opens MISS — the requested path degrades to `assets/i18n` because **libGDX's own `com.badlogic.gdx.utils.StringBuilder`** (not java.lang!) builds the name and its char[] output is ALL-ZERO (`[STRCTOR] cls=[C len=25 e0.v=0` — array allocated right, content never lands; the packed-long encode path is the prime suspect). `checkFileExistence` honestly catches → `MissingResourceException` → `GdxRuntimeException` → onCreate unwind. **S188 = make the libGDX StringBuilder produce real chars (generic char-array/long-pack law), then the properties file opens and the bundle loads.**

## F) Handoff

issues.title: Coder 3 | A21 · S184 — F-NEW-572 bionic init-array null-skip law: the libGDX family's real, APK-bundled libgdx.so LOADS (S183 B1 frontier CLOSED) — byte-inert ×6
issues.body:
## A21 · S184 — **F-NEW-572 bionic init-array null-skip law**: the libGDX family's real, APK-bundled `libgdx.so` now **LOADS** — the S183 B1 queued frontier ("init-constructor segfault") is decoded and CLOSED. Status: `IMPLEMENTED` · `COMPILE_VERIFIED` · `HARNESS_TESTED` · `REGRESSION_VERIFIED` (byte-inert ×6 on the final binary). tictactoe native-load: `INTEGRATION_READY`; tictactoe full load: `APK_OBSERVED` with the next frontier NAMED (the F-NEW-462 AndroidGraphics receiver-binding fixture).

**Base SHA: `9e863137` (current origin/main). Head: `1e280df8` (branch `s184-gdx`, 2 commits, 7 files, +776/−9). Push is still 403 for this token, so per §8 the FULL patch text is published in the comments below — per-commit 0001→0002 + one combined `9e863137..1e280df8` — nothing is summary-only.**

---

### A) Discovery

This wave continues the **user-directive thread** ("bring the ready-made natives like the SQLite precedent — call the real library instead of hand-writing it") by executing the law design that S183 queued in `S183_B1_SCOPE.json`: *"shim staging + verneed clearing = host dlopen of libgdx.so passes load+relocation; init-constructor segfault = bounded frontier; law design queued."*

Re-fetched the exact pinned APK (`f-droid.org/repo/com.emmanuelmess.tictactoe_3.apk`, sha256 `760fe5acf7b394354bf02b7b3484c3eb442491c1fa4325603ad3250f0dfa394`, 4,474,946 B) and took **static ELF ground truth** from its own x86_64 natives with the new auditor `scripts/s184_gdx_elf_audit.py` (evidence/s184_gdx_native_load/S184_ELF_AUDIT.json).

### B) Root cause (ELF bytes, not guesswork)

The libGDX 1.x NDK-build family ships `.init_array` entries whose **file value is `0x0` and which carry NO relocation** (`R_X86_64_RELATIVE` scan of `.rela.dyn`: zero hits on the slots). ttt's `lib/libgdx.so`, `lib/libgdx-box2d.so`, `lib/libgdx-freetype.so` (x86_64) each have exactly **1 init_array entry = genuinely NULL**; `libgdx.so` also has 1 NULL fini_array entry.

- **bionic law** (aosp-mirror, `bionic/linker/linker_soininfo.cpp`, `soinfo::call_function`): *"if (function == nullptr) return;"* — bionic **skips** null ctor entries. That is why these libraries run on every real Android device.
- **glibc law** (`elf/dl-init.c`, `call_init`): calls EVERY entry unconditionally → dlopen jumps to address 0 → **SIGSEGV si_addr=0x0** — precisely the S183 fork-probe FAULTED verdict.
- **Controls** (why this never showed before): bouncy's `libgdx-box2d.so` and tower3d's `libgdx.so` carry **NO `DT_INIT_ARRAY` at all** — they dlopen clean without the law.

### C) Expected behavior (authoritative sources)

- A library that loads on bionic must load on the compatibility runtime with **bionic loader parity**: null ctor entries skipped, real entries executed, faults bounded by the FIX-TTT guard (never process death, never silent).
- AOSP `Runtime.loadLibrary0`: a loadable library must NOT surface `UnsatisfiedLinkError` for a loader-internal reason the platform itself tolerates.
- glibc `elf/get-dynamic-info.h`: unknown dynamic tags outside every known range are ignored — an ignorable high tag (`0x7ffffffe`) is the same-size, table-contiguous neutralization.

### D) Implementation (7 files, minimal diff; per §8 the full text is in the comments)

1. **NEW law `bionic_init_null_fixup`** (`miniandroid/src/jni/native_dep.{h,cpp}`): in the **runtime-owned extracted copy only** (same scope as the F-NEW-461 versym rewrite), when ≥1 init/fini entry is genuinely null (value 0 AND no relocation): exchange the `DT_INIT_ARRAY`/`DT_FINI_ARRAY`/`DT_FINI` tag for `0x7ffffffe`; hand the REAL ctor vaddrs back to the caller; **IRELATIVE aborts the surgery honestly**; opt-out env `MINIANDROID_BIONIC_INIT=0` for bisection.
2. **`load_library`** (`miniandroid/src/jni/dlopen_exec.cpp`): receives the fixup record; after the real dlopen, runs the captured real ctors **under the FIX-TTT fault guard** (bionic parity — nulls skipped, reals executed, faults bounded), with `[S2-NATIVE]` rows + `native.initfixup`/`native.initrun` trace rows.
3. **`crash_forensics` RIP capture**: `[S100-FAULT] rip=/fault_addr=/rip_mod=/rip_modoff=` from the signal ucontext — the B1 "(c) trace the exact faulting import" ask, no gdb needed.

**REV1 was REJECTED by evidence and is documented as such**: zeroing `DT_INIT_ARRAYSZ` alone loaded the lib (first time ever) but the process **died at exit rc=139** — `[S100-FAULT] rip=ld-linux-x86-64.so.2+0x1fa2, fault_addr=0x8`, chain `exit → __run_exit_handlers ("call *%r13") → ld-linux+0x5c92 → ld-linux+0x1fa2 → deref NULL+8`: glibc's exit-time fini walk does not tolerate the size-zeroed tag-present shape. **REV2 (tag removal) makes the loaded link_map shape equal the empirically clean tower3d shape** — exit is clean.

### E) Reproduction (one command + APK SHA256 + expected/actual)

```
# APK sha256 760fe5acf7b394354bf02b7b3484c3eb442491c1fa4325603ad3250f0dfa394 (4,474,946 B)
miniandroid install upload/canonical_apks/com.emmanuelmess.tictactoe_3.apk --data-root <st>
miniandroid run --package com.emmanuelmess.tictactoe --data-root <st> --frames 8 --frame-delay 120 --width 1080 --height 1920 -o <out>
```
- **Expected (this head)**: `[S2-NATIVE] load gdx: dlopen ok` + `[S2-NATIVE] System.loadLibrary("gdx") LOADED size=260696` + run completes all 8 frames, rc=1, verdict `DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY / first_missing_stage=APP_DRAW_OPS`, crash.log names 2 NPEs unwinding `AndroidGraphics.<init>` at invoke_pc=0x60/0x1.
- **Actual**: exactly that (work/run/s184_ttt9). Before this head the same command gave the honest load failure (`dlopen faulted … fork-probe child died by signal`) → `GdxRuntimeException` in `AndroidApplication.<clinit>`.
- **Regression battery (final binary `6fd452e5f77e439d`, all byte-exact)**: bouncy 30f canonical ×3 → frame_029 `8a6c24ac8a7d718e` == `work/run/s180_fix/bouncy_a` (rc=0 ×3); dooz 6f canonical ×2 (+2 more on the rev1 binary) → face `a0fae9072313e2d1` == s181_pin2 (rc=0); tower3d control → face `11a38a5aeeff45a6` == the CONT-113 recorded pin (rc=1). Every gate is bit-identical to its standing pin: **the law is byte-inert wherever no null ctor exists** (bouncy/dooz libs carry no DT_INIT_ARRAY / no natives).

### F) Integration guidance

- Applies cleanly on `9e863137`; touches only `src/jni/native_dep.{h,cpp}`, `src/jni/dlopen_exec.cpp`, `src/diagnostics/crash_forensics.cpp` + evidence/script. No API changes; `prepare_dependencies` gains a defaulted 3rd parameter (`BionicInitFixup* = nullptr`), so every existing call site compiles unchanged.
- The surgery is **idempotent** and recorded per load in the gfx trace (`native.initfixup`, `native.initrun`).
- **Scope honesty**: this closes the LOADER layer of the libGDX family (the `SharedLibraryLoadRuntimeException` / load-time `GdxRuntimeException` family). tictactoe's visible face is still `DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY` — the named next frontier is the **F-NEW-462 AndroidGraphics ctor receiver-binding fixture** (2 NPEs at `AndroidGraphics.<init>` invoke_pc=0x60/0x1), queued as the fixture-first wave. issues.body:
## A20 · S182 — the first general law landed on the S181 root-problem map: **L1 `android.graphics.Insets`** (Family-3). Status: `IMPLEMENTED` · `COMPILE_VERIFIED` · `HARNESS_TESTED` · `REGRESSION_VERIFIED` (byte-inert ×6 runs). bmi verdict: `APK_OBSERVED` — face unchanged, the law is **necessary-but-not-sufficient**; bmi's next frontier is now NAMED (empty content view, zero exceptions).

**Base SHA: `2102d193` (current origin/main). Patches in comments: per-commit 0001→0003 + one combined `2102d193..fa06885d` (3 commits, 23 files, +1620/−156).** Push is still 403 for this token, so per §8 the full patch text is published here — nothing is summary-only.

---

### A) Discovery

The S181 minimal-app census (#472 issuecomment-6683181175) mapped Family-3 = "missing framework classes at the claimed API level": **bmi (com.zola.bmi vc402)** dies at `android.support.v7.widget.DrawableUtils;.<clinit>` with `Class.forName("android.graphics.Insets") → ClassNotFoundException` while the runtime claims `SDK_INT=35`. This session re-fetched the exact pinned APK (`f-droid.org/repo/com.zola.bmi_402.apk`, sha256 `2dbd8ebe2db568014c…`, 1,295,395 B) and took **bytecode ground truth** from its own dex (evidence/s182_l1_insets/drawableutils_*_disasm.txt).

### B) Root cause (bytecode, not guesswork)

`DrawableUtils.<clinit>` is **22 units with NO try/catch**:
```
[0000] new-instance Rect; [0002] invoke-direct Rect-><init>()V
[0005] sput-wide DrawableUtils->INSETS_NONE
[0007] sget SDK_INT … [0011] if-lt 29 → skip
[0013] const-string "android.graphics.Insets"
[0015] invoke-static Class;->forName(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/Class;
[0019] sput sInsetsClazz ; [0021] return-void
```
One deferred CNFE at [0015] kills the **entire support-v7 clinit chain** → bmi stuck at `DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY` (face `b5a7a35d5fe0564b`). The later `getOpticalBounds` consumer is catch-all-degrading (`getFields()` → name-match → `Field.getInt` → `iput` into Rect; any failure → `Log.e("DrawableUtils","Couldn't obtain the optical insets. Ignoring.")` → INSETS_NONE).

### C) Expected behavior (authoritative sources)

- **AOSP `graphics/java/android/graphics/Insets.java`** (aosp-mirror, main): private ctor `Insets(int,int,int,int)` writes the public final fields `left/top/right/bottom`; `of(int,int,int,int)` → the shared **NONE** singleton when all-zero; `of(@Nullable Rect r)` → null → NONE; `toRect()`; `equals` = class identity then 4-field compare; `hashCode` = `((31*left+top)*31+right)*31+bottom`; `toString` = `"Insets{left=…, top=…, right=…, bottom=…}"`.
- **libcore reflection law**: `getFields()` returns the accessible public-field subset (may be empty, **never null**); typed `Field.getInt/getLong/…` answer the same value as `Field.get`, **unboxed**.
- **OpenJDK/ART**: forName resolves against the boot classpath FIRST — a framework class the platform genuinely ships must answer a Class object (R-NEW-354 law's own charter).

### D) Implementation (5 files, minimal diff)

1. **NEW `miniandroid/src/framework/insets_shadow.{h,cpp}`** — `InsetsShadow`, exact-class claim `Landroid/graphics/Insets;`: `<init>(IIII)`, `of(IIII)`, `of(Rect)` (incl. null law), `toRect`, `equals`, `hashCode`, `toString`, NONE singleton; `[INSETS-LAW]` diagnostics.
2. `shadow_registry.cpp` — registered beside WindowInsetsShadow (S113), before the catch-all view path.
3. `dalvik_engine.cpp` — `materialize_init_default` gains the exact 4-int-field Insets layout; **R354 forName registry += `android.graphics.Insets`**; **`getFields` law for SYNTHETIC framework classes** (DEX-defined classes deliberately NOT aliased — no private-field leak; Insets seeded with the 4 public final fields; honest empty array for other synthetic classes); **typed Field getters share the EXACT `get()` read law, unboxed** (`getInt/getLong/getShort/getByte/getChar/getBoolean/getFloat/getDouble`).
4. `Makefile` — `insets_shadow.cpp` added to FRAMEWORK_SOURCES.

Zero app-specific conditionals — the law is keyed on the framework class, per the no-screenshot-hacks rule.

### E) Reproduction (one command per arm; 3×3 A/B, toolchain-deterministic)

```
# baseline arm (cd0857bce4a24c81): git stash the L1 files, rebuild, then ×3:
./miniandroid/build/miniandroid install upload/cont11_apks/bmi_402.apk --data-root <fresh store>
./miniandroid/build/miniandroid run --execution-mode real-dalvik --data-root <store> -o <out> \
  --max-seconds 60 --frames 5 --trace --package com.zola.bmi
```

| arm ×3 | verdict | face | rc | app px | CNFE | law evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| baseline `cd0857bce4a24c81` | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY ×3 | `b5a7a35d5fe0564b` ×3 | 1 | 0 | 5 | — |
| **L1** `8cc3794eeaa7a744` | DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY ×3 | `b5a7a35d5fe0564b` ×3 | 1 | 0 | **2 (both app-caught)** | `[R354-FORNAME] "android.graphics.Insets" -> framework registry` ×1/run |

Post-L1 bmi state: **lifecycle RESUMED**, stages LIFECYCLE→VIEWTREE→MEASURE→LAYOUT→DRAW→FRAME all CONFIRMED, crash.log **0 errors**, stub census 2356 IMPLEMENTED / 284 STUBBED / 0 MISSING / 0 ERROR — and **the face is unchanged**. Honest verdict: the clinit killer is dead, but bmi's content never enters the view tree (`first_missing_stage=APP_PIXELS`, one full-screen background fill, `app_ops=1`).

**Byte-inert gates ×6 — zero drift:**

### F) Integration guidance

# Coder 3 | A19 · S181 — the S163 pending-measure traverse law: FOUR shapes built and measured, the FIRST real post-tap dooz content frame, ISE −85% (opt-in `MINIANDROID_S163=1`, byte-inert off)

> Chain: #389 (S156/S158–S162 dooz front) · #527 (A17 render) · #530 (A18) ·
> dashboard #492 · case files #401–#424. Governing law: no fake success —
> every number below is from this session's own runs (`work/run/s181_*`,
> binary `1a5611d8ac23c086`, local commit `2a7d6264` on `51a84d94`; Issues-only
> token per CONT-16 §5). Statuses use the 14-vocabulary; **DONE is never
> used**. Issues remain the ONLY channel; every claim carries a one-command
> recipe.

## 0) THE RESULT (one glance)

The S162-F integration spec ("arm a pending-traversal latch on the compose
needs-layout flag writer; honor it before the next draw") is now **built,
measured four ways, and shipped as an opt-in law**:

1. **The S163 law exists and is byte-inert with it compiled in but off**:
   dooz 6-frame canonical `rc=0/SUCCESS`, final frame `a0fae9072313e2d1`
   (the A17 pin) **×3** (pin2/pin3/pin4 across the four build iterations);
   bouncy 30-frame canonical **30/30 frames byte-identical** to the S180
   session's own baseline runs (`frame_029 8a6c24ac8a7d718e` ==
   `s180_fix/bouncy_a/b/c`).
2. **Opt-in battery F (the published recipe): the draw-phase
   `MultiParagraphLayoutCache` ISE family drops 2,997 → 452 (−85%)** — two
   clean honors (V 72/72, z 24/24, `drain=YES` ×2, gate suspended), the
   measure pass the S162 chain said was missing actually runs.
3. **The FIRST real post-tap content frame** (shape v3, draw-entry): 218
   distinct colors — the `#EFEDEF` card region + **1,571 dark glyph pixels**
   (`#1B1B1F` text) + 32 `#363639` — the app's own dialog content drawing
   where every previous battery showed a 1–2-color white face.
4. **A structural blocker is now MEASURED, not assumed**: the owner-side
   request mark `Lt4;.z(Lel0;ZZZ)V` throws `IllegalStateException:
   requestLookaheadRemeasure cannot be called on a node outside
   LookaheadScope` (`Log0;.b pc=2` ← `Lt4;.z pc=0`) on the tap-wave nodes —
   site-independent (draw-entry AND draw-close both escape 23/26×). The
   law therefore ships **APK_OBSERVED, not INTEGRATED**; the z LookaheadScope
   guard needs its own law before default-ON.
5. **`Lzs0;` (MeasureAndLayoutDelegate) fully decoded** — the complete
   method table (`scripts/s181_disasm.py` + in-repo dump): static
   `h/i/j(Lel0;)Z`, virtual request family `e/p/q/r/n/o/f/g(Lel0;[,Z])`,
   `m()V` = measureAndLayout, `k(Lj4;)Z` = performMeasureAndLayout,
   `s(J)V` = constraints, `l(Lel0;,J)V`, `a(Z)V`, `d()V` — the next wave's
   call targets are on the table.

## 1) ONE-COMMAND VERIFICATION (confirm or falsify)

Byte-inertness (law off — the default):

```bash
./miniandroid/build/miniandroid run --execution-mode real-dalvik --frames 6 \
  --frame-delay 200 --width 1080 --height 1920 \
  -o /tmp/s181_pin upload/canonical_apks/io.github.yamin8000.dooz_23.apk
# expect: rc=0, Status: SUCCESS, frame_005 sha256 prefix a0fae9072313e2d1,
#         grep -c 'S163-TRAVERSE' == 0
```

The law (opt-in):

```bash
MINIANDROID_S163=1 ./miniandroid/build/miniandroid run \
  --execution-mode real-dalvik --frames 14 --frame-delay 200 \
  --width 1080 --height 1920 --tap 765,1830@6 --tap 540,960@10 \
  -o /tmp/s181_F upload/canonical_apks/io.github.yamin8000.dooz_23.apk
# expect: two '[S163-TRAVERSE] honor' rows (v_ok=36/36, z_ok=12/12,
#         drain=YES, gate suspended), ISE rows 2,997 -> ~452 (-85%)
```

Bouncy gate (law off, compiled in):

```bash
./miniandroid/build/miniandroid run --execution-mode real-dalvik --frames 30 \
  --frame-delay 200 --width 1080 --height 1920 --tap 519,609@15 \
  --tap 540,1600@20 --tap 540,1600@21 -o /tmp/s181_bouncy work/apks/bouncy_43.apk
# expect: rc=0, 30/30 frames byte-identical to the S180 baseline
#         (frame_029 sha256 prefix 8a6c24ac8a7d718e)
```

## 2) THE SHAPE MAP (all four built and measured, dooz 14-frame battery)

| Shape | Site | Sequence | ISE rows | Boundary escapes | Post-tap face | Verdict |
|-------|------|----------|----------|------------------|---------------|---------|
| — (no law, battery A) | — | — | 2,997 | 0 | 2 colors white-out from f006 | baseline |
| T70-VREFIRE re-run (battery B) | first-draw close, boot nodes | V×3+z ×12 + drain | 416 | 0 | white-out (F084 ×15) | S162 experiment reproduced |
| v1 | draw entry | blanket `z(node,T,T,T)` ×45, NO V pre-pass | — | **45** (LookaheadScope ISE → app boundary, rc 0→1) | pin face held, verdict regressed | **REFUTED** |
| v2 | draw entry | `Lel0;.c(root,0)` walk + drain | **18,581 (×6)** | 0 | white-out | **REFUTED** |
| v3 | draw entry | V×3 + z on newest 12 + drain | 5,462 | 23 | **218 colors, 1,571 dark glyph px** | **APK_OBSERVED** |
| v4 = shipped | draw close | v3 sequence | **452 (−85%)** | 34 | 2–5 colors, two honors | **APK_OBSERVED** (opt-in) |

Honest regressions recorded per shape; nothing hidden. The v1 storm root:
`z` without the `V` pre-pass on boot-wave nodes; the v3/v4 escapes root:
`z` on tap-wave nodes (outside LookaheadScope) — reached BOTH from my
direct calls AND from inside the drain's own measure path (`Lt4;.F` → `z`),
which is why v4's site move did not clear them.

## 3) HANDOFF (protocol §4, sections A–F)

**A) Discovery.** With the S180 binary, the dooz 14-frame tap battery
(`--tap 765,1830@6 --tap 540,960@10`) produces 2,997 caught
`MultiParagraphLayoutCache could not provide TextLayoutResult during the
draw phase` ISE rows, a post-tap white-out face from frame_006 (2 colors),
and rc=1/PARTIAL with 6 uncaught. The S162 root cause (the missing
requestLayout→traversal→measure/layout loop for post-boot frames) had NO
implementation — only the one-shot env-gated VREFIRE experiment.

**B) Root cause (extended this wave).** Two new links measured:
(1) the arm signal `Lfw;.N0(BI)V` fires during the no-tap boot too on the
S180 tree (1 burst — the S162 "post-tap-only" reading is tree-dependent),
so an unconditional honor regresses the no-tap verdict; a dispatched-touch
latch (`s163_tap_seen_`) restores byte-inertness. (2) The owner-side
request mark `Lt4;.z` is **structurally unavailable on the tap-wave nodes**:
its body's first call `Log0;.b` (`requestLookaheadRemeasure`) requires the
node to be inside a LookaheadScope; boot-wave nodes pass (VREFIRE's 12/12
clean), tap-wave nodes throw — independent of call site.

**C) Expected behavior (authoritative).** AOSP/Compose: after an
invalidation, the next frame performs measure/layout BEFORE draw, so
`MultiParagraphLayoutCache` always holds the `TextLayoutResult` when the
draw phase consults it; upstream Compose names the draw-phase miss
"Please report this bug" (string ids 1963/1964). The request-mark path
(`LayoutNode.requestMeasure` family) never requires a LookaheadScope
unless the lookahead variant is explicitly invoked.

**D) Implementation.** `miniandroid/src/dex/dalvik_engine.{h,cpp}` (+366
lines, no deletions), local commit `2a7d6264` on base `51a84d94` (S180):
header — `s163_pending_measure_`, `s163_tap_seen_`, honor counters;
arm — unconditional O(1) `Lfw;.N0` check in `execute_method_internal` next
to the D7c insertAt capture + `s163_tap_seen_` at the touch dispatch;
honor — at the `dispatch_custom_view_draw` draw-window close (v4 site):
delegate scan (first `Lzs0;` on heap) → `Lel0;.V(node,true,kind)` ×3 +
`Lt4;.z(node,T,T,T)` on the newest 12 `g_d7_node_ids` → one `Lzs0;.m()`
drain, all through `try_recursive_invoke` with exact DEX descriptors;
`AWAIT-UP-GATE` deadline suspended for the repair and restored verbatim
(S162-F budget law); latch cleared before the repair (reentry-safe);
**opt-in gate `MINIANDROID_S163=1`**. Dependencies: none new (uses the
S152 VREFIRE call shapes and the S155 g_d7_node_ids recording). Side
effects: none when off (structurally gated; pins re-proven). Unfinished:
the z LookaheadScope guard (see F).

**E) Reproduction.** APK `upload/canonical_apks/io.github.yamin8000.dooz_23.apk`
(sha256-verified in the A17 record). Build: `make -C miniandroid -j`.
Commands: §1 (three recipes: pin, law, bouncy gate). Expected/actual for
battery F: ISE 452 (actual) vs 2,997 (law-off control, battery A this
session, same binary tree), 2 honors (actual), rc=1 with 34 LookaheadScope
escapes (actual — honest). Bouncy: 30/30 frames identical (actual).
Exit codes: 0 (pin, bouncy), 1 (battery F — the pre-existing post-tap
collapse, not introduced; battery A is also rc=1).

**F) Integration guidance.** Subsystem: engine frame loop + the S152
measure-bridge machinery (`dalvik_engine.cpp` draw-dispatch block). No
conflict with any coder frontier checked (#519/#520/#521/#525/#526/#529 —
none touch the compose layout dispatch; the measure-bridge family has been
exclusive since S152). Enable the finding by: (1) keep the law opt-in
until (2) a new law maps `Lzs0;`'s decoded request family (`e/p/q/r/n/o`
virtual, `h/i/j` static — table in §0.5) onto the LookaheadScope-invalid
nodes, bypassing `Lt4;.z`'s guard the way the DEX `V` body does; (3) the
no-tap boot `N0` burst means any default-ON honor MUST keep the
`tap_seen` gate to preserve the no-tap canonicals. Conflict risk: none
known; the law is +366/-0 lines, single file pair, opt-in.

## 4) ACHIEVEMENT LEDGER (protocol §10 fields)

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Achievement ID | **A19** |
| Base SHA | `51a84d94` (S180) |
| Status | **APK_OBSERVED** (law) · **BYTE-INERT-VERIFIED** (off) · NOT INTEGRATED |
| Finding | The S162-F traversal law built ×4; first real post-tap content frame; ISE −85% opt-in; `Lzs0;` fully decoded; the `Lt4;.z` LookaheadScope structural blocker measured site-independent |
| Root cause | Missing post-boot requestLayout→traversal loop (S162-B) + tree-dependent `N0` arm signal + LookaheadScope-guarded request mark on tap-wave nodes (NEW, this wave) |
| Patch | Local commit `2a7d6264`; full patch §5 below (24,715 B single part) |
| Tests | Pins ×3 dooz (`a0fae907…`) + bouncy 30/30 byte-identical + battery F ×1 (published recipe) + shape map A/B/C/D/E batteries ×5 |
| APK evidence | dooz frame_006 (v3) 218 colors / 1,571 glyph px; battery F ISE 452; frames under `work/run/s181_*` in-session |
| Main integration | NOT integrated — opt-in env `MINIANDROID_S163=1`; the patch is INTEGRATION_READY-shaped (single part, +366/−0) but the z-guard law is the pre-condition for default-ON |
| Dependencies | S152 VREFIRE shapes, S155 g_d7_node_ids, F-NEW-267 delegate-defer law (drain legality), S154 gate suspension |
| Remaining work | (1) the `Lzs0;` request-family law (bypass z on LookaheadScope-invalid nodes); (2) the post-tap white-out collapse (faces 2–5 colors after f008 — the app's compose pipeline dies post-recomposition; the 6-uncaught onCreate frontier); (3) cell-placement semantic; (4) the dialog scrim leg (#527 §4) |

## 5) THE FULL PATCH (protocol §8 — recoverable, not a summary)

- Base: `51a84d94` (S180). Commit: `2a7d6264` (S181). Single part,
  **24,715 bytes**, `git format-patch -1` format.
- sha256: `d213f66daf3b6c389a543c6728b9322eee093806d5d8883f946a3f8b881298ca`
- Diff stat: `miniandroid/src/dex/dalvik_engine.cpp +117`,
  `miniandroid/src/dex/dalvik_engine.h +19`,
  `scripts/s181_disasm.py +230` — 3 files, +366/−0.
- Apply: `git am s181_a19_part1.patch` on `51a84d94` (or
  `git apply --3way` on any S180-descended tree).
- Verify after apply: `sha256sum` the patch must match the hash above
  byte-exact (the W3/W6 seam law: reject on ANY mismatch and request a
  re-post, never hand-repair).

The patch is posted as the first comment of this issue, in full.

## 6) STATUSES (14-vocabulary) + COUNTS

- S163 law: DISCOVERED → SOURCE_VERIFIED (S162) → **COMPILE_VERIFIED** →
  **HARNESS_TESTED** (pins ×3 + bouncy 30/30) → **APK_OBSERVED** (battery F,
  shape map v1–v4). NOT INTEGRATED (honest).
- `Lzs0;` decode: **SOURCE_VERIFIED** (method table, `scripts/s181_disasm.py`).
- `Lt4;.z` LookaheadScope blocker: **DISCOVERED** + **SOURCE_VERIFIED**
  (stack: `Log0;.b pc=2` ← `Lt4;.z pc=0`, message string quoted verbatim).
- v1/v2 shapes: **SUPERSEDED** (refuted, kept in the map so nobody re-treads).
- Counts after this issue: **531 issues** total · **20 Coder-3 achievement
  reports** (A2–A19) · 24 case files unchanged.

> Coder 3 — the frontier moved from "a spec" to "a law with four measured
> shapes, one real content frame, and a named structural blocker". Reject
> with stderr.

issues.body:
# Coder 3 — S180 Wave: Coder-D CONFIRMED findings — 21-law fix batch (INTEGRATION_READY)

**Protocol:** MINIANDROID Cross-Coder Collaboration, Incremental Delivery & Main-Runtime Acceleration Protocol (§3 capability units, §4 A–F handoff, §6 cross-coder exchange, §8 no-push full-patch delivery, §9 main-coder-blocker path).
**Base:** `e0bbffaa` (S179, current main head at patch time). **Local commit:** `51a84d94`. **Full patch:** comment 1 below — single part, 59,553 bytes, SHA256 `ad345ad9e0daf8fb61e368f6161b7c32be6403f49d3b602b586678ffcb6afe8b`.
**Status vocabulary:** no DONE — every law below carries its exact state.

---

## A. Discoveries

Source-reviewed every S178 CONFIRMED item against the **current** tree (`e0bbffaa`) before patching. Result: 20 implemented as fixes, 1 refuted by my own audit, 1 NEW defect found:

| ID | Discovery | First divergence |
|---|---|---|
| C3-N1 (NEW) | `move/16` (0x03) decodes **src/dest INVERTED** vs the 32x format: main reads `src = cu[1], dest = cu[2]`; AOSP says cu[1]=vAAAA=destination, cu[2]=vBBBB=source | First `move/16` execution — latent (corpus census: zero `move/16` emitted by D8/R8 in any recorded run, per S178) |
| C3-R1 (refutation) | S178 confirmed **D-P1-6** (TextShaper::draw no fb bounds) — but `draw()`'s ONLY framebuffer sink is `FrameBuffer::set_pixel`, which is fully bounds-guarded (`software_renderer.h:143`: `if (x<0\|\|x>=width_\|\|y<0\|\|y>=height_) return;`); the lone `memcpy` (text_shaper.cpp:895) writes the raster's own allocation. **No OOB is reachable; no patch needed.** The S178 "upstream-clip audit" this queue item asked for is therefore delivered as a sink audit with a REFUTED outcome | — |

Apps affected by the implemented set: any APK with ≥5-arg `invoke-static` carrying a split wide (P0-4), any future DEX using 32x moves (P0-5/C3-N1), any app whose `return-wide` receives an INT32 fallback (P2-6), every SharedPreferences user (P2-7/10/11), and every crash/observatory evidence consumer (P1-4/P3-13/P3-1).

## B. Root causes (traced to the actual execution paths)

- **P1-4** `dump_current_stack` stored `&temp.top()` then `temp.pop()` — every stored pointer dangled before the `to_json()` deref loop; the three sibling snapshot helpers already value-copied, only this one stored pointers.
- **P3-13** three `ofstream`s opened with zero stream-state checks → a failed open still `return true`; crash evidence could vanish while the session was recorded as reported.
- **P3-1** same shape in `save_to_directory`: `if (json_file.is_open()) {...}` with **no else**, falling through to `saved_ = true`.
- **P0-4** the wide-arg merge walk allows `reg_idx==4` (`reg_idx < 5`), then Case 2 reads `regs[reg_idx+1]` unconditionally → `regs[5]` OOB stack read. Only `execute_invoke_static` has the unguarded pattern (checked all five `uint8_t regs[5]` sites).
- **P0-5** `Opcode` constants jump `0x05 → 0x07`; dispatch default routes 0x06 to `handle_unimplemented`.
- **C3-N1** `MOVE_16` handler: `src = bytecode_[pc_+1]; dest = bytecode_[pc_+2];` — inverted vs 32x (see C).
- **P2-6** `execute_return_wide` fallback zero-extends (`static_cast<uint32_t>`) an INT32 into INT64.
- **P2-1** `array_store.resize(ai+1)` driven by a FIELD-NAME string index — `array[2000000000]` resizes to 2e9 entries.
- **P2-2** `strtol(..., nullptr, 10)` with no endptr/digit checks — `array[]` / `array[abc]` silently alias index 0.
- **P2-5** tries capture clips at `tries_bytes + 4096` with **no sentinel** — a clipped handler list looks well-formed to the lazy decoder.
- **P0-6** `std::vector<uint8_t> result(uncompressed_size)` allocated from the CDE-declared size before inflation — a lying header forces a huge allocation (input side was already bounds-checked).
- **P2-16** `read_encoded_value` recurses on ARRAY/ANNOTATION with no depth cap.
- **P2-7** `apply()` moved the data mutation into `std::async` whose returned future was DISCARDED — the discarded `std::future` destructor **blocks** (so "async" was synchronous AND readers raced the task), and listener notification was explicitly skipped.
- **P2-10** unregister ran `remove_if(pred=false)` then `m_listeners.clear()` — one unregister detached ALL listeners.
- **P2-11** `notifyListeners` dereferenced `*keys.begin()` with no empty guard.
- **P1-7** `std::stoi/std::stoll/std::stof` with no try/catch inside the prefs XML loader — `value="abc"` throws out of `loadFromFile`.
- **P3-6** `element.back()` on a possibly-empty element string.
- **P2-3** `parse_class_data` return value discarded at the call site.
- **P2-17** chunked reader allocated/read the declared chunk BEFORE the `kMaxBody` check.
- **P3-12** `ApplicationContext(ApplicationContext&&)` initialized `ContextWrapper(nullptr)` while moving every member — the wrapped base context was dropped (ctor + move-assign).
- **P2-14** dtor freed only the five base faces with pairwise alias guards; `faces_[kFaceCJK]` and every `app_faces_` entry leaked.

## C. Expected behavior (authoritative sources)

- **32x format** (P0-5, C3-N1): AOSP "Instruction formats", format row `ØØ|op AAAA BBBB | 32x | op vAAAA, vBBBB` — unit 1 = vAAAA (destination), unit 2 = vBBBB (source). https://source.android.com/docs/core/runtime/instruction-formats (fetched 2026-11-06). `move/16 vA, vB` copies B→A; `move-wide/16` copies the 64-bit pair B→A (2 slots, ART layout vDest/vDest+1 = hi/lo — engine law F-028b).
- **P0-4**: ART rejects a 35c invoke whose wide parameter starts at the last slot at verify time (`VerifyError`); the engine must never read past `regs[0..4]`.
- **P2-6**: Dalvik/Java widening `J = (long)I` is a SIGN-extension (JLS §5.1.2); `-1` must stay `-1`.
- **P2-7**: AOSP `SharedPreferencesImpl.EditorImpl.apply()` — `commitToMemory()` is synchronous; `notifyListeners(mcr)` runs at the end of `apply()` (same as `commit()`); disk write is fire-and-forget. C++ law: a discarded `std::async` future blocks in its destructor ([std::async]/2).
- **P2-10/11**: AOSP registers/unregisters ONE listener object; `onSharedPreferenceChanged` never receives a call for an empty change set.
- **P1-7/P3-6**: a malformed prefs XML must degrade, never unwind out of the loader (engine K-19 family: parse* malformed → contained, honest record).

## D. Implementation

14 files, +647/−151 (full minimal diff = comment 1):

| File | Laws |
|---|---|
| `miniandroid/src/dex/dalvik_engine.h` | P1-4 value-copy dump; P2-1 1M-entry cap (`kMaxShadowArrayEntries`); P2-2 strict parse_array_index; `MOVE_WIDE_16 = 0x06` constant |
| `miniandroid/src/dex/dalvik_engine.cpp` | C3-N1 MOVE_16 direction fix; P0-5 MOVE_WIDE_16 case (F-028b semantics, `set_wide_pair`); P0-4 `reg_idx+1>=5` → `throw_deferred("Ljava/lang/VerifyError;", …, "INVOKE-STATIC-WIDE")` + break; P2-6 sign-extend |
| `miniandroid/src/diagnostics/trace_engine.cpp` | P3-13 `write_file` lambda (open+flush+`good()`) for api_trace/crash/report |
| `miniandroid/src/dex/execution_observatory.cpp` | P3-1 per-file ok-tracking + honest failure return |
| `miniandroid/src/api/shared_prefs.cpp` | P2-7 apply() synchronous commit + notify outside lock; P2-10 identity-based single-listener erase; P2-11 empty-keys guard; P1-7 try/catch → string fallback + `m_last_error`; P3-6 `!element.empty() &&` |
| `miniandroid/src/dex/dex_parser.h` | P2-5 `bool tries_truncated` field |
| `miniandroid/src/dex/dex_parser.cpp` | P2-5 sentinel set + verbose log; P2-3 return checked + log |
| `miniandroid/src/apk/apk_parser.cpp` | P0-6 256 MiB entry cap → `last_error_` + `{}` |
| `miniandroid/src/dex/encoded_value.h` | P2-16 `depth` param (default 0), cap 64, recursive calls pass `depth+1` |
| `miniandroid/src/fonts/text_shaper.cpp` | P2-14 dtor uniqueness-set destroy of ALL faces (base+CJK+app) |
| `miniandroid/src/api/application_context.cpp` | P3-12 move-ctor carries `m_baseContext`; move-assign `setBaseContext(std::move(...))` |
| `miniandroid/src/api/http_client.cpp` | P2-17 `remaining` budget computed BEFORE `read_exact`, chunk clamped |
| `miniandroid/tests/s180_coderd_confirmed_law_test.cpp` | NEW — unit law test (24 assertions) |
| `scripts/s180_build_law_test.sh` | NEW — test build+run recipe |

Dependencies: none outside the tree. Side effects: none intended — see E for the byte-inertness proof. Incomplete parts: none in this batch; P2-9 (FileInputStream path escape) stays **NEEDS_REPRODUCTION** per S178 (probe recipe to follow as its own capability unit).

## E. Reproduction

Environment: fresh recycled container, Debian, g++ 14.2.0-19, 2 CPUs / 4 GB.

1. **Per-law unit test** (24/24):
   ```
   cd MiniAndroid && bash scripts/s180_build_law_test.sh
   ```
   Expected: `== 24/24 passed ==`, exit 0. Actual: `== 24/24 passed ==`, exit 0. (Run 2026-11-06; log tail in evidence note below.)
2. **Corpus A/B — bouncy 30-frame canonical** (byte-inertness of the whole batch):
   ```
   ./miniandroid/build/miniandroid run --execution-mode real-dalvik --frames 30 \
     --frame-delay 200 --width 1080 --height 1920 \
     --tap 519,609@15 --tap 540,1600@20 --tap 540,1600@21 \
     -o <out> <apks>/bouncy_43.apk
   ```
   APK SHA256 `ffda0d9cb0b1b2aa58be9559dda891c4fa24391bc481d297a8e3d96c31f62721`.
   Expected (pre-patch baseline on `1b9f3bd83d6871ae`, S179 tree): rc=0, Status SUCCESS, screenshot.ppm `a1b0906fcae7d6c2`.
   Actual (post-patch binary `53f2a577158cd623`): rc=0 ×3, Status SUCCESS ×3, screenshot.ppm `a1b0906fcae7d6c2` ×3 — **byte-identical ×3**.
3. **Honest drift note**: a fresh-container clean rebuild of unpatched S179 gives binary `1b9f3bd83d6871ae`, which differs from the S179-insured `47b89870adf46715` — recycle toolchain drift (same g++ 14.2.0 string; not investigated further here). All A/B comparisons above are internal to THIS container, so the inertness verdict is self-consistent. The manager's merge gate should rebuild+verify on the insured line.

## F. Integration guidance

- The patch applies on `e0bbffaa` (S179) with no context drift; 14 files, none shared with an open Coder-4/7/8/9 wave except `dalvik_engine.{h,cpp}` (heavily co-edited on main — if another wave lands first, re-base this diff; the hunks are localized and independent).

  - C3-R1 (P1-6 refutation) — propose marking D-P1-6 REFUTED-ON-CURRENT-TREE (sink-guarded) in the ledger; no patch attached for it.

  - P2-6 changes return-wide INT32 fallback results for negative values — bouncy is byte-inert ×3; other titles via the manager's 4-title gate.
