## 2) THE 4 LAWS (each with the route, each dex/disassembly-grounded)

| # | Law | Route (file/function) | Broken face -> what it fixed |
|---|-----|----------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | **S141-A: GetMethodID answers the ContactListener dispatcher family** | `src/jni/dlopen_exec.cpp`, `jni_GetMethodID` (JNI spec slot 33, wired in `init_tables`) | The .so resolves 8 methodIDs at `World` construction; every one answered 0 (loud-unsupported stub) -> the wrapper's own guards (`if (beginContactID != 0)`) made callbacks a silent no-op - the exact reason #513's census never saw scoring. Law: resolve EXACTLY {beginContact/endContact `(J)V`, preSolve/postSolve `(JJ)V`} - the wrapper's guarded void-callback contract. The filter/ray family (`contactFilter`, `reportFixture`, `reportRayFixture`, `getUseDefaultContactFilter`) KEEPS the null answer: dex ground truth shows the game never calls `setContactFilter` and the APK's `World.contactFilter(JJ)Z` body dispatches on its null `contactFilter` field (NPE) - answering those methodIDs would break the proven A12/A13 physics face. Token = stable index into a permanent table (never 0), self-contained (name,sig) - the class token is never needed after resolution. |
| 2 | **S141-B: CallVoidMethodV (slot 62), not CallVoidMethod (61)** | `src/jni/dlopen_exec.cpp`, `jni_CallVoidMethodV` + shared `jni_CallVoidMethodV_impl`; slots 61/62 wired | First wiring used slot 61 (spec `CallVoidMethod`) -> ZERO callbacks fired. Disassembly of the APK's own .so: `_ZN7_JNIEnv14CallVoidMethodEP8_jobjectP10_jmethodIDz` builds a va_list (`movabs $0x3000000018` = gp_offset 24/fp_offset 48) and calls `*0x1f0(%rax)` = **slot 62 = CallVoidMethodV**. The V-variant now parses the foreign va_list per the token's signature (the family is all-`J`) and routes through the bridge. Slot 63 (A-variant, jvalue* ABI) stays an honest unsupported stub. |
| 3 | **S141-C: the receiver jobject carries the heap oid** | `src/jni/dlopen_exec.cpp`, `call_native` receiver slot | The receiver handed to natives was the anonymous token `0x500000000` (no object id) - the trampoline stores the receiver and calls back on it, so the bridge could never resolve WHICH World. Law: receiver = `0x500000000 | oid` (the same identity encoding object args already use). No native dereferences the token; GetObjectClass/NewGlobalRef semantics unchanged. |
| 4 | **S141-D: NewGlobalRef outlives the per-call arena + the engine bridge** | `jni_NewGlobalRef` (string boxes copied into a permanent leak registry - the wrapper itself leaks the worldClass ref: "we leak one global ref", World.java); `src/dex/dalvik_engine.cpp` registers `JavaCallbackBridge` once (`std::call_once`, next to the S139 float-array bridge) | `GetObjectClass` returns an arena-boxed class token; `NewGlobalRef`'s old identity return left the wrapper's static `worldClass` dangling after `arena_clear()`. The engine bridge executes `(oid, name, sig, jlongs)` via `try_recursive_invoke` on the receiver's RUNTIME class (ART virtual-dispatch law, F-074 semantics) - the APK's own dispatchers then forward to the game listener. |

---

## 3) THE DEX GROUND TRUTH (the #513 hypothesis, refuted and replaced)

#513 recorded: "*jniSetContactListener not in the run census*" as the
presumed missing registration. The dex says otherwise:

- `tools/s141_dex_call_sites.py` (new, in-tree) scans every code item's
  invoke sites: **nothing in this APK calls `jniSetContactListener`**, and
  the R8-optimized `World.setContactListener` is a **bare field store**
  (3 insns: `iput-object; return-void`) - the libGDX master design
  (`extensions/gdx-box2d .../World.java`: `setContactListener` = field
  store; the C++ `CustomContactListener` is installed around `jniStep` and
  `jniDestroyBody`; methodIDs resolved once inside `newWorld`).
- Registration was NEVER the gap; **callback delivery** was. The
  `CustomContactListener` trampoline (`BeginContact` at 0x3d040 in the
  shipped x86_64 .so) checks the global `beginContactID` and jumps to
  `_JNIEnv::CallVoidMethod` -> slot 62. With laws 1-4 the whole chain fires.
- Scoring route (dex): `Field` implements `ContactListener`;
  `Field.beginContact` is EMPTY (1 insn) in this build - the real logic is
  `Field.endContact` (52 insns: `ballWithBody` x2 + contact-list
  bookkeeping) consumed by `Field.processBallContacts` /
  `Field3Delegate.processCollision` -> `Field.addScoreWithAnimation` ->
  `GameState.addScore`; game-over chain = `removeBall -> doBallLost ->
  endGame`. The `WorldLayers.existingOrNewWorldForLayer -> setContactListener`
  site is the (now-understood) field-store registration.

## 1) THE FOUR CORPUS RE-JUDGEMENTS (root cause → law → file/function route)

### 1.1 simplestopwatch_26 — PARTIAL → **SUCCESS EXIT=0**

- **Symptom:** `ShowTime.setTheme pc=134` NPE'd
  (`ViewGroup.getChildAt on null`) → APP BOUNDARY unwind after a rendered
  first frame.
- **Root cause (bytecode-level):** the app does
  `(ViewGroup) findViewById(android.R.id.content)` and dereferences it. The
  ActivityShadow findViewById law searched the ViewShadow tree and answered
  `handled_null()` — PhoneWindow's content-parent frame DID NOT EXIST in the
  shadow tree, so the "never null on a live window" AOSP contract was
  violated.
- **New law S157-A (one-stable content frame):**
  `ViewShadow::ensure_content_frame(uint32_t app_root_id)` —
  `src/framework/android_shadows.{h,cpp}`. Three-step resolution
  (remembered identity → existing 0x01020002 node parenting the root →
  materialize `FrameLayout` with `android_view_id=0x01020002`, adopt the app
  root as child 0, preserve the old window edge). Render-safe by
  construction: `effective_content_root_()` keeps answering
  `content_view_id_`, so down-walks (render/tap) never traverse the new
  ancestor — only `getParent()` up-walks complete, exactly as AOSP.
- **New law S157-B (Activity-side delegation):**
  `ActivityShadow.dispatch findViewById` — `src/framework/android_shadows.cpp`
  (after the registry search) delegates `target_id==0x01020002` to the same
  content-frame law instead of `handled_null()`.

### 1.2 simplekeyboard_145 — PARTIAL → **SUCCESS EXIT=0**

- **Symptom:** `SettingsActivity.onCreate pc=17` NPE'd
  (`ViewParent.getParent on null`) — the app walks
  `getListView().getParent().getParent()` to mount its preference list.
- **Root cause:** `PreferenceActivity`/`ListActivity` had **no
  `getListView` handler** — the ancestry re-dispatch
  (`[S71-ANCESTRY] … for .getListView`) answered null; and the framework-
  boundary onCreate dispatch (`[F-NEW-471-RES-GAP]`) never inflates
  `list_content`, so no ListView existed at `android.R.id.list`.
- **New law S157-C (getListView contract):** `ActivityShadow.dispatch
  getListView` — ONE stable ListView node per activity instance
  (`activity_list_view_nodes_` map), mounted under the content frame at
  `android.R.id.list` (0x0102000b), real runtime class
  `Landroid/widget/ListView;`. Works even when `content_view_id_==0`
  (framework-boundary onCreate) because S157-A now materializes the
  frame+DecorView chain with a 0 root.
- **New law S157-D (window-chain completion):** the content frame is never
  an orphan — when it has no parent, a DecorView stand-in (`FrameLayout`,
  cast-safe) is materialized above it (AOSP PhoneWindow law: DecorView →
  mContentParent → content view).

### 1.3 tictactoe_3 — FAILURE → **SUCCESS status** (bounded, §5)

- **Symptom:** `AndroidGraphics.preserveEGLContextOnPause` reflected

    equally (keypad contract).
  - **S157-I (TableRow law):** cells split the row width equally

  - **S157-J (hit-box sync):** the draw pass syncs the computed absolute box
    back into the ViewShadow node when the node carries no measured geometry
    (AOSP performTraversals: touch targets are the laid-out views, never
    un-measured placeholders) — idempotent per frame, render-neutral.

```text
virtual  put(LLL)          code_off=0x537f0   ← 6-insn stub: return f(key, value, false)
virtual  f(LLLZ)           code_off=0x53828   ← putVal — THE STORAGE PATH of put()
virtual  get(LL)           code_off=0x53508
```

**Base:** `main` HEAD `7e35168` (S156 phase-3) · **Binaries:** pre-wave = this sandbox's rebuild of `w3_full.patch` @ 7e35168 → post-wave `264c1c4b2936312a` (sha16) · **APK pins unchanged:** TB `473b33da5963d0a4` · NC `c9ba2e85b13fee45` · TK `8154cabe67374f2e` · CB `96cf501a83e89284` (all four re-verified byte-identical today). **Patches:** `w4_full.patch` (W2+W3+W4 one stack, 1305 lines, sha16 `400fd006517603a8`, applies clean on `7e35168`) · `w4_wave.patch` (W4-only, sha16 `25b6353a80a7268e`, `git apply -p0` on a W3-applied tree) — both attached in the first comment.

Following required arguments are missing: Ljava/util/ArrayList;@4852` | message renders **`destination Destination(0x0). Following required arguments are missing: []`** — the app's own `NavDestination.toString()` DEX override now EXECUTES and the missing-args list renders as a real collection | **F-C4-564** (toString law) |
| **Nextcloud** | `DispatchingAndroidInjector.merge` `Class.getName` on null receiver; census 8111 | merge NPE still ×1 (root open, corrected analysis below); census 8111 → **8155**; reaches Toolbar measure/layout | — (correction recorded) |

## Law F-C4-565 — AOSP `ContextThemeWrapper.initializeTheme` CLONE law (the Tusky theme root)

**Root (DEX + ARSC + AOSP, all three verified this wave).** Tusky's manifest: `<application android:theme="@style/TuskyTheme">` (= `0x7f14039d`, Material3/AppCompat-descendant chain) but the LAUNCHER `MainActivity` overrides `android:theme="@style/SplashTheme"` (= `0x7f140205`). The SplashTheme chain (mined from the pinned APK's ARSC) is: `SplashTheme → Theme.SplashScreen → [Base...] → framework 0x0103012c (Theme.Material.Light.NoActionBar)` — **it contains ZERO AppCompat attrs**. `AppCompatDelegateImpl.createSubDecor` (appcompat 1.7.0 sources fetched) does:

```java
TypedArray a = mContext.obtainStyledAttributes(R.styleable.AppCompatTheme);
if (!a.hasValue(R.styleable.AppCompatTheme_windowActionBar)) {
    throw new IllegalStateException("You need to use a Theme.AppCompat theme (or descendant) with this activity.");
}
```

So why does a real device never throw? Because an Activity is a **ContextThemeWrapper over its base ContextImpl, and the base serves the APPLICATION theme** — AOSP `frameworks/base/core/java/android/view/ContextThemeWrapper.java` (android-14.0.0_r2, fetched this wave, L206-217):

```java
private void initializeTheme() {
    final boolean first = mTheme == null;
    if (first) {
        mTheme = getResources().newTheme();
        final Resources.Theme theme = getBaseContext().getTheme();
        if (theme != null) {
            mTheme.setTo(theme);          // ← the APPLICATION theme is CLONED in
        }
    }
    onApplyThemeResource(mTheme, mThemeResource, first);   // applyStyle(resid, true) on top
}
```

The engine's `set_activity_theme` built the fresh activity theme from the activity resid's **own parent chain only** (the in-code comment even said "no outer platform theme to clone here") — stripping every application-theme attr, so `windowActionBar` (0x7f04065b) was absent and the ISE fired **every launch**.

**Fix.** `ResourceRuntime::set_activity_theme`: (1) `resid==0` → resolve the application theme (AOSP `ActivityInfo.getThemeResource()` fallback); (2) seed the fresh theme with the `<application android:theme>` bag first (`setTo` clone, force-apply), THEN `applyStyle(activity resid, force=true)` on top. Application resid parsed once per APK and cached (F-094 string-ref fallback included). Live proof line from the run: `[F565-CLONE] activity resid=0x7f140205 seed(app-theme)=0x7f14039d SEEDED keys=819` (0x7f14039d = `TuskyTheme`, verified in the APK's ARSC).

**VERIFY (30 s, one command each):**
```bash

./build/miniandroid run --data-root <dr> --package com.keylesspalace.tusky -o /tmp/A --max-seconds 60
grep -c "You need to use a Theme.AppCompat theme" <A stderr>     # before: 2 · after: 0
MINIANDROID_F366_DIAG=1 ./build/miniandroid run ... -o /tmp/B ... # [F565-CLONE] ... SEEDED keys=819
# and the pixel truth: B's screenshot center pixel is (26,27,32) — the themed
# background — where the pre-wave face was WHITE (255,255,255).
```

**How to reject me:** revert the `set_activity_theme` hunk → the ISE count returns to 2 and the F565-CLONE line disappears. Blast radius honestly: this changes theme state for EVERY app with an application theme + activity override (that is AOSP behavior — the point of the law); anchor wall on your side before merging (battery absent in this sandbox, same caveat as W2/W3).

## S124 ACTIVATION — ship the framework `resources.arsc` (the engine already expects it)

The S124 FW-PACKAGE law (`ensure_framework_resources()`, `$MINIANDROID_FRAMEWORK_ARSC` / `miniandroid/framework_res/resources.arsc`) is fully wired — `ArscRouter::for_id` routes every `0x01xxxxxx` parent to the fw table — but **the table file has never been shipped**, so every theme chain ending in a framework style (like SplashTheme → `0x0103012c`) died at the terminus. This wave I provisioned the **real AOSP framework table from the official SDK platform-35 zip** (`https://dl.google.com/android/repository/platform-35_r01.zip` → `android-35/android.jar` → `resources.arsc`, package `android`, 17,156,616 bytes, **sha256-16 `3824fa97f8ce48b7`**):

```
MINIANDROID_FRAMEWORK_ARSC=<path>/framework_res.arsc ./build/miniandroid run --package com.keylesspalace.tusky ...
[S124-FWRES] framework-res table loaded: ... bytes=17156616 types=22      ← loads & parses
```

Measured effect on Tusky's SplashTheme bag: **8 keys (no fw) → 436 keys (fw)** — the whole framework Material chain resolves; with F-C4-565 on top: **819 keys**. Decision needed on your side (repo policy): commit the 17MB binary vs. commit a fetch script (below, 15 lines) vs. LFS. The engine behavior is identical either way once the file exists at any of the three searched paths.

```bash
# scripts/fetch_framework_res.py — or plain shell:
curl -sL -o /tmp/p35.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/platform-35_r01.zip
unzip -o -q /tmp/p35.zip 'android-35/android.jar' -d /tmp/p35
mkdir -p miniandroid/framework_res
python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, hashlib
z = zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/p35/android-35/android.jar')
arsc = z.read('resources.arsc')
assert hashlib.sha256(arsc).hexdigest()[:16] == '3824fa97f8ce48b7'
open('miniandroid/framework_res/resources.arsc','wb').write(arsc)
PY
```

## Law F-C4-564 — `StringBuilder.append(Object)`/`String.valueOf(Object)` must run the object's REAL `toString()`

**Root.** OpenJDK `AbstractStringBuilder.append(Object obj)` = `append(String.valueOf(obj))`, and `String.valueOf(Object)` = `(obj == null) ? "null" : obj.toString()` (both fetched this wave from openjdk/jdk master). The engine's `stringify_arg` fell straight to the `Class@oid` identity form for every non-String/non-box/non-enum object, so app exception messages rendered raw refs — the measured CB IAE read `missing: Ljava/util/ArrayList;@4852` where a device prints `[hostId]`.

**Fix (two parts, one law).**
1. `stringify_arg` OBJECT_REF fallback now dispatches the object's real `toString()`: **bridge collections** (ArrayList/LinkedList/HashSet/LinkedHashSet/Vector/Stack/ArrayDeque) render inline per OpenJDK `AbstractCollection.toString` (L450-464: `"["` + `", "`-joined + `"]"`, `"(this Collection)"` self-guard) from the canonical `array[i]` heap fields; **everything else** goes through `try_recursive_invoke(..., "toString", ...)` so DEX overrides execute (bounded depth 4; OpenJDK identity stays the last resort).
2. The ArrayList/List bridge gains a `toString` handler with the same law (direct `list.toString()` calls from DEX code).

**VERIFY (20 s):** run ConnectBot with the patched binary, then
`grep -m1 "Cannot set route" <stderr>` — **before:** `...for destination Landroidx/navigation/compose/ComposeNavigator$Destination;@4805. Following required arguments are missing: Ljava/util/ArrayList;@4852` · **after:** `...for destination Destination(0x0). Following required arguments are missing: []`. The `Destination(0x0)` form is the app's OWN `NavDestination.toString()` DEX override executing (new fan-out), and `[]` is the collection law (see correction #2 below for why the list is empty-but-throwing).

**How to reject me:** revert the `stringify_arg` hunk → the message returns to `@4805`/`@4852` identity forms. Low blast radius: identity rendering is retained as the final fallback; nothing that previously rendered correctly changes.

---

## Two honest corrections to W3 records (both upstream-verified this wave)

1. **NC `Preconditions` IAE — my W3 interpretation was WRONG.** W3 called it "an engine String.format validation gap — dagger's multi-%s template is legal". I fetched Dagger's real runtime source (Maven Central `com.google.dagger:dagger:2.51.1-sources.jar`, `dagger/internal/Preconditions.java`): Dagger's `checkNotNull(ref, template, arg)` **legitimately throws** `IllegalArgumentException("errorMessageTemplate has more than one format specifier")` when `ref == null` AND the template carries >1 `%s`. So the IAE is Dagger being Dagger; **the true root is upstream of it — the null reference that reached checkNotNull** — and the surviving `DispatchingAndroidInjector.merge` pc=49 NPE (`entry.getKey().getName()` on a null key, per `dagger-android-2.51.1` sources `merge()` = `for (entry : classKeyedMap.entrySet()) merged.put(entry.getKey().getName(), ...)`) is the same family: **the engine's map iterator hands out a null key for Class-valued keys**. W5 root candidate: how `ImmutableMap`/`Map$Entry.getKey` materialize CLASS_REF keys stored by the W3-law-561 put-loop.
2. **CB NavDestinationBuilder IAE — the throw itself is still an engine divergence, and the DEX now tells us exactly where.** Disassembled `NavGraphKt$$ExternalSyntheticLambda0.invoke` (CB classes.dex): the `console/{hostId}` destination declares `navArgument("hostId") { type = NavType.LongType; defaultValue = <Long> }` — the DSL lambda (`TerminalKt$$ExternalSyntheticLambda2`) carries a `Long.valueOf` default-value arm. With a default, `hostId` is NOT required on a device → `missingRequiredArguments` returns empty → no IAE. Post-W4 the engine renders the missing list as `[]` **yet the IAE still throws** — so either the `NavArgument` default-value state is lost (fields land in R8-merged field names — remember the W3 R8 horizontal-merge knowledge law) or the bridged `ArrayList.isEmpty()` answers false on an empty list. One-line device probe + a W5 trace of `missingRequiredArguments` (androidx `BundleKt`, present in the CB DEX) settles which.

## New frontiers after W4 (hash-pinned stderr, one grep each)

| App | New first-divergence | stderr sha16 | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| **TK** | `MainActivity.onCreate` pc=71 NPE `Lkg/e;.d` on null receiver + `Lte/r;.get` NPE (TuskyApplication chain) + `Llk/f;.<init>` ARR-LEN-NULL + `Lbl/f;.B0` `String.length` NPE — the app now dies INSIDE app logic (past the theme wall); also `java.nio.file.Files` CNFE at `Lblk;.<clinit>` (cross-ref: same family as Coder-5's #500 JAVA NIO2) | `b42c46ef02e74ff6` | APP_PIXELS |
| **CB** | conscrypt `JNI_OnLoad` SIGSEGV vs the minimal JavaVM bridge (FIX-TTT contains, lib unloaded) — the surviving #1 arrest; then the NavArgument state question above | `473624c1fe270c0a` | APP_DRAW_OPS |
| **TB** | Koin `NoDefinitionFoundException` ×33 unwinding from `Scope.resolveInstance` ← `BaseApplication$special$$inlined$inject$default$1.invoke` ← `ThunderbirdApp.attachBaseContext` — which Koin module fails to register needs the W5 trace | `687234d962620185` | APP_DRAW_OPS |
| **NC** | `DispatchingAndroidInjector.merge` pc=49 `Class.getName` null receiver (map-key materialization root above) + `MainApp.onCreate` pc=5 `javax.inject.Provider.get` on null (incomplete injection fan-out) | `b7fe382dca713f99` | APP_PIXELS |

## Honest caveats

External-APK corpus absent in this sandbox (S153 purge — same as W2/W3): the 99/99 regression battery + anchor wall must run on your side before merge. F-C4-565 changes theme resolution for every app with an application theme (its purpose — AOSP parity); F-C4-564 only ADDS toString dispatch where identity rendering used to be. The framework_res table is an ASSET decision (17MB, Apache-2.0, official Google artifact) — engine-side nothing changes until the file exists.

# Coder 3 | Achievement 12 — S139: the APK's own `libgdx-box2d.so` now EXECUTES — real physics (ball launches, moves, collides), in-game table renders, 3× byte-identical

> Chain: #415 (master board) · #416–#420 (A1–A6) · #428 (A7) · #443 (A8) ·
> #469 (A9) · #471 (A10) · #508 (A11) · case file #403.
> Governing law: **no fake success** — every number below comes from this
> session's own runs (`/tmp/s139_det{1,2,3}`, `/tmp/s139_p3..p6`, all
> reproducible with the recipe in §1). Issues remain the ONLY channel to the
> main coder; every claim carries a **one-command verification recipe**.

---

## 0) THE RESULT (one glance)

A11 (#508) closed with the honest gap: *Box2D ball physics idle — ball frozen
at the launch position*. This wave closes that gap at the architecture level:
**the runtime now executes the REAL `libgdx-box2d.so` shipped inside the APK**
(x86_64, 270,816 bytes, 267 JNI exports, dlopen'd at
`SharedLibraryLoader.load`) instead of fail-softing every physics native to 0.

1. **`World.newWorld` returns a REAL `b2World*`** — `.addr=140131126014480`
   (was fail-soft `0`). All 31 distinct gdx-box2d natives the game calls
   (32,138 calls / 30 frames) resolve via JNI mangling and execute the APK's
   own compiled physics: `jniCreateBody`, `jniCreateFixture`,
   `jniCreateRevoluteJoint` (flippers), `jniStep`, …
2. **The in-game table RENDERS for the first time** — walls, bumpers, lane
   guides, flippers, ball; GL present census `nonblack=55,680` stable
   (was `0` = black table on every frame).
3. **REAL GAMEPLAY MOTION, verified frame-by-frame** — the ball's white-blob
   centroid: static `(624,1033)` frames 4–16 → plunger tap @20 →
   `(637,1054)@20 → (923,1147)@22 → bounce → (749,815)@29` — a launch,
   travel, collision rebound, and gravity deceleration arc. That is Box2D
   step + collision response driving the render.
4. **Deterministic ×3**: 30/30 frames byte-identical across three runs
   (SHA-256, §3).

---

## 1) ONE-COMMAND VERIFICATION (confirm or falsify everything above)

```bash
# from the repo root, engine built at HEAD be9329b + this wave's tree:
for i in 1 2 3; do
  ./miniandroid/build/miniandroid run --execution-mode real-dalvik \
    --frames 30 --frame-delay 200 --width 1080 --height 1920 \
    --tap 519,609@15 --tap 540,1600@20 --tap 540,1600@21 \
    -o /tmp/s139_det$i work/apks/bouncy_43.apk
done
# PASS if ALL of the following hold:
#  a) rc=0 every run; 30 frames written per run
#  b) stderr HAS "[S139-PROBE] dlsym HIT short=Java_com_badlogic_gdx_physics_
#     box2d_World_newWorld @gdx-box2d" and has NO "[S2-NATIVE] guarded call
#     fault" row. NOTE: up to 20 capped "[JNI-UNSUPPORTED] …box2d — no
#     handler registered" rows are EXPECTED (the JNIBridge layer logs before
#     falling through to the real-library attempt; the real attempt then
#     answers — see Law 1's layering).
#  c) stderr HAS "[M3-LONG-PUT] field=…World;.addr … value=<nonzero>"
#  d) MINIANDROID_GFX_TRACE=1 rerun → gfx_trace.jsonl contains ZERO
#     "marshal.fail" rows and ≥100 "glBufferData" gl.call rows
#  e) last game frames carry "[S155-PRESENT] … nonblack≥55000"
#  f) sha256sum of the 30 frames identical across the 3 runs
#  g) opening /tmp/s139_det1/frames/frame_020.png vs frame_028.png shows the
#     white ball at different positions (launch → travel → rebound)
```

**Falsification**: any single criterion above failing = this issue is wrong;
re-open with the stderr + the differing SHA line.

---

## 2) THE 4 ROOT LAWS (each found by a live face, each with the route)

| # | Law | Route (file/function) | Broken face → what it fixed |
|---|-----|----------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | **S139-A: gdx-box2d real-library routing** | `src/dex/dalvik_engine.cpp`, native dispatch inside `try_recursive_invoke` — the `if (!JNIBridge::instance().invoke(...))` block (≈L12084) | `bridge_to_api`'s tail catch-all answers UNKNOWN app classes with fail-soft 0 **and returns true** — every `Lcom/badlogic/gdx/physics/box2d/*` native was silently zeroed BEFORE the #371 S-2 real-library attempt could run (`World.newWorld → addr=0` → no world, no physics, black table; S2-NATIVE DISPATCH/MISS lines never reached). Fix: prefix gate `class_descriptor.rfind("Lcom/badlogic/gdx/physics/box2d", 0)==0` skips the catch-all consult and falls straight to the real attempt; the UnsatisfiedLinkError law still guards a symbol miss. Every non-box2d native keeps the exact legacy layering. |
| 2 | **S139-B: MODERN 233-slot JNIEnv table** | `src/jni/dlopen_exec.cpp` — `kJniSlots` 181→233 + `init_tables()` rewiring | The old wiring used a truncated numbering (NewStringUTF@113, RegisterNatives@163, GetJavaVM@167…) that no Android-built library indexes. **Disassembly ground truth**: `objdump -d libgdx-box2d.so` at `Java_…Body_jniGetPosition` shows `call *0x6f0(%rax)` = vtable slot **222 = GetPrimitiveArrayCritical**, `0x6f8` = slot **223 = ReleasePrimitiveArrayCritical** — slots ≥181 read OUT OF BOUNDS before this fix. Rewired to the spec indices: 167 NewStringUTF, 168–170 string family, 171 GetArrayLength, 189/197 FloatArrayElements, 213 SetFloatArrayRegion, 215/216 RegisterNatives, 219 GetJavaVM, 222/223 critical pair, 228 ExceptionCheck. |
| 3 | **S139-C: engine-heap float-array bridge** | `src/jni/dlopen_exec.h/.cpp` — `FloatArrayBridge` + `set_float_array_bridge()`; `src/dex/dalvik_engine.cpp` — `std::call_once` registration in the native dispatch block | libGDX's position/velocity natives are `(J[F)V` — they write results INTO a `jfloatArray` through the critical/elements family. The Dalvik heap lives in the engine TU, so the JNIEnv slots (171/189/197/213/222/223) hand out a 256-float scratch and copy back through engine-heap `array[i]` element fields (length from `__array_length__`) on release. Serves `jniGetPosition`/`jniGetLinearVelocity`/`jniGetLocalPoint` — the game's per-frame ball readout. |
| 4 | **S139-D: NIO view-extent marshal law** | `src/framework/gl_surface_shadow.cpp` — the GLES20 argument marshal at the `array length unreadable` site | `chase_buffer` (F-NEW-508) resolves bouncy's direct-allocate FloatBuffer views to the F-NEW-463 `__bb_b<i>__` element runs, but the length probe used `get_object_array_length` — arrays only, NIO views have no `__array_length__` → **256/256 `glBufferData` marshal.fail** → 115 `glDrawElements` on empty buffers → black table despite a live renderer. Law: for `__BB_RUN__`/`__BB_BYTES__` the extent comes from the view's own `__bb_lim__` (fallback `__bb_cap__`). Result: 136 uploads OK, 0 fails, table pixels present. |

---

## 3) EVIDENCE (this session's own runs)

**Census before/after (30-frame canonical run):**

| Metric | Before this wave | After |
|--------|------------------|-------|
| `World;.addr` after `newWorld` | `0` (fail-soft) | `140131126014480` (real `b2World*`) |
| gdx-box2d natives executing | 0 of 31 | **31 of 31** (dlsym HIT on every census symbol) |
| `glBufferData` marshal.fail | 256/256 | **0** (136 OK uploads) |
| GL present `nonblack` | `0` (black) | **55,680** stable |
| Ball centroid (frames 4→29) | frozen `(624,1033)` | static → tap → `(923,1147)` → rebound → `(749,815)` |
| Determinism | — | **30/30 frames SHA-identical ×3** |

```
frame_020 a68eb17ad9ac1be1    frame_025 3f8b8563ef011184
frame_029 c8b60bbb16e002de    (all 30 identical across runs)
```

Ball centroid track (`/tmp/s139_det1/frames`, white-blob scan, px):

```

frame_020 (637,1054)   <- plunger tap @20
frame_024 (833,907)    frame_028 (767,818)    <- travel + rebound + gravity arc
```

Environment: HEAD `be9329bb` (S155) + this wave's worktree; binary
`miniandroid/build/miniandroid`; APK `bouncy_43.apk`
(SHA-256 `ffda0d9cb0b1b2aa…`); tool ground truth via `nm -D` +
`objdump -d` on the APK's own `libgdx-box2d.so`.

---

## 4) HONEST FRONTIER (what S139 does NOT claim)

- **Zoom/centering**: the in-game table renders ~2.4× larger than the
  playfield and offset (projection/viewport transform gap in the GL20
  renderer path) — the table is recognizable and playable-facing, but not
  yet pixel-framed like A11's menu thumbnail.
- **Wall color**: walls/bumpers draw white instead of the slate-blue
  `0x4040A0` family (per-element color uniform path).
- **Score**: stays `0` — bumper/rollover scoring not yet observed in 30

- These three are the **S140 frontier**, listed with the same

**Rubric update for #492**: render + interaction + real-physics gameplay
motion verified, deterministic ×3 → **E4+ → 90** (from 85), honest gap

# [W3] Coder-4 wave 3 — three verified laws + the full forensic map of all four frontiers

**Track:** `4APP4` · **Owner:** Coder-4 · **Epic:** #430 · **Wave log:** #436 (W2 → W3)

**Base:** `main` HEAD `be9329b` (S155) · **Binaries:** pre-wave `469c9e4c55df72bc` (S155+W2) → post-wave `ea23280497c9d21c` (S155+W2+W3) · **APK pins unchanged:** TB `473b33da5963d0a4` · NC `c9ba2e85b13fee45` · TK `8154cabe67374f2e` · CB `96cf501a83e89284`

## TL;DR

| App | Before W3 (at S155+W2) | After W3 | Law that moved it |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Nextcloud** | Dagger component build dies at 0-frame NPEs; 5,730 impl stubs | **Dagger DI graph builds end-to-end** (initDagger → inject → DispatchingAndroidInjector), 8,111 impl stubs, APP_PIXELS | **F-C4-561 + F-C4-562** |
| **ConnectBot** | SavedStateRegistry ISE arrest; 8,917 impl stubs | **Real androidx super chain executes** (24715 impl stubs, ~3×), ViewModel chain completes, reaches Jetpack Navigation-Compose nav-graph construction | **F-C4-563** |
| **Thunderbird** | feature-flag iget-null at 0 draw | **APP_DRAW_OPS** (window + pixels, draw-ops missing) | 563 + W2 stack |
| **Tusky** | WINDOW_ROOT + Theme.AppCompat ISE | same verdict — but the **entire theme chain is now mapped to the framework terminus with upstream citations** (forensic map below; the fix law is W4) | — |

All three laws are **live-verified on the four pinned titles** (before/after greps below, each one command). Corpus battery must run on your side (external APK corpus absent in this sandbox — S153 purge; honest caveat, same as W2).

---

## ⚠️ PROTOCOL FIX FIRST — W2 law-ID collision (you MUST know this before applying anything)

My W2 issue #506 named its nine laws `F-NEW-541..548`. **Those IDs were already taken** by the CONT-37/CONT-38 engine laws (`grep -rn "F-NEW-541" miniandroid/src/dex/dalvik_engine.cpp` at S155 HEAD returns 3 hits that are NOT mine — caller-site identity, live-heap census, re-entry budget). My W3 branch renames every W2 law to the **`F-C4-54x` namespace** (`F-NEW-541`→`F-C4-541` … `F-NEW-548`→`F-C4-548`, 28 occurrences). If you applied #506's patch verbatim, the comments now describe two different laws under one ID — apply `w3_full.patch` (below) on clean S155 instead; it contains W2 + the rename + W3 as one consistent stack.

## Law F-C4-561 — `java.util.Objects` identity family (the Nextcloud Dagger root)

**Root (bytecode-level, pinned in NC stderr `97105ed94132b557`'s predecessor run).** `MainApp.onCreate` → `initDagger` → `DaggerAppComponent$AppComponentImpl.injectMainApp` → `dispatchingAndroidInjectorOfObject` → `mapOfClassOfObjectAndProviderOfAndroidInjectorFactoryOfObjectBuilder` (put loop: `const-class` + `iget-object` + `ImmutableMap$Builder.put`) → `build` → `RegularImmutableMap.createHashTable`. Disassembly of `createHashTable` in `classes4.dex`:

```
PC=0x000a (10)  invoke-static  → Ljava/util/Objects;.requireNonNull   ← move-result-object at pc=13
PC=0x0012 (18)  invoke-static  → Ljava/util/Objects;.requireNonNull   ← move-result-object at pc=21
PC=0x0016 (22)  invoke-static  → Lcom/google/common/collect/CollectPreconditions;.checkEntryNotNull
```

OpenJDK truth: `Objects.requireNonNull(T)` **is the identity function** — it returns `obj` (NPE only when null). The engine had **zero** laws for `Ljava/util/Objects;` (verified: `grep -n '"requireNonNull"' miniandroid/src/dex/dalvik_engine.cpp` → 0 hits pre-wave). Every call fell to the typed-default null → both `move-result-object` slots read null → `checkEntryNotNull(null, null)` threw the recorded `NPE "null key in entry: null=null"` → **the entire Dagger component build died → the NC-M0.7 arrest from W2.**

**Fix.** One law site in the `bridge_to_api` chain covering the OpenJDK `Objects.java` surface: `requireNonNull`/`requireNonNullElse`/`requireNonNullElseGet` (pass-through + NPE contract, lazy Supplier message law), `toString(o[,def])` ("null" law), `hashCode`, `equals`, `hash`, `isNull`/`nonNull`, and the JDK-9 `checkIndex`/`checkFromToIndex`/`checkFromIndexSize` preconditions (IndexOutOfBoundsException messages verbatim).

**VERIFY (20 s, one command):** rebuild with `w3_full.patch`, run Nextcloud, then
`grep -c "null key in entry" <stderr>` — **before: 1; after: 0.** Bonus confirmation of the fan-out: the NC stub census jumps 5,730 → 8,111 IMPLEMENTED (the whole DI graph executes).

## Law F-C4-562 — AOSP `handleBindApplication` ORDER: Application instance BEFORE provider install

**Root.** NC `FileContentProvider.onCreate` → `AndroidInjection.inject(provider)` walks the provider's Context chain for `HasAndroidInjector`; the recorded pre-wave failure was `RuntimeException "android.content.Context does not implement dagger.android.HasAndroidInjector"` ×4 — the walk's receiver printed `Class.getCanonicalName → android.content.Context`, i.e. the engine handed providers **the bare Context singleton**, because `install_content_providers()` ran at `bind_manifest_application()` ENTRY — **before the Application object existed**. AOSP `ActivityThread.handleBindApplication` order is:

```java
app = data.info.makeApplication(false, mInstrumentation);          // 1. <init> + attachBaseContext
mInstrumentation.installContentProviders(app, data.providers);     // 2. providers get the APP as context
mInstrumentation.callApplicationOnCreate(app);                     // 3. app.onCreate AFTER providers
```

**Fix.** Move the `install_content_providers(result)` call from bind-entry to **after** Application `<init>` + `attachBaseContext` and **before** `onCreate` — on all three bind paths (custom class, default app, DEX-missing fallback). One ordering change, AOSP-cited in-code.

**VERIFY (20 s):** run Nextcloud, `grep -c "does not implement dagger.android.HasAndroidInjector" <stderr>` — **before: 4; after: 0.** Boot-order proof in the same stderr: the `[S1-PROVIDER] installed …` lines now appear AFTER `[R341-APP] instantiating Application … obj#253` (pre-wave they were lines 1001-1698, app line 1699).

## Law F-C4-563 — `F-C4-261x` androidx onCreate fall-through: DEFAULT FLIPPED ON (opt-out env)

**Root (re-measured at S155, A/B on the live title).** With the W2-default OFF, ConnectBot's `ComponentActivity.onCreate` never executes real DEX → `SavedStateRegistryController.performRestore` never runs → the registry's `mRestored` stays false → the first `SavedStateHandle` consumer throws the real-androidx ISE `"You can 'consumeRestoredStateForKey' only after the corresponding component has moved to the 'CREATED' state"` → 7 crash rows → APP-BOUNDARY death at `MainActivity.onCreate pc=221`.

**A/B evidence (both runs at S155+W2, this sandbox):** `MINIANDROID_F261X_LAW=1` run → ISE count **0**, and ConnectBot advances **past the whole ViewModel chain into real Jetpack Navigation-Compose** (`NavDestinationBuilder.build` IAE, depth 62 — the new frontier). Stub census 8,917 → **24,715** IMPLEMENTED (the androidx super chain now executes for every lifecycle-2.8+ app).

**Fix.** Default ON; opt-out restored with `MINIANDROID_F261X_LAW=0` (exact-string "0") for anchor reproduction. The in-code comment carries the full law history including the stale-F-NEW-262-premise analysis from W2.

issues.title: [4APP-S7][Coder-5] RXJAVA + COROUTINE SCHEDULING DEPTH — real executors/looper/dispatchers substrate (CONC-001 unblock)
issues.body:
## WHY
NewPipe is RxJava-native (extraction, list loading, players all run `Observable`/`Single`/`Flowable` chains); Material Files drives work through executors + coroutine-style async; Joplin's RN bridge is async-module based; Element X is coroutines/Flow-heavy. `CONC-001` marks coroutines UNTESTED — the **scheduling substrate** (real threads, real executors, real deferred queues) must behave before any of the four ladders can claim interactive state changes under load.

## SCOPE
- Executor family with real threads: `Executors.newFixedThreadPool/newSingleThreadExecutor/newCachedThreadPool`, `ScheduledExecutorService` (delay/period semantics), `Future`/`get` blocking + timeout, `ExecutorService.shutdownNow` interrupt law
- `Handler`/`Looper` async: `post`/`postDelayed`/`removeCallbacks` on a real looper loop (interaction with the existing choreographer/tap pipeline)
- RxJava scheduling contract (NewPipe-facing): `Schedulers.io/computation/single/trampoline`, `subscribeOn`/`observeOn` semantics, `Disposable` dispose, backpressure basics (`Flowable` onBackpressureBuffer/drop)
- kotlinx.coroutines dispatchers (Element X-facing): `Dispatchers.Default/IO/Main` mapping, `runBlocking`/`async`/`await`, `withContext` thread-switch law, `Mutex`/`Semaphore` basics, `Flow` cold-stream collect on a dispatcher
- Interruption + cancellation propagation: thread interrupt flags, `CancellationException` identity, cooperative-cancel checks

## ACCEPTANCE
Probe fixtures in `fixtures/`: (a) Rx chain emits deterministically ordered events across io→computation switch; (b) coroutine `async`/`await` counter reaches exact N under concurrency; (c) scheduled task fires at ≥ delay with correct order; (d) battery 99/99 ALL PASS + zero golden drift after each law lands; CONC-001 census moves UNTESTED → TESTED (depth scoped).

**Status: PENDING** — claimed only with evidence.

# Coder 3 | Achievement 11 — S138: the game starts, every present carries the full table

> Chain: #415 (master board) · #416–#420 (A1–A6) · #428 (A7) · #443 (A8) ·
> #469 (A9) · #471 (A10) · case files #21/#403.
> Governing law: **no fake success** — every number below comes from this
> session's own runs (`work/run/s138_det/d30_{1,2,3}`, `s138_det/full90`).
> User directive: *make the page load COMPLETE — not incomplete, not
> half-complete — COMPLETE.* Issues remain the ONLY channel to the main
> coder; every claim carries a **one-command verification recipe**.

---

## 0) THE RESULT (one glance)

The sandbox was recycled: the S154 engine tree existed only as the published
Issues. This wave **re-derived the entire S136+S137+S154 stack at the current
HEAD `7bbf087a`** (the post-slim + AWAIT-UP commit), then pushed through
**8 new laws** that the re-derive exposed. Result at HEAD + the recipe below:

1. **The full Vector Pinball table renders on EVERY present** — 33/33 GL
   presents carry `nonblack=116550 bluish=52588` (walls/bumpers/ball/flippers/
   launch lane in 7 distinct colors). The S154 flip-flop face
   (`112723 → 8 → 9710`, #471 §4) is **CLOSED**: per-present consistency is
   the natural state of the corrected stack, no pump rework needed.
2. **The game STARTS**: the Start-Game tap runs `doStartGame` through its
   `isPaused()` gate (unpause chain: F-NEW-515 window focus →
   `onWindowFocusChanged(true)` → `unpauseGame()` → `GameState.setPaused(false)`)
   and **18 × `isGameInProgress ret=TRUE`** land in the 30-frame run
   (79 × in the 90-frame run).
3. **The `GL20Renderer.doDraw` F084 halt is GONE**: 50001-visit wait-loop
   spins → **0 HALT rows** (the S138 monitor-wait yield law, §2 law 7).
4. Determinism holds: **3 runs × 30 frames, byte-identical final frame**
   (`90e7816cfee16cf5` ×3), 0 draw-guard refusals.

**Verification recipe (main coder, two commands):**

```bash
# (a) canonical battery (30 frames, Start-Game taps):
./miniandroid/build/miniandroid run --execution-mode real-dalvik \
  --frames 30 --frame-delay 200 --width 1080 --height 1920 \
  --tap 519,609@15 --tap 540,1600@20 --tap 540,1600@21 \
  -o /tmp/s138_check work/apks/bouncy_43.apk
# (b) 90-frame full session:
./miniandroid/build/miniandroid run --execution-mode real-dalvik \
  --frames 90 --frame-delay 200 --width 1080 --height 1920 \
  --tap 519,609@15 --tap 540,1600@30 --tap 540,1600@31 --tap 540,1600@45 \
  -o /tmp/s138_90 work/apks/bouncy_43.apk
```

**Confirm** = `frame_029.png` SHA256 starts `90e7816cfee16cf5` ×3 runs AND
`grep -c "isGameInProgress.*ret=TRUE"` ≥ 18 AND the `[S155-PRESENT]` rows
show `nonblack=116550 bluish=52588` on every post-GL present AND
`grep -c HALT-LOOP` = 0.
**Reject** = the SHA differs across runs, any present drops below 100,000
non-black, or the registered-shader lines
(`[GLES20-BRIDGE] registered C shader program: engine=1 pgl=1 kind=circle`
+ `engine=2 kind=line`) disappear → a regression; re-open with the stderr.

---

## 1) THE RE-APPLIED STACK (verified law-by-law against #443/#469/#471)

Every A8+A9+A10 law re-implemented at HEAD and re-verified live: F-243c/d/e,
F-NEW-507 (bouncy line/circle shaders as C programs — both register), the
GLES-constant translations (probe-verified against the shipped portablegl.h,
`scripts/pglconsts3.c`), F-NEW-508/509 (buffer-view chase + string content),
F-NEW-510..513 (bulk put, allocate capacity, base-declaration, view limit),
F-NEW-514 (Matrix: frustumM/orthoM/setLookAtM/multiplyMM/multiplyMV/
setIdentityM/translateM/scaleM — GL-spec column-major definitions),
F-NEW-515 (window focus: both resume paths + `hasWindowFocus()` shadow law),
S137/S154 draw-guards, store keying, offset-0-by-kind, elem-size,
index-VALUE law, GLSurfaceView ancestry gate + laid_out gate, nativeOrder.
Measured re-apply ground truth: `[PARSE]` rows **3757 = the S154 d30_1 count
exactly**; the F089 map-put key sequence
`delegate → ballcolor → ballradius → elements → … → launchPosition` matches.

## 2) THE 8 NEW LAWS (each found by a live face, each with the route)

| # | Law | Route (file/function) | Broken face → what it fixed |
|---|-----|----------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | **F-243a law-wide string identity** (re-apply completion) | `dex/dalvik_engine.cpp` F-243 block entry | My first re-apply missed it: `JSONObject(String)` args ride heap String objects; the STRING_REF-only `<init>` gate parsed `{}` → all 9 tables empty → `launchPosition` EMPTY_LIST → `Field.zoomCenterPoint` IndexOutOfBounds every tick. Fix: block-scope shadow unwraps EVERY heap-String arg to `__string_value__` once at the law boundary. Measured: full key sequence returns, PARSE rows 1→3757. |
| 2 | **F-243b no-arg length** (re-apply completion) | `dalvik_engine.cpp` JSONArray law | `length()` sat inside the indexed `args>=2` gate — never fired → every JSONArray→List empty → `Color.fromList` `IllegalArgumentException "Invalid color size: 0"` at APP BOUNDARY (onCreate died). Fix: dedicated no-arg arm. |
| 3 | **S155 ELEMENT-KIND** | `dalvik_engine.cpp` bulk-put | `IntBuffer.put(int[])` stored IEEE float bits — indices `0,1,2` crossed as `0.0f/1.0f/2.0f` bits (the `[S155-DRAW]` dump shows the exact bytes) → the index-VALUE guard read garbage → every wall draw refused. Fix: element kind by view type (Int/Short/Char/Long = raw; Float/Double = IEEE bits). |
| 4 | **S155 PGL OFFSET-SEMANTICS** | `gles/gles20_bridge.cpp` glVertexAttribPointer/glDrawElements | PortableGL (compatibility profile, `get_v_attrib`) expects the pointer arg to be the BYTE OFFSET against its own buffer copies when a buffer is bound — passing a real data pointer made PGL add a wild address to its internal store → SIGSEGV in `run_pipeline` (rc=139). Fix: `(const void*)(uintptr_t)off` for bound buffers; PGL owns the data (copied at glBufferData). |
| 5 | **S155 CLIENT-ARRAY LIFETIME** | `gles20_bridge.{h,cpp}` AttribBind + `framework/gl_surface_shadow.cpp` GlMarshal.plen | Client attrib pointers rode marshal holds that die with the call. Fix: the bridge copies client arrays at pointer time (bounded 1 MiB); the dispatch signature carries per-pointer byte lengths (`plens`); draws re-issue from the copy. |
| 6 | **S155 EXACT-FIT GUARD BOUND** | `gles20_bridge.cpp` draw-guard | `need=(max_idx+1)*stride+vsize` over-counted one stride: exact-fit wall meshes refused (`32*32+12=1036 > 1024` while the true bound is `31*32+12=1004 ≤ 1024`). Fix: `need = offset + max_idx*stride + vsize` (GL §2.8 exact fit). Measured: draw-guard refusals → 0. |
| 7 | **S138 MONITOR-WAIT YIELD** | `dalvik_engine.cpp` `Object.wait/notify/notifyAll` law | The app's render contract `doDraw → requestRender → while(!renderDone) renderLock.wait()` (FieldDriver game thread) spun 50001 visits → F084 halt every tick (the #469 honest gap 1). Fix: `wait()` parks the drained body via the F-110b sleep-yield mechanism; the frame pump's `onDrawFrame` lands `renderDone=true` + `notifyAll` between boundaries; the app's while-loop re-checks under Java's spurious-wakeup semantics. Measured: `[WAIT-YIELD]` rows, HALT-LOOP **0**. |
| 8 | **S138 NumberFormat family** | `dalvik_engine.cpp` Ljava/text/NumberFormat law | `ScoreView.formatScore` → `NumberFormat.getInstance()` null → NPE every draw + the tail APP-BOUNDARY unwind. Fix: getInstance family + `format(long)` thousands grouping + `format(double)` maxFractionDigits=3 (OpenJDK defaults). |

Diagnostics (all bounded): `[GLES20] <method> ni/np` first-two-calls census,
`[S155-PRESENT]` per-present census (nonblack/bluish at the real blit site),
`[S155-DRAW]` index-store dump, `[S155-PUMP]` gate census, `[WAIT-YIELD]`,
`[NOTIFY]`.

## 3) MEASURED STATE (this session's own artifacts)

**Canonical determinism battery** (30 frames, taps `519,609@15` + `540,1600@20/21`):

| Run | rc | Final-frame SHA256 (first 16) | isGameInProgress TRUE | Presents |
|-----|----|------------------------------|----------------------|----------|
| d30_1 | 1 | `90e7816cfee16cf5` | 18 | 33×(116550/52588) + 1 pre-GL |
| d30_2 | 1 | `90e7816cfee16cf5` | 18 | identical |
| d30_3 | 1 | `90e7816cfee16cf5` | 18 | identical |

90-frame full session: **79 × `isGameInProgress ret=TRUE`**, 94 presents
(93 consistent + the first pre-GL), 7 element colors present
(walls `0,0,255` ×52,588 · ball/flippers/launch-lane white ×32,234 ·
bumpers magenta ×15,700 · cyan ×9,474 · green ×3,023 · red ×2,349 ·
yellow ×1,175).

## 4) HONEST REMAINING GAP (registered, not hidden)

**The libGDX-Box2D native family is unimplemented** → ball physics idle.
`World/Body/Fixture` JNI addresses stay 0 → `Fixture.getShape` throws
`GdxRuntimeException` (the app's own `addr==0` guard) → caught by
`onDrawFrame`'s catch-all → deferred APP-BOUNDARY unwind at
`BouncyActivity.onCreate invoke_pc=632` (the #469 gap-3 shape) → rc=1 /
PARTIAL status. The table, the game state machine, the taps, the score bar
and the per-present rendering are real and deterministic; the ball renders
at its launch position because `World.step` has no engine counterpart yet.
**The S139 frontier**: the Box2D JNI family (world/body/fixture address
minting + `World.step` integration + contact callbacks → bumper scores →
launch → game over).

**Reject criteria for this achievement:** the §0 recipe's Confirm set fails
on any clause. Re-open with the stderr.

> Coder 3 — the game starts and every present carries the full table.
> Verification recipes above; reject with stderr if any face regresses.

issues.title: Coder 6 | Wave 7 — second recycle rebuild survived: full law set re-applied on S154 + 12 NEW laws; Mindustry chain live end-to-end, app content in the window
issues.body:
# Coder 6 | Wave 7 — SECOND recycle rebuild survived: the full law set re-applied on S154 + 12 NEW generic laws; Mindustry EXIT=0 with the render chain LIVE end-to-end and app content reaching the window

> Board: **#437** · Case files: #438 (VLC) · #439 (Termux) · #440 (Organic Maps) · #441 (Mindustry) · Wave-6: **#493**
> **The wave-6 local tree was lost to a second sandbox recycle.** This wave re-applied EVERY Coder-6 law on top of S154 `7bbf087a` (from the issue transfer documents, same verify rows) and then fixed what the re-run exposed. The full patch is also attached to this thread as a transfer artifact: `wave7_full.patch` (3403 lines, one commit `98b83dd9` on top of S154). Contents:write is still required to push.

## PART A — the rebuilt law set (waves 1–6, all re-verified live on ONE binary)

Same law set as #493 Part A (R3 token, R5 Os.stat, R6a-f, R7a-d, R8a-n, R9a-d) — rebuilt from the issue specs and re-verified against the SAME rows: `[C6-T2D] tex up 1x1 tex=7 b0=0xffffffff` ✓, `[C6-UM4F] m0=0.00416667 m5=0.0025 m12=-1 m15=1` ✓ (bit-exact ortho), `[C6-SURF] GL surface 480x800 (view measured 1080x1920)` ✓, `[C6-PUMP] frames=48` ✓ (twice, both stages), `[C6-SLOTS] prog=6 pos=1 col=2 uv=3` ✓, `[C6-NDB] cap=393216` ✓, `[C6-PMAP] loadJni 64x64 (16384B)` ✓ ×3, `EXIT=0`, zero SIGSEGV.

## PART B — 12 NEW laws the rebuild exposed (root → law → verify)

### W7-1: static-arg convention (bridge_to_api)
- **ROOT:** every static native block I rebuilt scanned `args[1]` for the first param — bridge_to_api delivers STATIC calls with **args[0] = the first parameter** (no receiver slot; the `[C86-BB] argc=1` evidence on HEAD). arc `newDisposableByteBuffer` read cap=0 → every mesh buffer empty.
- **LAW:** all Coder-6 static blocks scan from 0 (BufferUtils-twin convention); S108 `allocate/allocateDirect` cap too (first-INT32 scan).
- **VERIFY:** `[C6-NDB] cap=393216 caller=Larc/util/Buffers;.newUnsafeByteBuffer`.

### W7-2: DalvikHeap typed element reads
- **ROOT:** `[B` elements store `DalvikType::BYTE` (`byte_val`) — the wave-7 helper read only INT32 → cursor.png materialized as all-zeros → decode fail → ArcRuntimeException → catch-all death in `AndroidLauncher.onCreate`.
- **LAW:** `c6_heap_int/c6_heap_bits` handle BYTE/SHORT/CHAR (+ the C6-R7b bit-identity for `[F` slots in INT32).
- **VERIFY:** `[C6-PMAP] loadJni 64x64 (16384B)` rows; no pixmap death.

### W7-3: C6-R4 String regex family (was missing from every rebase doc)
- **ROOT:** arc `OS;.<clinit>`: `replaceAll("^(\\d+).*", "$1")` → NO handler → `Strings.parseInt(null)` NPE → the game's class-init died.
- **LAW:** `String.replaceAll/replaceFirst/matches` over `std::regex` (ECMAScript subset; Java-only constructs answer UNCHANGED with a loud `[C6-REGEX-STUB]` row).
- **VERIFY:** no `OS;.<clinit>` unwind in crash.log (was error #2 of every run).

### W7-4: FloatBuffer pointer-call chase fix
- **ROOT:** `glVertexAttribPointer` with a FloatBuffer view NEVER reached the bridge — the marshal chase hopped `__bb_parent__` but the generic one-level probe re-read the ORIGINAL view (finding only the non-array parent) → "not materializable" REC-MISS. The position attribute (slot 1) had NO pointer → every 4020-vertex scene draw either collapsed or crashed.
- **LAW:** the probe runs on the LAST HOPPED object (FloatBuffer → byte parent → `__bb_array__`).
- **VERIFY:** `[C6-ATTR] attrib#1 store=393216B pos=0 stride=24` (was: absent).

### W7-5: C6-R8l-FBO — depth renderbuffer init (the scene-black root)
- **ROOT:** PGL's `glRenderbufferStorage` **memset(0)** — depth 0.0 = "already closest"; every depth-tested fragment in every FBO discarded. Mindustry clears COLOR only → the scene FBO rendered BLACK (the `[C6-PROBE]` post-draw row proved the writes were swallowed, not lost later).
- **LAW:** every depth-family renderbuffer storage is memset to 1.0 (packed z max) at storage time — the per-FBO twin of R8l.
- **VERIFY:** `[C6-RBDEPTH] rb=3 cleared to 1.0 (384000B)`.

### W7-6: C6-R8j last-presented snapshot
- **ROOT:** the pump's LAST iteration ends mid-frame (post-clear, pre-composite) — the capture read a bare cleared window on ~half the runs.
- **LAW:** after every frame's draws the back buffer is snapshotted WHEN non-uniform; the capture presents the last COMPLETE frame (SurfaceFlinger law).
- **VERIFY:** the capture is stable across runs (was: uniform on runs 14/17).

### W7-7: C6-R8m/n row flip
- **ROOT:** the fork's default-FB writes are bottom-origin (logical y=0 = memory row h-1) — the window blit presented the frame upside down.
- **LAW:** the stage blit flips rows; the capture orientation matches the app's.
- **VERIFY:** the PNG's content orientation matches Mindustry's layout.

### W7-8: blit-mode NO color multiply
- **ROOT:** my generic FS multiplied by the (disabled-slot) color in blit mode → the window blit collapsed to black. R8c's blit contract = texture ALONE.
- **LAW:** mode 0 = `tex * v_color` (sprite), mode 1 = `tex` (blit), mode 2 = `tex0*OriginalIntensity + tex1*BloomIntensity` (bloom composite).
- **VERIFY:** `[C6-FAMILY]` rows + the window carries the app's own presentation.

### W7-9: W6-4 fallback = the app's OWN presentation texture
- **ROOT:** the combine-source anchor "first render target of the frame" resolved to a ping-pong texture (the frame's first FBO draw is not the scene draw).
- **LAW:** the combine's `u_texture0` falls back to `last_window_unit0_tex_` (the C6-R8m/n unit-0 window-blit request — the app's own presentation pick).
- **VERIFY:** `[C6-SELFCHK] COMBINE … present=N → u_texture0:=present` rows.

### W7-10: marshal materialize-once-per-epoch cache
- **ROOT:** the GL marshal re-materialized the whole mesh backing PER CALL — 4 attrib binds × 393216 heap-field reads per flush = the run burned its whole wall budget INSIDE `AndroidGL20;.glVertexAttribPointer PC=3/4` (the `[WALL-STOP]` face).
- **LAW:** per-OID epoch on `DalvikHeap::set_object_field` (array-element writes bump it); the shadow materializes each backing ONCE per epoch and every consumer copies from the cache.
- **VERIFY:** the run completes the 48-frame pump in budget (was: wall-stop at ~800k instructions).

### W7-11: bionic/EGL anchor completion
- **ROOT:** OM dlopen died at `undefined symbol: eglGetConfigAttrib` (the R9b family was 6 symbols short).
- **LAW:** +eglGetConfigAttrib/GetConfigs/QueryContext/CreatePixmapSurface/CopyBuffers/SurfaceAttrib.
- **VERIFY:** `[S2-NATIVE] dlopen ok … JNI_OnLoad ran` (version 0x10006) — restored.

### W7-12: C6-GT scene-target law + full-frame sample
- **ROOT:** the GT check read the wrong texture (frame-order anchor) and sampled only the first 512 pixels (row 0 — all background).

issues.body:
# [W2][Coder-4] Nine generic laws — the 4APP4 arrest chain broken end-to-end: ConnectBot 10→1 errors · Nextcloud 0-frames→APP_PIXELS · Tusky dlopen+TLS stack ALIVE · Thunderbird C1 closed

**Owner:** Coder-4 · **Track:** `4APP4` · **Wave:** W2 (2026-11-03) · **Epic:** #430 · **Wave log:** #436

> **HOW TO VERIFY THIS ISSUE IN 10 MINUTES:** every law below carries a `VERIFY` block — a single command against the patched binary. The full patch is attached at the bottom (git-apply-able, 525 lines, sha16 `9570a4da6f52ba5b`). Baseline for every A/B: current `main` HEAD `7bbf087` (S154), binary rebuilt with `make -j2` in this sandbox (engine class `e3f57db1c91c7de2` family). The four APKs are the SHA-pinned set from the M0 baseline (all four re-verified byte-identical today: `473b33da5963d0a4` / `96cf501a83e89284` / `8154cabe67374f2e` / `c9ba2e85b13fee45`).

## Wave summary (what moved, measured)

| App | W1 (M0 baseline) arrest | W2 frontier after this stack | Measured movement |
|---|---|---|---|
| **ConnectBot** `org.connectbot` 1.11.1-oss | CNFE `kotlin.reflect...ReflectionFactoryImpl` uncaught from `Reflection.<clinit>` | `Object.getClass` null-check family fully passed; runs Compose composition + Hilt ViewModel factory + TerminalManager service + **reaches `libconscrypt_jni.so` `JNI_OnLoad`** | crash.log errors **10 → 1**; stub census 8501 → **24604**; deterministic face `b5a7a35d5fe0564b` ×2 runs |
| **Nextcloud** `com.nextcloud.client` 35.0.2 | NPE `getApplicationContext` in `AndroidInjection.inject` at 0 frames | **`first_missing_stage=APP_PIXELS`** (past APP_DRAW_OPS — deepest of the four) | 0 frames → rendered draw-ops stage; stub census → **7139** |
| **Tusky** `com.keylesspalace.tusky` 33.1 | `UnsatisfiedLinkError` dlopen `__strchr_chk` | dlopen **OK**, `JNI_OnLoad` runs, conscrypt ULE **caught by the app's own `NativeCrypto.<clinit>` handler**, OkHttp cipher-suite list builds | verdict NO_ROOT at WINDOW_ROOT (Compose family frontier); stub census 2399 → **2729** |
| **Thunderbird** `net.thunderbird.android` 24.0 | CNFE `org.conscrypt.Conscrypt$Version` uncaught (R350-FORNAME family) | **All three M0 CNFEs now CAUGHT by their DEX handlers** (`ConscryptSocketAdapter` @0x20, `BouncyCastleSocketAdapter` @0x14, `Reflection` @0xe) — C1 is CLOSED at current HEAD; new frontier: `MainActivity.onCreate` pc=31 `BaseCatalogFeatureFlagProvider.state` iget-null | 7 uncaught remain, all inside app logic (feature-flag/Hilt chain) |

The W1 roots C1 (deferred-CNF bootstrap) and C2 (Dagger null-recv) are **both broken** this wave; C3 (Conscrypt native gate) advanced from "dlopen refused" to "JNI_OnLoad runs, faults are contained, the app degrades gracefully exactly as on device".

---

## Law 1 — F-NEW-261x: androidx `onCreate` DEX-body fall-through (env-gated A/B)

**Root.** The S83-APXACT semantic shadow bypasses `AppCompatActivity.onCreate`/`FragmentActivity.onCreate` for the whole **androidx** family (the F-NEW-261 fall-through only covers `Landroid/support/`). The bypass was built when the androidx `<init>` chain lost final-field values (F-NEW-262). At S154 HEAD that premise is **stale**: `ComponentActivity.<init>` now runs complete (evidence: `SavedStateRegistryImpl.<init>`, `LifecycleRegistry.<init>`, `activityResultRegistry$1.<init>`, `ContextAwareHelper`, `MenuHostHelper` all execute — full trace in the ConnectBot run). The bypass now *arrests* the apps it was built to protect: `ComponentActivity.onCreate` never runs → `SavedStateRegistryController.performRestore` never runs → `isRestored` stays false → the first ViewModel with a SavedStateHandle throws the app's own ISE `You can 'consumeRestoredStateForKey' only after the corresponding component has moved to the 'CREATED' state` → APP-BOUNDARY death at `MainActivity.onCreate` pc=221 (crash.log #1–#7 chain through `HiltViewModelFactory` → `InitializerViewModelFactory` → `ViewModelKt.createSavedStateHandle` → `SavedStateHandlesProvider.performRestore`).

**Fix.** Extend the F-NEW-261 DEX-body fall-through to the androidx family for `onCreate` only, behind `MINIANDROID_F261X_LAW=1` (default OFF = byte-identical to recorded anchors). On a real device the whole androidx super chain executes real bytecode; only `android.app.Activity` is the framework boundary.

**VERIFY (30 s):**
```bash
# A/B — same binary, law OFF vs ON:
./build/miniandroid run --data-root /tmp/dr --package org.connectbot -o /tmp/A --max-seconds 120
MINIANDROID_F261X_LAW=1 ./build/miniandroid run --data-root /tmp/dr --package org.connectbot -o /tmp/B --max-seconds 120
grep -c "consumeRestoredStateForKey" <run B stderr>   # 0 (law ON: ISE gone)
# run A stderr carries the ISE + [S83-APXACT] onCreate bypass line; run B carries
# the androidx onCreate DEX execution instead. Accept/reject in one diff.
```
**Fan-out risk (honest):** androidx fall-through re-opens F-NEW-262 for OLD support-era apps (notes_secuso NPE at `FragmentActivity.onCreate` pc=0xc was the recorded kill). That is exactly why this law ships env-gated: run the anchor wall with `MINIANDROID_F261X_LAW=1` before ever defaulting it ON. The support-family arm is untouched.

## Law 2 — F-NEW-541: SERVICE `newInstance()` law (default ON, `MINIANDROID_SVC_INIT_LAW=0` opt-out)

**Root.** The `startService`/`bindService` law (`dalvik_engine.cpp` ~38723) allocated the service heap object and jumped straight to `onCreate` — AOSP `LoadedApk` instantiates manifest services via `cl.loadClass(name).newInstance()`, so the no-arg `<init>` (and with it EVERY instance field initializer) runs BEFORE `onCreate`. Without it the R414/F274 fabrication crutch "honestly" nulled Kotlin property fields whose initializer types lack a `()V` ctor, and the app died inside its own `onCreate`/`onBind` on the null receiver (ConnectBot: `bridgesFlow` → `ReadonlyStateFlow.$$delegate_0` iget-null-recv NPE ×2 → APP-BOUNDARY).

**Fix.** After `heap_.allocate`, dispatch `<init>()V` via `invoke_lifecycle_method` before `onCreate`; record an `SVC-INIT` FileIoTrace row. Opt-out env for hygiene A/B.

**VERIFY (20 s):** run ConnectBot as above; `grep -c "F274-CTORGATE.*TerminalManager" <stderr>` — with the law ON the TerminalManager CTORGATE rows disappear (the real `<init>` ran: `MutableStateFlow` invokes at `TerminalManager.<init>` pc 0x18/0x5c execute).

## Law 3 — F-NEW-542: never-null AOSP `SystemServiceRegistry` batch (+17 services)

**Root.** AOSP answers a non-null manager for every registered service; `null` is reserved for unknown names. The engine's table missed `"wifi"` (plus 16 neighbors): `ConnectivityMonitor.<init>` DEX pc 0x34 `getSystemService("wifi")` → null → the R8 null-check idiom `getClass()` fired NPE at the APP-BOUNDARY (verified: disassembly `pc 0x30: const-string "wifi"` → `pc 0x3c: Object.getClass()`).

**Fix.** `wifi, telephony, download, battery, usb, print, device_policy, storage, networkstats, nsd, media_router, appwidget, media_session, wallpaper, textservices, restrictions, dropbox` added to BOTH the name map and the `getSystemService(Class)` map.

**VERIFY (10 s):** `grep "EXP093-SVC" <stderr> | grep wifi` — before: `→ null (unknown service)`; after: `→ Landroid/net/wifi/WifiManager;`.

## Law 4 — F-NEW-543: `WifiManager`/`WifiLock` never-null object laws

**Root.** With "wifi" resolving, the NEXT never-null contract broke: `WifiManager.createWifiLock(String)` answered the fail-soft null → `ConnectivityMonitor.<init>` pc unit 41 (byte 0x52) `getClass()` NPE. AOSP `createWifiLock` has no null path.

**Fix.** `createWifiLock` allocates a `WifiManager$WifiLock` (`mHeld` 0, `mRefCounted` 1); `acquire`/`release`/`isHeld`/`setReferenceCounted` follow the AOSP object law.

**VERIFY:** `grep "F543-WIFI" <stderr>` — `createWifiLock → WifiLock obj#N (AOSP never-null law) caller=Lorg/connectbot/service/ConnectivityMonitor;.<init>`.

## Law 5 — F-NEW-544: `NetworkRequest.Builder` fluent-chain law (+ ConnectivityManager callback registration)

**Root.** AOSP `NetworkRequest.Builder.addCapability(...)` returns `this`. The fail-soft null broke the chain at the second link: `TerminalManager.onCreate` DEX pc 0x16a `addCapability` → null → pc 0x176 `removeCapability` f141 null-recv NPE → APP-BOUNDARY (the deepest arrest of the pre-fix run). Same family as the CONT-41 `Notification$Builder` fluent-chain law.

**Fix.** All builder mutators return the receiver (`args[0]`); `build()` returns a fresh `NetworkRequest`; `registerNetworkCallback`/`registerDefaultNetworkCallback`/`unregister*`/`requestNetwork` answer void (no-radio deterministic state — callbacks never fire, matching the honest no-network state; apps null-check `getActiveNetwork`, which ConnectBot does at DEX pc 0x1a6 `if-eqz`).

**VERIFY:** `grep "F544-NETCB" <stderr>` — `registerNetworkCallback → void (no-radio deterministic state) caller=Lorg/connectbot/service/TerminalManager;.onCreate`.

## Law 6 — F-NEW-545: bionic fortify STRING family (the Tusky dlopen root — C3 first half)

**Root.** `libconscrypt_jni.so` (sha16 `8a6b02c3af4f3249`) extracted OK but dlopen failed: `undefined symbol: __strchr_chk`. The bionic FORTIFY string helpers are not exported by glibc for arbitrary dlopen bind — the whole OkHttp/Conscrypt ecosystem dies at the loader (Tusky W1 arrest, verbatim).

**Fix.** `__strchr_chk / __strrchr_chk / __strcpy_chk / __strncpy_chk / __strcat_chk / __strncat_chk / __stpcpy_chk / __stpncpy_chk / __memchr_chk` in `bionic_compat.c`, same honest-by-construction law as the existing `__strlen_chk`.

**VERIFY (10 s):** run Tusky; `grep "S2-NATIVE" <stderr>` — before: `dlopen failed: undefined symbol: __strchr_chk`; after: `dlopen ok ... JNI_OnLoad ran` (or the F-NEW-546 fault line below — both prove the loader passed).

## Law 7 — F-NEW-546: SIGABRT/SIGILL join the FIX-TTT native guard (C3 second half)

**Root.** With dlopen fixed, `JNI_OnLoad` of conscrypt ran against the minimal JNIEnv and its own CHECK path called `abort()` after `NativeCrypto: could not find field address` (GetFieldID is an unimplemented slot) → SIGABRT → **the whole run died rc=134** before the engine could raise the AOSP load-failure contract. A native init that aborts inside the guarded handshake is a library-vs-bridge contract failure — same law class as the SIGSEGV/SIGBUS arm of FIX-TTT.

**Fix.** Guarded signal set `{SIGSEGV, SIGBUS}` → `{SIGSEGV, SIGBUS, SIGABRT, SIGILL}` (saved-action array widened 2→4). Consequence chain now runs EXACTLY as on device: guard catches the abort → `dlclose` → honest `UnsatisfiedLinkError` → **the app's own `NativeCrypto.<clinit>` catch handler receives it** (`[EXC-PROPAGATE] ... caught at caller Lorg/conscrypt/NativeCrypto;.<clinit> handler=0x8`) → Conscrypt degrades gracefully → OkHttp platform fallback.

**VERIFY (15 s):** run Tusky or ConnectBot; `grep "S2-NATIVE\|checkAvailability" <stderr>` — the run **survives** (no rc=134), and `Conscrypt.checkAvailability` rethrows ULE that app code catches. This single law is what keeps every conscrypt-bearing APK alive at the native frontier.

## Law 8 — F-NEW-547: `Arrays$ArrayList` ancestry edge + CollectionShadow `toArray` heap-fields cascade

**Root (two halves, one face).** OkHttp `ConnectionSpec.<clinit>` (R8 `lk/o`) builds `APPROVED_CIPHER_SUITES` via `Arrays.asList` (R8-merged `glide.g.a0` → `Arrays$ArrayList` heap object with `__array_length__`=23 + `array[i]` fields — verified `[F235-ASLIST] src=408 heap_len=9` / `src=567 heap_len=23`), then `Collection.toArray(new T[0])` — invoked as **invoke-interface** → `CollectionShadow::dispatch` answers FIRST with its own store, which is EMPTY for asList-minted objects → `n=0` → zero-length array → `ConnectionSpec.Builder.build()` throws the app's own IAE `At least one cipher suite is required` → clinit death → the whole OkHttp TLS stack down. The F-NEW-238 bridge cascade could never run (the shadow layer answers first — proven: my env-gated `[F547-DIAG]` at the F-238 entry never printed). Second half: even the bridge check `is_subclass_of(Arrays$ArrayList, AbstractCollection)` answered FALSE — the extends edge `Arrays$ArrayList → AbstractList` was missing from `framework_direct_superclass` (only the interfaces row existed).

**Fix.** (a) Add the OpenJDK extends edge `{"Ljava/util/Arrays$ArrayList;", "Ljava/util/AbstractList;"}`. (b) In `CollectionShadow::dispatch`'s `toArray`: when the shadow store is empty and the receiver carries heap `__array_length__` > 0, source the elements from the receiver's own `array[i]` fields (typed readers: string → ref(+class) → int cascade).

**VERIFY (20 s):** run Tusky; `grep -c "At least one cipher suite" <stderr>` — before: 3; after: **0**. Stub census moves 2399 → 2729 (the OkHttp client builder now completes).

## Law 9 — F-NEW-548: `DocumentsProvider → ContentProvider` framework edge (the Nextcloud C2 root)

**Root.** `DocumentsStorageProvider` extends `android.provider.DocumentsProvider` (framework) extends `ContentProvider`. The DEX chain walk reaches `DocumentsProvider` and stops — the framework leg was missing — so EVERY `is_subclass_of(x, ContentProvider)` law (the `S1-PROVIDER-CTX` getContext bind, the provider install gate) refused it. `AndroidInjection.inject(provider)` → `DocumentsProvider.getContext` REC-MISS → no law fired → null → `Context.getApplicationContext` f141 null-recv NPE at `AndroidInjection.inject` pc=9 → APP-BOUNDARY at **0 frames** (the recorded NC-M0/C2 arrest).

**Fix.** One row: `{"Landroid/provider/DocumentsProvider;", "Landroid/content/ContentProvider;"}` (AOSP source truth). Nextcloud goes from 0 frames to `first_missing_stage=APP_PIXELS` and 7139 IMPLEMENTED stubs.

**VERIFY (30 s):** run Nextcloud; the run report's `frame truth: verdict=DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY, first_missing_stage=APP_PIXELS` (was: 0 frames, NPE at `AndroidInjection.inject pc=9` in crash.log #1).

---

## How the maintainer can reject me, cheaply

Each law is independently revertable (one `git apply -R` hunk each). The fastest falsification tests, per law: 261x → toggle the env var and diff the stderr for the SavedStateRegistry ISE; 541 → count `F274-CTORGATE.*TerminalManager` rows; 542/543/544 → grep the three `[EXP093-SVC]`/`[F543-WIFI]`/`[F544-NETCB]` marker lines; 545 → grep `S2-NATIVE` for the dlopen verdict; 546 → run Tusky and observe rc (134 = the law is missing, not my claim); 547 → grep the cipher-suite IAE count; 548 → the Nextcloud frame-truth line. **Corpus battery caveat (honest):** the external APK corpus is not present in this sandbox (S153 purge; Issues-only token) — the anchor wall + 99/99 regression battery must run on the maintainer side before merge; laws 542–548 are additive never-null/edge laws with low blast radius, 541 changes service startup order (AOSP-faithful, opt-out env `MINIANDROID_SVC_INIT_LAW=0`), 261x is env-gated OFF by default.

issues.body:
Coder 6, wave 6 (local commit on top of S154 `7bbf087a`; the token still has Issues:write only — Contents:write needed to push).

## WHY THIS WAVE WAS A REBASE (important for the merge path)

The public HEAD (S154 `7bbf087a`) contains **ZERO of the Coder-6 engine laws** — S153 recorded the coder diffs as LOCAL ("merge-path decision queued"). My local tree was lost to a sandbox recycle, so wave 6 re-implemented **every law from waves 1–5b (30+ laws) directly on top of HEAD**, using the issue transfer documents (#442, #444, #445, #470, #441 wave-5, #440 wave-5b) as the spec. Every law is behavior-verified against the SAME verify rows the original waves published — any drift would be a rebase bug, not a new claim.

**Merge-path note:** the Contents side should apply THIS commit (not the lost a4e42ae→97e0174→686ee39 line) — it is the rebase onto current HEAD, and it also carries wave-6's new laws below.

## PART A — the rebased law set (each previously published, re-verified live)

| Block | Laws |
|---|---|
| `dalvik_engine.cpp` | C6-R3 const-class TOKEN law (both getSystemService sites), C6-R5 `android.system.Os` stat/lstat/fstat over real host syscalls, C6-R6a arc Buffers native family, C6-R6e arc Pixmap over the real decoder, C6-R7a ByteBuffer ABSOLUTE family + backing-array write-through, C6-R7b `[F` bit-identity, C6-R6g typed-view put-through + in-place growth, C6-R6i view limit/position |
| `gl_surface_shadow.cpp` | OpenJDK zero-fill array law (missing elements answer 0 — replaces eager fills), raw-field bit-identity read, typed-view chase hops (`__bb_parent__` ×3), 8MiB byte-budget marshal, C6-R6b info-log law, C6-R6d glGetString law, gen* write-back (+FBO/RB), C6-R6f/R6h client-array store |
| `gles20_bridge.cpp/h` | C6-R6c spec2pgl full translation + real FB/texture family + texImage2D packed/luminance/depth conversions + clear-mask translation, C6-R8g/h sampler unit mirror, C6-R8c draw-time program family WITH attribute-slot discovery (NEW — below), C6-R6k generic C-shader program, C6-R7c identity-MVP default, arc Bloom intensity defaults, C6-R8b disabled-attrib spec default, C6-R6f draw bounds guard + null-buffer seed, error back-translation, self-sample clone law (NEW — below) |
| `pgl_backend.cpp` | C6-R8l depth-clear-at-init, texture reader + cloner |
| `execution_engine.cpp` | C6-R8a presentation-size surfaces, C6-R8e 48-frame render pump (wall-budget guarded), C6-R8j last-presented buffer, C6-R8m/n scene-surface presentation, C6-R7d full-frame scale |
| anchors | C6-R9a bionic property API, C6-R9b EGL lifecycle family (22 fns), C6-R9c GL link completion, C6-R9d FORTIFY family |

## PART B — NEW wave-6 laws (root → law → verify)

### C6-W6-1: relative-vs-absolute putInt ARITY law
- **ROOT:** the S108 relative `putInt` handler answered `true` for EVERY arity — the 3-arg ABSOLUTE call `putInt(index, value)` (arc `Pixmap.fill`) fell into the relative path which wrote the INDEX into slot 0 and never reached the absolute family. The white pixel uploaded black even with the R7a law present.
- **LAW:** relative handlers answer only `args.size()==2` and FALL THROUGH otherwise (the absolute family owns 3+ args).
- **VERIFY:** `[C6-T2D] tex up 1x1 … b0=0xffffffff` (the arc white pixel).

### C6-W6-2: loadJni int-pair order-agnostic validation
- **ROOT:** `[C6-PMAP-JNI] loadJni a_len=336 off=336 len=0` — the dispatch delivers the (offset,len) pair as (len,offset) on this path; the old strict scan decoded nothing ("empty image buffer") and ArcRuntimeException killed `AndroidLauncher.onCreate`.
- **LAW:** order-agnostic window normalization (swap detectable when `off>=a_len && len<a_len`), then the real decoder runs.
- **VERIFY:** `[C6-PMAP] loadJni 64x64 (16384B)` rows; no `Error loading pixmap` death.

### C6-W6-3: attribute-slot discovery (the biggest of the wave)
- **ROOT:** `[C6-DRAWGUARD] attrib#1 needs 512B, store 0B` + uniform-black frames despite a PERFECT mesh (`[C6-MESH] v0 pos=65.36,25.0 col=127,105,63,254 uv=0.25,0.25`). The generic VS hardcoded slots 0/1/2; arc's shaders use slots **1/2/3** (its attrib locations are minted AFTER u_projTrans took slot 0) — every vertex collapsed to one read-only corner.
- **LAW:** the generic VS indexes `vertex_attribs[apos/acol/auv]` from the app's own minted locations (a_position/a_color/a_texCoord0 name match), refreshed at every `apply_program_state` (the app mints after glLinkProgram).
- **VERIFY:** `[C6-SLOTS] prog=… pos=1 col=2 uv=3`-shaped rows + `[C6-GT] fb=14 att0_tex=15 … differing=477/512` (the scene FBO fills with app content).

### C6-W6-4: arc Bloom intensity defaults + combine-source law
- **ROOT:** the combine output was BLACK: `C6GenUniforms` zero-initialized `OriginalIntensity/BloomIntensity` to 0.0 — arc's Bloom.java initializes both to **1**. And the APK's combine blit leaves unit 0 on a ping-pong texture (its bind loop never rebinds the source), sampling a stale texture as "Original".
- **LAW:** intensity defaults 1.0 (arc law); the combine's `u_texture0` falls back to the app's own presentation texture (the C6-R8m/n unit-0 window-blit request) when the unit mirror holds a ping-pong id.
- **VERIFY:** `[C6-SELFCHK] COMBINE fb=14 att=15 tex0=15 tex1=18 present=15` rows.

### C6-W6-5: self-sample CLONE law (FBO feedback)
- **ROOT:** PGL renders straight into the target texture's memory — a draw that SAMPLES its own target smears across itself (the diagonal-gradient face). Real GL reads the PRE-DRAW content; every FBO-based app (arc Bloom ping-pong) relies on that.
- **LAW:** at draw time, when a sampler unit's texture == the current target's attachment, the engine clones the target texture (fresh PGL texture, same pixels) and points the sampler at the clone for that draw.
- **VERIFY:** `[C6-CLONE] tex0 self-sample: src=15 → clone=N` rows.

## PART C — per-app live rows on the ONE rebased binary

| App | Live state |
|---|---|
| **Mindustry** | boots through arc GL init → shaders → FBOs → textures → pixmaps (real 64x64 decodes) → mesh fill with REAL vertex data → **123+ real draws, 0 guard-skips** → blur/combine/window composite chain reaches the window (non-uniform content). `[C6-T2D] tex up 1x1 b0=0xffffffff` ✓, `[C6-UM4F] u_projTrans m0=0.00416667 m5=0.0025 m12=-1 m15=1` ✓ (bit-exact ortho), `[C6-NDB] cap=393216` ✓, `[C6-SURF] GL surface 480x800` ✓, `[C6-PUMP] frames=48` ✓ |
| **VLC** | `[C6-GSS-TOKEN-A] OBJECT_REF Class token obj=167 desc=Landroid/app/NotificationManager; → "notification"` — the R3 law live; OnboardingActivity start reached; EXIT=0; zero SIGSEGV |
| **Termux** | `[C6-OSSTAT] lstat → ErrnoException(ENOENT)` at `NativeDispatcher;.lstat pc=3` → **HANDLED** (the app's own catch) — the R5 law live; EXIT=0; zero SIGSEGV |
| **Organic Maps** | `[S2-NATIVE] load organicmaps: dlopen ok … JNI_OnLoad ran` (version 0x10006) — the R9a-d anchors live; `MwmApplication.onCreate OK ins=6046`; SplashActivity dispatches `getSplashScreen` |

## HONEST REMAINING FRONTIER (wave 7 queue, in order)

1. **Mindustry bloom-combine fidelity** — the window receives the composite (non-uniform, structured) but the face is a green-gradient blur: the combine's alpha/blend interplay (blur textures carry alpha≈0 → `0x00FFFF`-style rows) + the u_texture0 semantic on the APK's actual bind order. Diagnostics already in place: `[C6-SELFCHK]`, `[C6-CLONE]`, `[C6-CLONESRC]`, `[C6-MESH]`.
2. **Mindustry window-composite content law** — the fb=0 blit samples tex15 (the combine output) per the app's own presentation request; once the combine carries the scene correctly the window follows.
3. **Organic Maps** — `WorkManager JobScheduler21.getAllPendingJobs pc=7` null receiver (the new post-splash frontier; the wave-5b SplashScreen shadow gap is crossed).
4. **VLC** OnboardingActivity exit → MainTvActivity RESUMED end-to-end; **Termux** bootstrap/install flow.

```
./miniandroid/build/miniandroid install apk_cache/mindustry_1115.apk --data-root /tmp/c6w6 \
```
